jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Willow Grove, PA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BUILDOUT

Buildout is the AI deal engine for CRE brokerages, automating every step from first contact to commission. While brokers focus on relationships and winning listings, Buildout handles the workflows behind the scenes, turning manual processes into intelligent, scalable systems. Trusted by over 50,000 brokers, Buildout powers more profitable deals from lead to close. Learn more at www.buildout.com http://www.buildout.com.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Content Marketing Manager who can turn complex ideas into content people actually want to read, watch, share, and act on.

This is not a traditional content production role. You’ll help shape our content strategy and bring it to life across the CRE buyer journey - from the big ideas that establish our point of view to the practical content that helps prospects understand our product and customers make better decisions.

You’ll bring both strong writing skills and creative instincts to the role. Great content isn't always written content. You’ll determine the right format and creative treatment for an idea - whether that’s an article, LinkedIn post, customer story, carousel, infographic, short-form video, webinar, interactive experience, or something we haven’t tried yet. You should be comfortable creating simple visual assets yourself and partnering with designers or other creative resources when an idea calls for deeper production.

AI will be a meaningful part of how you work. You’ll use AI to research faster, develop ideas, create and repurpose assets, personalize content, and increase your output - while bringing the judgment, voice, creativity, and perspective that AI cannot provide on its own.

You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, sales, subject-matter experts, and leadership to turn what we know into content that builds awareness, earns trust, and contributes to the pipeline.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN


Build and Execute a Content Strategy

 - Help develop and execute a content strategy aligned to company priorities, ICPs, product launches, and revenue goals.

 - Identify high-value topics and perspectives, turning customer insights, product knowledge, market trends, and internal expertise into differentiated content.

 - Manage the editorial roadmap across channels, audiences, and stages of the buyer journey.

 - Write and edit content across formats including thought leadership, articles, customer stories, email, social, webinars, sales enablement, and website content.
   

Think Creatively About Format

 - Start with the idea, audience, and desired outcome - not a predetermined content format.

 - Determine the best way to bring an idea to life, whether through written, visual, interactive, video, or social content.

 - Create lightweight visual assets yourself using tools such as Canva, Figma, Adobe, or AI-powered creative tools. (Will leverage outside agencies for larger projects.)
   

Use AI as a Force Multiplier

 - Use AI throughout the content workflow - research, ideation, outlining, drafting, editing, repurposing, creative development, and distribution.

 - Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve content velocity without sacrificing quality.

 - Experiment with emerging AI tools and identify practical ways to make the marketing team more effective.

 - Understand where AI-generated content falls short and apply strong editorial and creative judgment to make the final product genuinely differentiated.
   

Make Content Discoverable

 - Partner with SEO and growth teams to create content that performs in traditional search as well as emerging AI-driven discovery environments.

 - Use search, customer, competitive, and performance data to identify content opportunities.

 - Optimize and refresh existing content based on performance and changing search behavior.

 - Think in terms of content ecosystems and topics rather than treating every piece as a standalone asset.
   

Connect Content to Business Outcomes

 - Partner with Demand Gen to turn high-performing content into campaigns and pipeline opportunities.

 - Work with Sales to create content that helps reps start conversations, educate prospects, and move deals forward.

 - Measure content performance across engagement, traffic, conversion, influenced pipeline, and other relevant metrics.

 - Continuously test, learn, refresh, and improve the content portfolio.
   




WHAT MAKES A GREAT CANDIDATE

 - 3+ years of experience in B2B content marketing, editorial, brand, or a related marketing role.

 - An excellent writer and editor who can make complex subjects clear, interesting, and compelling.

 - Experience creating content for a defined B2B audience or ICP.

 - Comfortable interviewing customers, executives, and subject-matter experts.

 - Working knowledge of SEO and modern content discovery.

 - Hands-on experience using generative AI tools as part of a professional workflow.

 - Comfortable creating basic visual assets and social creative independently.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects without losing the quality bar.

 - Curious, collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

 - Able to balance strategy with execution - you can develop the plan and then roll up your sleeves to make the thing.



HOW WE THINK ABOUT CONTENT

We don't believe AI replaces great marketers. We believe great marketers who know how to use AI will create better work, move faster, and have more room for creativity.

We're looking for someone who wants to build that kind of content engine - someone who can think strategically, write exceptionally well, spot a great story, turn an idea into the right creative format, move quickly, and use technology to make their work better.





ROLE DETAILS

Location: This is a fully remote role open across most of the US.

Travel: Interviewing, onboarding, and day-to-day work is done remotely, but we do bring the company together annually for an all-company kickoff where travel is expected.

Compensation: The targeted salary range for this position is $95,000 - $110,000

Reporting To: Jennifer Hopkins, our CMO




PERKS & BENEFITS 

This program includes:

 - Impactful insurance and benefit options, including 2 medical plans to choose from, 100% coverage of employee dental and vision insurance premiums, HSA seed, company-paid STD, LTD,  life insurance, and telemedicine, and a wellness benefit of $400/year.

 - Policies that support a healthy work/life harmony, including Flexible PTO, 14 paid company holidays, paid parental leave, and give back days

 - 401(k) with 4% company match and immediate vesting

 - A fully remote work culture with a monthly remote work reimbursement ($600/year) to support our distributed team and an annual, in-person company kickoff

 - Challenging problems to solve with a committed and supportive team who are invested in your growth and development

 - A wonderfully quirky culture where you’re encouraged to bring your whole self to work



Buildout is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. 

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at accommodations@buildout.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information and we will consider your request. 

Below, you will be asked to complete identity information for the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). It is required by law that we ask these questions using the format provided by the EEOC. However, we want you to know that at Buildout, we understand that gender is not binary and welcome people of all identities.

jobs.title: Director / Senior Director, Program Management
jobs.description:
About Tr1X

Tr1X is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing engineered Tr1 cell therapies to restore immune balance in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Leveraging the unique biology of Tr1 cells, the company is advancing a pipeline of off-the-shelf allogeneic and in vivo CAR-Tr1 therapies designed to deliver targeted immunoregulation and address diseases driven by immune dysfunction, including transplant-related complications. Founded by pioneers in the discovery of Tr1 cells, Tr1X, Inc. is focused on developing durable, potentially curative therapies for conditions with high unmet need. For more information, visit www.tr1x.bio.

Position Summary

The Director/Senior Director, Program Management provides strategic leadership and performs hands-on operational activities supporting cell therapy programs in autoimmune indications. This individual aligns cross-functional teams, manages dependencies and risks, and ensures programs deliver against milestones and organizational objectives. The Director/Senior Director partners closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Technical Operations and R&D, along with external partners to drive execution of complex preclinical and clinical programs from early development through registrational studies.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate program strategy into integrated timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring coordination across all contributing functions.

• Provide program/project management expertise and support to advance Tr1X's Tr1, CAR-Tr1 and in vivo cell therapy programs.

• Provide program management of one or more highly complex R&D programs and/or high-profile partnerships.

• Communicate with project team members, management leadership team, department heads, and key stakeholders including KOLs.

• Track and monitor key milestones and decision points to drive delivery of project objectives.

• Develop and refine tools for project governance and program timelines, as well as the communication of program KPIs, risks and achievements.

• Manage the interfaces between cross-functional teams and ensure effective handoff and communication between department functions.

• Lead cross-functional program management activities supporting autoimmune clinical development programs.

• Develop and maintain integrated clinical development plans, timelines, milestones, budgets, and risk management strategies across multiple functional areas.

• Partner with Clinical and senior leadership to support development strategy, indication prioritization, and pipeline programming.

• Ensure program activities support regulatory milestones including INDs, protocol amendments, health authority interactions, and potential BLA/MAA submissions.

• Partner with Clinical Operations to proactively identify enrollment, operational, and site-performance risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure on time and on budget study recruitment.

• Ensure seamless coordination between clinical and CMC activities supporting cell therapy manufacturing, supply planning, patient scheduling, and supply chain/delivery logistics.

• Facilitate governance meetings, cross-functional team meetings including program team meetings, clinical strategy meetings and executive program reviews.

• Collaborate with Clinical Development, Regulatory and Medical Directors on protocol strategy, clinical endpoints, efficacy measures, biomarkers, and patient-reported outcomes relevant to autoimmune studies.

• Support competitive intelligence activities and maintain awareness of evolving autoimmune treatment landscapes, clinical trial designs, and emerging therapies.

• Partner with R&D, Clinical Development and Medical Writing teams to support preparation of grants, posters, presentations and external-facing materials.

• Establish and maintain program dashboards, KPIs, and governance frameworks to ensure transparency and accountability.

• Support budget forecasting, scenario planning, and resource prioritization across the entire pipeline.

• Perform other responsibilities based on business needs.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• A minimum BA/BS and 10+ yrs in a relevant Program/Project management role supporting drug development; advanced degree (Ph.D., MS, MD) and/or PM Certification strongly preferred.

• Exceptional communication skills (in person and written word) and the ability to interact and directly engage with a diverse group of individuals.

• Extensive experience managing and partnering with contract development and manufacturing organizations in the cell and gene therapy space.

• Experience on the sponsor side with cell or gene therapy development programs required.

• Experience applying the principles, concepts, practices, and standards of project management for drug development.

• Ability to understand and communicate scientific and business elements associated with Tr1X's engineered Tr1 Treg cell therapies is a must.

• Strong skills in management of external stakeholders and ability to influence and guide them toward decisions and outcomes that support company goals.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to develop relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and effective conflict management skills.

• Results and detail-oriented for achievement of program timeline and deliverables; self-motivated, ability to work with minimal supervision.

• Ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Other Requirements

• Legally authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

• Position is on-site in San Diego, CA

The job responsibilities and requirements provided above are intended to describe the general nature of the work performed by individuals assigned to this job classification. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and requirements. Tr1X retains the right to add, change, or delete duties, education, experience or any other requirements of the position at any time.

Working at Tr1X

At Tr1X, our team is united by a singular shared mission: to transform patients’ lives through breakthrough science. We are a group of skilled experts driven by urgency, innovation and a collaborative spirit. Our culture thrives on excellence, positivity, persistence and the agility to tackle new challenges head-on. With an unwavering commitment to patients, science and one another, we foster an environment where team members feel engaged, supported and empowered to make a meaningful impact. We envision a world where autoimmune diseases are not just being treated but are cured.

Base Pay Range Anticipated: $210,000 - $230,000 (Director); $250,000 - $280,000 (Sr. Director)

Tr1X considers a variety of factors to determine salary such as education, years of experience, time in the position level, training, knowledge, skills, geographic location, and the market value of the position.

Compensation and Benefits

Tr1X provides a fair and competitive total rewards program that includes base salary; discretionary annual target bonus; incentive stock options; 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution; health and welfare insurance plans for employees (and their families) that include medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability, and life insurance; paid time off (PTO); and paid holidays.

Tr1X embraces a diverse, open, and inclusive environment and believes a strong culture connection is key to success. Tr1X is committed to fairness in recruitment, hiring, transfer, promotion or any other employment practice without regard to race, color, citizenship, national origin, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, age, physical and medical disability, medical condition, genetic information, political affiliation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you are an individual needing assistance to complete an employment application or would like to request an accommodation, please contact the Human Resources department at careers@tr1x.bio.

Notice to Employment Agencies

The Tr1X talent acquisition program is managed through internal resources, and unsolicited referrals and resumes are not accepted from employment agencies, unless advance written authorization is granted from the human resources department. Tr1X shall not be liable for any fees arising from any unsolicited or unauthorized candidate information received relative to position vacancies.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The mission of our team is to build a scalable and secure AI platform that enables security teams across Robinhood to develop and operate AI-powered agents and security solutions with confidence.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI Security team, you’ll help lead and build the foundational platform, infrastructure, and security primitives that make it easier for teams to develop AI-powered security capabilities at scale. You’ll work on complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and security, with a particular focus on areas such as identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and platform safety.

You’ll partner closely with security and engineering teams across Robinhood to create systems that make AI development easier while ensuring security is built into the platform from the start. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building platforms, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape how AI is securely adopted across security.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Design and build a scalable AI platform that enables security teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and security capabilities

• Build foundational platform services, APIs, libraries, and SDKs that make it easier for teams to integrate AI into security workflows

• Design secure systems with strong identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data protection controls

• Build and operate reliable, large-scale distributed systems that support AI-powered security use cases

• Develop platform capabilities and guardrails that enable teams to safely build and operate AI agents

• Partner with security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities

• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, developer experience, reliability, and security through automation

• Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood’s AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow

What you bring

• 8+ years of software development experience

• 6+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, with experience designing systems around security concepts such as authentication, authorization, identity, or encryption

• Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI-powered applications or agents

• Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong problem-solving and production debugging skills

• Experience with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, gRPC, or Kafka

• Strong understanding of security fundamentals and experience incorporating security into the design of production systems

• Experience designing and building reusable platform capabilities, APIs, libraries, or developer tooling

• Proven experience delivering large engineering projects with meaningful, long-term impact

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs across security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience

• Ability to solve complex engineering problems and collaborate effectively across security and engineering teams

What we offer

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

jobs.title: Veterinary Practice Liaison
jobs.description:
The Veterinary Practice Liaison serves as a key member of AMC's Outreach team and is responsible for strengthening relationships with referring veterinarians and veterinary hospitals throughout an assigned geographic territory. This field-based role focuses on referral growth, relationship management, service education, and enhancing the overall referral experience for AMC's referring community.

The Veterinary Practice Liaison acts as a trusted resource and ambassador for AMC by providing consistent engagement with referring practices, increasing awareness of AMC's specialty and emergency services, and identifying opportunities to strengthen partnerships that support patient care and hospital growth.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Management & Practice Outreach

• Manage an assigned geographic territory based on designated ZIP codes.

• Conduct a minimum of five veterinary practice visits per day through a combination of scheduled meetings and cold calls.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with veterinarians, practice managers, technicians, and hospital staff.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for referring veterinary practices within the assigned territory.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen referral partnerships and increase utilization of AMC services.

• Maintain regular visibility within the referral community through consistent in-person visits and engagement.

Referral Growth & Relationship Management

• Educate referring veterinary teams on AMC's specialty, emergency, and referral services.

• Promote AMC programs, veterinarians, continuing education opportunities, and hospital resources.

• Assist referring practices in navigating referral processes and accessing appropriate services.

• Gather feedback from referring veterinarians and communicate opportunities, concerns, and trends to AMC leadership.

• Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to support referral retention and practice satisfaction.

• Build long-term relationships designed to support sustainable referral growth.

Outreach Programs & Events

• Coordinate and participate in hospital visits, educational events, lunch-and-learn programs, and other outreach initiatives.

• Manage a quarterly outreach budget to support referral engagement activities, including in-service lunches, appreciation gifts, and branded promotional items.

• Represent AMC professionally at conferences, meetings, community events, and industry functions.

• Partner with hospital leadership to identify outreach opportunities that support strategic business objectives.

Performance & Reporting

• Track outreach activity, referral trends, and relationship-building efforts within assigned territories.

• Maintain accurate documentation of practice visits, meetings, and follow-up actions within the CRM platform.

• Monitor territory performance against established referral growth and revenue goals.

• Prepare and present regular reports on outreach activities, practice engagement, and key performance indicators.

• Meet or exceed established quarterly referral revenue benchmarks and territory performance expectations.

Qualifications

Required

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in veterinary medicine, veterinary business development, practice management, client relations, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years sales/territory management experience.

• Strong understanding of referral veterinary medicine and veterinary hospital operations.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

• Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage a territory-based schedule.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and reporting tools.

• Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently throughout assigned territories.

Preferred

• Experience in specialty, emergency, or referral veterinary medicine.

• Previous business development, outreach, pharmaceutical, or veterinary field representative experience.

• Experience presenting educational programs or facilitating professional meetings.

• Knowledge of veterinary referral networks and referring veterinarian engagement strategies.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an outgoing, relationship-focused professional with a passion for veterinary medicine and exceptional customer service. They are highly organized, comfortable working independently in the field, and skilled at building trust with veterinary professionals. This individual enjoys connecting with people, identifying opportunities for growth, and serving as a dedicated advocate for both referring practices and AMC. Their success will be measured by the strength of their relationships, territory engagement, referral growth, and contribution to AMC's strategic outreach initiatives.

Pay Range

$95,000—$125,000 USD

Excellence in veterinary medicine since 1910. AMC Offers:

A Commitment to Lifelong Learning: Founded in 1910, the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center is the world’s largest veterinary teaching hospital, offering compassionate, collaborative, and cutting-edge veterinary care. Our commitment to innovation has led to the creation of one of the most advanced veterinary facilities in the world.

State-of-the-Art Facilities: AMC just completed a major expansion and renovation. This project transformed the hospital’s entire 83,000-square-foot space into a state-of-the-art facility unlike any other.

Highlights include: A brand-new full floor surgical center, 1.5 Tesla Philips MRI (the exclusive high field MRI for small animals in NYC), 64-slice spiral CT scanner, Electroencephalography (EEG), Elekta Versa HD Linear Accelerator, In-house Laboratory, Ultrasound, Echocardiogram, and Mobile Cone Beam CT

A multidisciplinary team of 140+ veterinarians across 20+ specialties: With over 20 specialties and services under one roof, our departments frequently work together to deliver the highest quality of patient care in the veterinary field. Our dynamic array of specialists means that we are the go-to place for complex cases.

A Hospital in the heart of NYC: AMC is located in Manhattan, surrounded by leading research and teaching institutions such as Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine, Weill Cornell Medical School, and NYU. Collaborative research opportunities abound, and our strong focus on education ensures a rewarding career for those passionate about mentoring and advancing veterinary medicine.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Relief) - Willow Grove, PA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous referral reward program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Programmatic Senior Lead

• A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a continual learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a customer-focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.

• A dedication to people-focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

• Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching.

• Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses.

• Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being.

• Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available.

• Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus.

• Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities.

• AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety.

Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Designer
jobs.description:
🌿 MISSION

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn’t be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we’re building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate and lower bills, and make coverage easier to understand—saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the American’s most trusted advocate and partner to manage their healthcare, and healthcare financial decisions.




🏢 ABOUT US

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we’re a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We’re lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded and have solid runway.

Bill lowering is the hook. People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it — catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe.




🧭 ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring our first in-house Digital Marketing Production Designer to own hands-on creative production across web, email, collateral, and video. You take a brief: usually from marketing  and turn it into finished, on-brand assets ready to ship. This is a high-volume execution role: multiple landing pages, email templates, ad cuts, and decks each week, all held to Granted’s brand system and healthcare compliance rules.

One thing to flag up front: ads, landing pages, and emails are the core requirement. Video editing is a strong plus, not a must-have.




🛠 WHAT YOU’LL DO





LANDING PAGE DESIGN

 - Design and revise marketing-site and campaign landing pages in Figma (partner pages, patient-stories page, signup screens, and similar).

 - Design mobile-first, keep animation minimal, and match each page to the ad that drove the click.

 - Work from copy briefs and conversion benchmarks, not aesthetics alone.


EMAIL DESIGN

 - Design and iterate responsive email templates for lifecycle, promo, and partner (FFGA) sends.

 - Keep templates consistent with the design system: icons, logo lockups, buttons, and spacing.


COLLATERAL DESIGN

 - Build BD and partner decks, including reusable base templates that partner-specific versions fork from.

 - Produce sales enablement materials and co-branded partner assets (e.g., FFGA x Granted), plus a self-serve asset library reps and HR teams can pull from.

 - Turn around one-off brand and marketing design requests as they come in.


SOCIAL-FIRST VIDEO EDITING

 - Cut UGC and talking-head ads into multiple lengths (e.g., 15s and 30s) and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) for Meta and YouTube.

 - Burn in captions, add B-roll and text reveals, and keep the edit moving so it holds retention through the hook.

 - Version and riff winning ads: new hooks, on-screen insurer callouts, swapped presenters (including AI-generated), and platform re-cuts from existing masters.

 - Build light motion graphics and AI-assisted animation, such as product and explainer sequences (e.g., a bill-scan animation).




🧰 YOU'LL BRING


MUST-HAVES:

 - 3+ years in production or creative design, with a portfolio spanning web, email, and static work.

 - Proficiency in Figma for landing pages and web layouts.

 - Responsive email design in an ESP (Klaviyo, Customer.io http://Customer.io, or similar).

 - Comfort designing to an existing brand system and holding output consistent across formats.

 - Fast, reliable turnaround on high volume; you can read a written brief and run with it.


NICE-TO-HAVES:

 - Social-first video editing in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent — captioning, resizing, and fast multi-cut delivery.

 - Motion graphics or AI-assisted animation experience.


TOOLKIT:

Figma, Adobe Premiere and After Effects (or CapCut), an ESP for email (Klaviyo or Customer.io http://Customer.io), Canva, Linear for briefs and tickets, Slack, and Notion.




✨ YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You get energy from taking a rough brief and shipping the finished thing — the ad cut, the landing page, the email — not just art-directing it

 - You move fast without dropping the details: multiple versions a week, every one on-brand and within the compliance rules

 - You like variety and don’t need to own one polished flagship — you’d rather turn around video, web, email, and decks and see what actually performs

 - You care about the same problem Granted is solving — helping people who are stressed and overwhelmed feel like someone’s actually on their side

We use technology as a tool to bridge the gap between strategy and execution, powered by the knowledge, skills, and the expertise of our teams, who all have unique perspectives and years of experience across multiple industries. What does Blueprint do?

Blueprint helps organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. We connect strategy, business solutions, products, and services to transform and grow companies.

Why Blueprint?

At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. We believe in unique perspectives and build teams of people with diverse skillsets and backgrounds. At Blueprint, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple clients and teams, such as data science and product development, all while learning, growing, and developing new solutions. We guarantee you won’t find a better place to work and thrive than at Blueprint. In This Role

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade collaboration devices and platforms across Windows and Android environments. You will ensure services are secure, reliable, and scalable for global users, troubleshoot complex technical issues, optimize system performance, and drive automation to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. You will play a key role in deploying modern device management solutions, managing endpoints, and leading projects focused on device lifecycle, security hardening, and operational improvements.

• Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise collaboration devices and Windows-based infrastructure.

• Maintain detailed documentation for system configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting guides.

• Lead projects focused on device lifecycle management, Zero Trust security migration, and Windows security hardening.

• Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues across Windows and Android endpoints.

jobs.title: Open Source Engineering Lead for k0s
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Engineering & Team Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and develop a distributed team of engineers working on k0s, k0smotron, and related Kubernetes technologies.
• Establish clear engineering priorities, ownership, and expectations while giving experienced engineers the autonomy to solve difficult problems.
• Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback, support career development, and participate in hiring and onboarding.
• Build an engineering culture based on technical excellence, pragmatism, transparency, collaboration, and ownership.
• Develop additional technical leaders and maintainers so that critical project knowledge and ownership are distributed across the team and community.

Kubernetes Technical & Release Leadership

• Provide technical direction for k0s and related projects while working collaboratively with maintainers and the broader community.
• Participate directly in architecture and design discussions, code and pull-request reviews, issue triage, debugging, and technical decision making.
• Maintain deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, control-plane components, lifecycle management, networking, storage, security, scheduling, and distributed systems.
• Track upstream Kubernetes development and ensure relevant capabilities, architectural changes, deprecations, and requirements are incorporated into the k0s roadmap.
• Drive engineering quality across testing, CI/CD, release engineering, upgradeability, security, observability, performance, and operational reliability.
• Balance architectural improvement and technical debt against features, community needs, ecosystem evolution, and Mirantis product requirements.

Open Source, CNCF & Community Leadership

• Act as a senior maintainer and visible technical leader within the k0s and k0smotron open source communities.
• Partner with the Community Manager and project maintainers to drive k0s through CNCF maturity from Sandbox through Incubation toward Graduation. This includes governance, security, adoption, documentation, maintainer diversity, community health, and CNCF review requirements.
• Grow meaningful participation outside Mirantis by developing contributors into sustained participants and maintainers, cultivating adopters, and strengthening vendor-neutral project governance.
• Serve as a visible technical representative for k0s and k0smotron across the Kubernetes and CNCF ecosystems, including KubeCon + CloudNativeCon, Kubernetes Community Days, SIGs, TAGs, maintainer forums, conferences, workshops, podcasts, webinars, and other technical venues.
• Develop productive relationships with upstream Kubernetes developers, Cluster API maintainers, CNCF projects, vendors, adopters, and other ecosystem participants.

Product & Ecosystem Collaboration

• Work closely with Mirantis product, architecture, field engineering, support, community, and other engineering teams, including those for k0rdent, MOSK, and MKE.
• Translate production experience and customer requirements into well-designed upstream capabilities without compromising sound open source architecture.
• Help determine when capabilities belong in k0s, should be contributed to another upstream project, or should be composed from existing ecosystem technologies.
• Maintain clear architectural relationships among k0s, k0smotron, Cluster API, k0rdent, and the broader Kubernetes ecosystem.
• Serve as a Kubernetes and open source subject-matter expert within Mirantis.

Required

• Significant professional software engineering experience (10+ years desired), including experience leading senior engineers and open source development teams.
• Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, its architecture, control plane, and the underlying Linux, container, networking, storage, and distributed-systems technologies.
• Demonstrated experience designing, building, debugging, or operating Kubernetes infrastructure beyond simply consuming managed Kubernetes services.
• Strong experience with Go and the ability to review and contribute to production-quality Go code.
• Experience working effectively through GitHub-based open source development workflows including issues, pull requests, reviews, CI, releases, and community discussions.
• Demonstrated technical leadership in architecture, design reviews, mentoring, technical decision making, and driving complex engineering work to completion.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Ability to operate effectively in a globally distributed, asynchronous engineering organization.

Strongly Preferred

• Existing maintainer, reviewer, or significant contributor experience in Kubernetes, CNCF, or another substantial open source infrastructure project.
• Experience with Kubernetes Cluster API (CAPI) and Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, or other Kubernetes-native control-plane software.
• Experience with Kubernetes cluster bootstrap, upgrades, lifecycle management, high availability, and conformance testing or certification.
• Deep familiarity with Kubernetes internals such as etcd, containerd, kubelet, API machinery, CNI, and CSI.
• Experience with k0s, k0smotron, or similar Kubernetes distributions and cluster lifecycle technologies.
• Experience managing Kubernetes across bare metal, public cloud, edge, IoT, or heterogeneous infrastructure.
• Familiarity with emerging Kubernetes AI infrastructure requirements including accelerators, scheduling, networking, inference, and AI workload portability.
• Experience with CNCF project governance, maturity reviews, maintainership, or community processes.
• Experience speaking at technical conferences, running workshops, producing technical content, or otherwise representing an open source project publicly.
• Experience with release management, vulnerability response, dependency management, or software supply-chain processes for open source infrastructure.

Why Mirantis

You will have the opportunity to:

• Lead development of a real Kubernetes distribution rather than simply building applications on Kubernetes.
• Work directly with Kubernetes internals and important projects across the cloud-native ecosystem.
• Influence the technical direction of k0s, k0smotron, and the surrounding ecosystems.
• Contribute upstream and participate directly in CNCF and Kubernetes communities.
• Represent the project at major cloud-native conferences and technical forums.
• Solve infrastructure problems spanning cloud, bare metal, edge, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, and large-scale Kubernetes environments.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Professional Services
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



AI traffic is about to outrun API traffic the same way API traffic outran human traffic. Come lead the team that gets enterprises through that transition.

If you don't think you meet every bullet below, apply anyway. Nobody checks every box — we're looking for people who are strong in a few areas and hungry in the rest.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Kong is the connectivity layer of AI. We're a 6-time Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a Forrester Wave Leader, running in production at Fortune 500 scale. Every enterprise moving from “we're piloting AI” to “AI is in production” runs into the same wall: governance, security, and connectivity for a traffic pattern nobody built for. That's the opportunity in front of this team, and it's why Professional Services is one of the fastest-growing parts of this company right now.

We're hiring a Professional Services Manager to lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers across Kong's US Professional Services organization. This is a leadership role, not a delivery role: you're directly responsible for delivery outcomes, staffing, and the growth of the people who sit hands-on with customer engineering teams every day.

You own the full engagement lifecycle for your book of business — staffing the right FDE and Engagement Manager on every account, holding the team to go-live dates and technical quality, and driving resolution personally on the highest-risk or highest-value accounts. You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

We want leaders who've done the implementation work themselves and now want to multiply that impact through a team: coach the engineers, coach the engagement managers, clear the blockers neither of them can clear alone, and build the delivery muscle that lets Kong keep pace with enterprise demand for API and AI connectivity.

You'll work daily with Solutions Architects, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Engineering — scoping engagements correctly before they land on your team, and feeding what you learn in the field straight back into how Kong builds and sells.

This is a rare seat: AI connectivity is a land grab right now, and the person who builds this team's delivery model in the next 18 months owns a track record that doesn't come around twice.


IMPACT

Lead the team that turns Kong's platform into production reality for some of the world's largest enterprises — the ones deciding right now how AI gets governed, secured, and scaled across their business.


GROWTH

Build your leadership craft against the fastest-moving category in enterprise software: AI connectivity, cloud-native architecture, and distributed systems at Fortune 500 scale. Prove out this team's model and the case for more scope writes itself.


OPPORTUNITY

Join a Professional Services organization growing as fast as the AI adoption curve it's built to serve — market-leading credibility behind every conversation you walk into, and a direct hand in building the delivery model while it's still being written.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage and grow a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers — hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

 - Own delivery outcomes across your book of business: go-live dates, technical quality, and customer satisfaction. Report on them with the same rigor you'd demand from your team.

 - Staff the right FDE and Engagement Manager to every engagement based on account complexity, technical scope, and team capacity.

 - Be the senior escalation point on at-risk or high-complexity engagements — drive resolution and direct the team's response personally.

 - Run your team's operating cadence: staffing reviews, at-risk reviews, 1:1s, and status reporting up to Professional Services leadership.

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to scope new engagements accurately and take clean handoffs from pre-sale to delivery.

 - Set and enforce delivery standards across your team — reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that outlive any single engagement.

 - Feed what your team learns in the field back to Kong Product and Engineering — real customer signal shapes our roadmap.

 - Lead your team's work on the strategic initiatives that matter most right now: AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


EXPERIENCE

 - 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, professional services, or platform engineering, including 2+ years directly managing a technical, customer-facing team.

 - A track record of delivery leadership in API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms — deep enough that you can direct and evaluate your team's work, not just review it.

 - Experience managing staffing, capacity, and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise engagements.

 - Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure fluency — enough to unblock your team and hold your own with customer architects and executives.

 - Experience with major cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Comfort directing and evaluating automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling built by your team.

 - Prior experience in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is a strong plus.


PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES

 - A decisive leadership mindset — you make the staffing and prioritization call and drive it to resolution without needing to do the work yourself.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments where the right call today beats the perfect call next week.

 - A genuine passion for growing engineers and engagement managers into their next role — this job is measured in the careers you build, not just the accounts you save.

 - Excellent communication across technical and executive audiences, internal and customer-facing.

 - Highly organized, with strong prioritization and execution across a multi-account portfolio.

 - Real enthusiasm for AI, modern infrastructure, and cloud-native technology — this team is living the shift, not reading about it.

 - A strong sense of ownership for outcomes that aren't always fully in your control — that's the job.



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Manager, Business Development & Brand Partnerships

Location: Greenpoint, Brooklyn

Reports to: Vice President, Brand Partnerships and Business Development at The Lighthouse

The Lighthouse is a first-of-its-kind campus for creators and their teams, with locations in Venice, CA, and Brooklyn, NY.

We are a studio system and creative playground designed for creators to Learn, Make, and Belong—creating a more frictionless path from idea to production to publication.

Our mission is to assemble and inspire the Creator Generation, helping creators build sustainable careers while shaping what's next for the Creator Industry.

Learn more: www.thelighthouse.com.

About the role:

The Lighthouse is looking for an Associate Director, Brand Partnerships to help turn our Creator campuses in Brooklyn and Venice into a marketing platform brands want to buy, not just a venue they rent.

You'll own sales of our turnkey brand activations in the $50,000 to $100,000 range against your own revenue target, and spend around 40% of your time as right hand to our VP, Business Development & Brand Partnerships on larger deals, pitch materials, client communication and post-sale kickoff.

This role is built for someone from media buying, publishing or account management who's ready to move into sales, with hands-on mentorship and a clear path to a full, independent sales role.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Sell and close The Lighthouse's turnkey, off-the-shelf brand activations, mostly one-off events at our Brooklyn and Venice campuses in the $50,000 to $100,000 range, protecting speed and margin.

• Join inbound client calls with the VP, help grow opportunities into larger partnerships, and take ownership of the deals that land below that threshold, keeping your pipeline accurate and up to date.

• Act as the VP's right hand on larger deals, polishing pitch decks, gathering information and getting back to clients quickly when the VP is in back-to-back meetings.

• Share real market feedback to shape our program tiers: what lands, what's priced wrong, and what brands keep asking for

• Support the VP in running and scaling our Creator engine, including Creator casting, briefing, contracting, and payment, and applying our impression and eCPM (effective cost per thousand impressions) methodology to new deals

• Partner with our Creator Intelligence team to run occasional focus groups with Lighthouse members and present what you learn back to brands.

• Build pitch decks and media plans quickly with AI tools, pulling rates from our rate card to produce clear plans by placement, format and channel.

• Lead post-sale kickoff on the deals you and the VP close, making sure everything sold is properly scoped, briefed and handed over to the teams activating it.

• Serve as the point of contact for clients on the deals you own, and support the VP on larger deals, from pre-production and on-site execution through the post-campaign wrap report

• Work with our programming, content, activation and campus teams, including our location GMs, to source themes, concepts and resources for client pitches so every client experiences one Lighthouse.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

• 2–3 years in agency media buying, publishing, account management or integrated marketing, or at a Creator network or influencer platform, and a clear drive to move into sales.

• Experience building media plans or presenting them to clients, including working with rate cards, guaranteed impressions and eCPMs.

• A deep, practical understanding of social media and Creator economics; you're active on Instagram or TikTok yourself and know what Creators want from a brand deal.

• Confidence pitching in client meetings, writing your own pitch materials, and running a focus group and presenting findings.

• Proficiency with AI tools for building decks, media plans and client materials quickly.

• Strong project management skills, so you can hold scope, timelines and handovers across several teams and keep deals on track after they're sold.

• Excitement about building a career in sales, a collaborative approach to working shared deals with your manager, and a desire for hands-on coaching as you grow.

The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $130,000 and serves as a general guideline reflecting the potential compensation for the role. The final salary offer will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of factors such as the candidate's experience, expertise, alignment with the position's requirements, and, ultimately budget approvals. This position will also earn commission on the deals you close.

The Lighthouse provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments and experiences so employees can work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs:

• Medical, Dental, Vision

• PTO + Sick Time + Paid Holidays

• HSA, FSA, and Commuter + Parking Benefits

• Company Paid Life & Disability Insurance

• Voluntary Life Insurance Policy

• Voluntary Hospital and Critical Illness Insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• 401k with Employer Matching. No Vesting Period.

• Monthly Work from Home Stipend

• Yearly Professional Development Stipend

Our values:

At The Lighthouse, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement, it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers.

The Lighthouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Territory Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

About the role

As a Territory Restaurant Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for San Francisco: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

What you’ll do

• Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.

• Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.

• Menu quality. Menus, hero shots, item photos, tags, descriptions, and ratings are your product surface. You curate items that travel well and make sense as a single packed lunch, and eliminate recurring defects: missing photos, broken modifiers, misleading prices, items the kitchen doesn’t make.

• The team. You work with a Bogotá-based team across restaurant sales and onboarding, menu operations, and frontline support (POS, printers, tablets). You set the standards, SLAs, and routing, and improve the systems behind the work

Competencies

• Food-Obsessed Market Expert: Knows the region’s food scene: neighborhood staples, the brands eaters keep asking for, the spot that opened last month that nobody’s covering yet. Can name the five brands we should be chasing off the top of your head.

• Somehow-some-way mentality: Find a path to the signing even when the operator says no, the owner is unreachable, or the kitchen isn’t set up for batch orders. When a brand is a priority, you figure out how to get it on Picnic.

• Data-Literate Operator: Read a lateness report or a cuisine gap analysis and know exactly which restaurant to call. Convert supply and performance data into a clear, actionable plan.

• Builder and Team Leader: Close a partner in the morning and debug a menu modifier in the afternoon. Lead through others across time zones, and treat the same broken menu twice as a process failure, not bad luck.

• Assertive Negotiator: Understand Picnic’s commission structure and restaurant economics. Hold the commission line and still leave the operator feeling like a partner.

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 managing a team

• Background in restaurants, food delivery, marketplaces, hospitality, or supply-side operations

• Experience owning a supply base or partner portfolio, spanning both acquisition and ongoing performance

• Working knowledge of restaurant operations: kitchen workflow, POS systems (Toast, Square, Clover), menu management, ticket flow

• Comfortable with data: lateness reports, dashboards, and Google Sheets should not slow you down

• Spanish is a plus given the team is based in Bogotá

Who you are

• You genuinely love food, and you know your region

• Self-starter who does not wait for a lead list

• Comfortable with ambiguity: the playbook is half-written and you’ll write the rest

• High standards and low tolerance for recurring defects

• You’d rather be in a kitchen than on a call

• Willing to be in the field: facility visits, restaurant walk-ins, tastings

Why join us

• Drive real impact: Be part of building the operational engine behind a fast-growing startup that’s redefining how work gets done.

• Own your city: Take full ownership of your city’s performance and see the direct results of your ideas and execution every single day.

• Work with purpose: Join a mission-driven team focused on making the workplace experience better for thousands of people.

• Grow with us: At Picnic, there’s room to grow—personally and professionally—as we scale and take on new challenges together.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $87,000 - $111,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options).

• Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term).

• Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity.

• Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children.

• Time Off policies:

• Discretionary vacation days

• 8 paid holidays per year

• Paid sick time

• Paid Bereavement leave

• Paid Parental Leave

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. About the Role

The Pipeline Programs Manager turns GitLab's pipeline targets into programs the field can run. You'll own execution of pipeline generation programs, including sales plays, PipeGen days, and run the hygiene checkpoints that keep pipeline data trustworthy. You'll also help surface the risks and upside behind our pipeline plan working across Sales, Marketing, Field Enablement, Sales Strategy, and RevOps.

What You'll Do

• Execute global and regional pipeline generation programs, including codified sales plays and PipeGen days, against an established program calendar.

• Coordinate in-quarter program delivery across regions and segments: timelines, owners, communications, and follow-through on action items.

• Run weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline hygiene checkpoints, and report on adherence and trends with RevOps and Sales Strategy.

• Partner with Marketing and Enablement to bring pipeline generation programs to the field with the right messaging, content, and training.

• Work with the team on the GTM plan by identifying the drivers, risks, and upside that could move the pipeline numbers, and making them visible to decision-makers.

• Give input on the design of sales plays, hygiene standards, and related incentives from what you see during execution.

• Track program performance against success measures, and summarize what worked, what didn't, and what to change next time.

• Coordinate global outbound program execution with Sales Development and sales leaders, and help bring it to regional and team levels at scale.

• Identify process and systems improvements in Salesforce and reporting that increase metric visibility and reduce manual work, and work with RevOps and Systems to land them.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ Years experience in Sales, Sales Programs, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Field or Sales Enablement, or Marketing Operations, with a record of delivering programs on time and with quality.

• Experience running cross-functional programs with operational rigor: multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and clear follow-through.

• Comfort working with pipeline data. You can use Salesforce and BI dashboards to spot gaps and explain what they mean. Basic SQL (Snowflake or similar) is a plus.

• Understanding of the B2B sales funnel: pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, and hygiene.

• Clear communication and presentation skills. You can explain a program or a risk to Sales leaders and to cross-functional partners.

• Ability to influence without authority, earning trust and moving work forward across teams you don't manage.

• Good judgment in a fast-moving environment. You move quickly, keep quality high, and know when to escalate.

• Curiosity about how AI and automation can improve go-to-market execution.

• Ownership mindset. You carry programs through to outcomes, not just activity.

• Experience in a quota-carrying or sales role is a plus.
