Great Hill Solutions, LLC is part of the Seneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. SNG is Seneca Holdings' federal government contracting business that meets mission-critical needs of federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community customers. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

Great Hill is seeking a Facilities Manager SME in Orlando, FL to support the National Cyber Range Complex (NCRC). The Facility Manager will oversee facility operations, space planning, and infrastructure improvement initiatives while supporting mission-critical Department of War cyber testing, training, and operational events.

This position is responsible for coordinating office space projects, managing facility-related equipment and services, reviewing vendor proposals and contractor quotes, and ensuring facilities are maintained to support secure and efficient operations. This position is fully on-site.

Roles and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Assist in preparing and tracking requests and monitoring progress for office space renovations, and reconfiguration and relocation of office equipment and furnishings in support of internal moves.

• Track facilities work requests and provide support to customers, such as assistance with initiation of work requests and determination of work request status.

• Respond to reports of maintenance issues and other problems involving occupation, use, and maintenance of Government occupied facilities and interface with property managers, service contractors, and on-site maintenance personnel to determine the status of and ensure issue and problem resolution.

• Develop revisions to the facility plan based on facility or system modifications and updates.

• Provide technical review of all contractor reports relative to facilities and provide comments and/or recommendations.

• Assist in the evaluation of technical packages submitted by contractors relative to facility requirements and assist in evaluating the acceptability of proposals.

• Provide technical support towards the installation and administration of the Joint Worldwide Intelligence Communications System.

• Identify and analyze all aspects of NCRC Communications Security custodial requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

• Must be a US Citizen and hold a Top-Secret clearance.

• Ability to work closely with government stakeholders, contractors, and service providers to ensure facility requirements are executed on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with organizational and mission objectives.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or other equivalent STEM field from an accredited college or university.

• 5+ years of experience in facility management and coordination.

• Experience working in a government facility.

• Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

Desired Skills:

• Knowledge of the NCRC mission and operations.

• Experience communicating with vendors.

• Experience briefing senior-level government officials on facility status and updates.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Seneca Holdings provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, genetic information and/or predisposing genetic characteristics, victim of domestic violence status, veteran status, or other protected class status. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training. The Company also prohibits retaliation against any employee who exercises his or her rights under applicable anti-discrimination laws. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company does give hiring preference to Seneca or Native individuals. Veterans with expertise in these areas are highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.location: Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

As a Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will help build, operate, and maintain the in-house software behind our digital thread — applications and services that keep product data connected across the product lifecycle and, over time, become the systems of record our teams work in every day. You'll ship real features across the stack from day one and work alongside senior and staff engineers who will invest in your growth.

You will learn the product-data domain — how requirements, design, PLM, ERP, manufacturing, and quality data connect — while contributing directly to delivery and operations. This is a high-growth role in a fast-paced environment where your work has immediate, visible impact.

This is an ideal role for an engineer early in their career or a few years in who is eager to learn, takes ownership, and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced engineers building something foundational. We're hiring at levels I through III; your level will be set based on your experience and interviews.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Build Across the Stack

• Build features across the stack — services, APIs, data models, and web user interfaces — with guidance from senior engineers and growing independence over time.

• Implement data flows, mappings, and workflow automation between our software and the engineering systems we use today.

• Help migrate data and users onto in-house software as it replaces off-the-shelf tools.

• Take on larger pieces of work as you grow — at level III, owning features end to end, from design through production.

Operate & Improve

• Write tests, contribute to code reviews, and help keep our applications and services observable and reliable.

• Help operate our software in production, including monitoring, triage, and resolving user-reported, sync, and data-quality issues.

• Write clear technical documentation and grow your understanding of the engineering ecosystem and digital thread.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Up to ~5 years of software development experience; internships, academic, or equivalent projects count for early-career candidates.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language and a willingness to work in our stack (e.g., Go, TypeScript).

• Understanding of APIs, databases, web application fundamentals, and basic distributed-systems concepts.

• Solid problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn the product-data domain.

• Good written communication and collaboration habits.

• U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience building web applications (e.g., TypeScript, React) through work, internships, coursework, or personal projects.

• Exposure to system integrations, data pipelines, or event-driven services.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), CI/CD, and testing practices.

• Any exposure to PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), requirements/ALM, or MBSE systems.

• Interest in aerospace, defense, or engineering data.

COMPENSATION

• Denver, Colorado Base Salary: $70,000 – $160,000

• Long Beach, California Base Salary: $75,000 – $165,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• This role operates in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment supporting national security space operations, where adaptability and rapid decision-making are essential.

• Participation in an on-call and support rotation may be required as you grow into operating our software in production.

• A supportive, mentorship-driven environment with room to take on increasing ownership.

• Occasional travel to other company sites as needed.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

• Work Location: this role is fully onsite at our facilities in Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA. #LI-Onsite

• Work environment is a standard office setting, working at a desk or on a production factory floor.

• Physical demands may include frequent standing, sitting, walking, bending, and lifting or carrying items up to 20 lbs.

• This position will be open until it is successfully filled.

jobs.title: Senior Wire Cutter
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Wire Cutter to join our Rexel USA team in Denver, CO!

Summary:

The Senior Wire Cutter is responsible for efficiently and accurately fulfilling orders for wire and cable cuts utilizing material handling equipment and wire reeling / coiling machinery. Ensures wire/cable is stored, staged, and cut in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. May be required to fill in for other warehouse roles.

This position's schedule is from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM Monday through Friday. This position has a $1,500 sign on bonus & weekends off!

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment. Follows established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately addresses safety concerns
• Perform daily machine checks and operates any material handling equipment and powered material handling equipment in a safe and efficient manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity
• Retrieve and cut wire efficiently and accurately for requested customer shipments Examines wire for conformance to specifications and removes defective pieces
• Fill all orders efficiently and accurately. Ensures outbound shipments are accurate and free of damage
• Place reel of specified wire onto payout spindle of machine and threads wire through feed rolls. Adjusts machine controls to regulate factors such as wire thickness, pressure, heat, and cutting and stripping length
• Stack/store merchandise in the appropriate area and stages wire cuts in the appropriate shipping area
• Maintain a minimum standard in wire cuts in compliance with current company policies in both accuracy and productivity
• Report any damage to electronic hardware, work machines, or pipe racks immediately to a supervisor
• May be required to perform other job functions within a branch when required including but not limited to counter sales, preparing and filling orders and/or receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material, and maintaining branch equipment
• Mentor and coach junior level team members
• Other duties as assigned

Job Duties Disclaimer:

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

What You'll Need

• 3+ years of wire cutting experience
• Prior warehouse or distribution center experience a plus
• Certification to operate forklift, hand truck, pallet jack and other warehouse equipment preferred. If required to make deliveries:
• Must have a valid driver's license
• Must be at least 21 years of age
• Must pass a pre-employment and annual review of their Motor Vehicle Record
• Must obtain verification of non-expired medical certificate as required by law within 60 days of hire
• Must not have had a suspended drivers’ license for a traffic accident/violation within the past 3 years
• Must not have any at fault accidents in the past 3 years
• High School or GED - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Knowledge of Radio Frequency scanning devices preferred
• Must be willing to be trained on all the following material handling equipment: forklift, stand-up reach truck, High-Reach Narrow-Aisle, Stand-Up Rider pallet Jack that conform to OSHA safety training requirements
• Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers and customers
• Ability to handle moderate issues and problems
• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations to accurately complete job tasks
• Ability to organize and prioritize job tasks and requirements
• Excellent organizational and time management skills
• Ability to meet deadlines
• Ability to work overtime as needed
• Basic computer knowledge

Physical Demands:

• Sit: Must be able to remain in a stationary position - Frequently – 21% to 50%
• Walk: Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location - Constantly – at least 51%
• Use hands to finger, handle, or feel: Operates a computer and other office machinery - Constantly – at least 51%
• Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl: Must be able to crouch down to stock shelves, pick up boxes, or position oneself to maintain computers in the lab/under desks/in server closet - Frequently – 21% to 50%
• Climb or balance: Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder, forklift, pallet jack, or other warehouse equipment - Occasionally – up to 20%
• Talk, hear, taste, smell: Must be able to use senses to effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions - Constantly – at least 51%

Weight and Force Demands:

• Up to 10 pounds - Constantly – at least 51%
• Up to 25 pounds - Constantly – at least 51%
• Up to 50 pounds - Constantly – at least 51%

Working Environment:

• Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environment such as high noise level and/or exposure to heat and cold - Constantly – at least 51%
• Exposed to electrical hazards; risk of electrical shock - Occasionally – up to 20%
• Handles or works with potentially dangerous equipment - Frequently – 21% to 50%
• Travels to offsite locations - Occasionally – up to 20%

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Digital Engineering
jobs.location: Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

True Anomaly designs, sources, and manufactures spacecraft across a landscape of engineering and business systems — PLM, requirements/ALM, MBSE, and ERP — that today do not share a connected flow of product data. As Senior Manager of Digital Engineering, you will own the digital thread that changes this: the authoritative, traceable flow of product data across the entire lifecycle, and the internal platform and in-house software that make it real. Delivering this digital thread is a contractual requirement, so the mandate is concrete and the timeline is externally driven. This is a founding, hands-on leadership role — early on you will build the platform yourself and set its architecture and engineering patterns in code, while you hire and grow the software engineering team behind it, from early-career engineers to staff level, expanding as the mandate grows. As the team matures your hands-on share deliberately gives way to multiplying through others, but you stay close enough to the architecture to lead your engineers on the merits. The platform you build will give engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing one authoritative source of product data instead of manual exports and disconnected tools, with the auditability and traceability an ITAR/CUI environment demands. Integrations connect today's tools, which remain owned and administered by the teams that run them; over time, your team will build in-house systems of record wherever owning the software serves the company better than buying it.

This is a role for a builder who leads — an engineer who never stopped shipping and is energized by developing people and standing up a high-performing function from the ground up. It is not a fit for a pure people-manager who is years out of the code, nor for a senior IC who does not genuinely want to build and grow a team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Development

• Hire, coach, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers, from early-career to staff level.

• Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and support career development and growth planning for direct reports.

• Foster a collaborative, high-ownership culture that thrives under fast-paced, high-stakes conditions.

• Manage on-call and support rotations so the team can keep its software reliable in production.

Hands-On Technical Contribution

• Build early: personally write production code for the platform's core services, integrations, and first applications while the team is small, establishing the architecture and patterns others will extend.

• Stay hands-on as the team grows — through design and code review, prototyping hard problems, and pairing — enough to make sound technical calls and keep the trust of senior engineers.

• Deliberately hand off and multiply: shift work to the team as you hire, avoiding becoming the bottleneck or single point of failure on any critical path.

• Set and uphold the engineering bar for code quality, testing, and technical documentation by example.

Strategy & Program Ownership

• Define and drive the digital thread roadmap across the platform, integrations, in-house applications, and workflow automation — including build-vs-buy decisions for core engineering and business systems, made together with the teams that own them today.

• Balance new platform capability against operational support load, enforcing the discipline to protect roadmap work.

• Run the team's delivery — planning, prioritization, and a predictable release cadence.

• Proactively identify gaps across the program and prioritize resourcing to close them.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, the owners of today's engineering and business systems, IT, Platform Engineering, and Cybersecurity to embed the digital thread into how products are designed, sourced, and built.

• Define clear responsibility boundaries with system owners and shared governance for integration changes, upgrades that affect integrations, access and separation-of-duties, and high-risk production change management.

• Serve as an escalation point for cross-functional questions about product-data flow and integrations.

• Communicate roadmap, delivery status, and risk to technical and executive audiences.

Technical Oversight

• Provide technical guidance and review for major initiatives such as cross-system data architecture, integration patterns, traceability, and platform operations.

• Ensure observability, auditability, sync health, and data quality are built into the platform.

• Support compliance efforts (e.g., CUI/ITAR, auditability) by ensuring the team produces necessary evidence and documentation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years directly managing software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• 8+ years of total experience in software engineering or a related technical field, with substantial and recent time as a hands-on individual contributor — you have built production systems, not just managed people who do.

• Current coding proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., Go, Python) — able to contribute production-quality code, prototype hard problems, and lead code review credibly, especially while the team is small.

• Track record shipping software products or platforms to production on a predictable cadence.

• Demonstrated experience building or maturing one or more of: software platforms, in-house enterprise applications or systems of record, system-integration programs, or workflow automation.

• Strong understanding of cloud and enterprise technologies, API and integration patterns, data modeling, and keeping data consistent across systems of record.

• Proven ability to translate business priorities into technical strategy and communicate it across all levels of an organization.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

• U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience managing teams in a startup, Series C through E, or similarly high-growth environment.

• Experience standing up a new team or function from the ground up.

• Experience leading a migration from an off-the-shelf enterprise system to in-house software.

• Familiarity with PLM, MBSE, requirements/ALM, ERP, and/or manufacturing execution (MES) systems and how product data flows across engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing.

• Background in aerospace, defense, hardware, or another regulated, product-data-intensive environment.

• Experience with digital engineering / digital thread initiatives.

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

COMPENSATION

jobs.title: Behavioral Direct Support Professional / Caregiver
jobs.description:
As a Behavioral Direct Support Professional (DSP) with Dungarvin, you’ll walk alongside people as they work toward their personal goals, build independence, and enjoy the things that matter most to them.

That might mean going shopping, heading to the pool, supporting someone at work, attending a Special Olympics event, getting out into the community, or simply helping someone have a good day.

You’ll build meaningful relationships while providing the individualized support, encouragement, and guidance each person needs to live with dignity, choice, and as much independence as possible.

What You’ll Do

• Provide individualized support to adults with mental health, intellectual and developmental, and/or physical disabilities.

• Support people as they develop skills, pursue personal goals, and participate in their communities.

• Provide encouragement, mentoring, and guidance with daily activities and life skills.

• Help individuals maintain their comfort, safety, dignity, and independence.

• Support daily living activities when needed, which may include mobility, dressing, bathing, personal hygiene, meals, and other personal-care needs depending on the individual.

• Recognize and respond appropriately to behavioral or mental health needs.

• Use a calm, patient, and team-based approach during challenging situations.

• Attend community activities, appointments, social events, recreational activities, and other outings.

• Build positive, respectful relationships with the people we support and your teammates.

• Complete required documentation regarding services, progress, incidents, and important events.

• Complete Dungarvin’s Handle with Care training and other required training to help you safely and effectively support the people in your care.

This Work Can Be Challenging—and Meaningful

Some of the people we support experience significant mental health or behavioral challenges. These may include verbal or physical aggression, emotional distress, or other behaviors that require patience, sound judgment, and effective crisis-management skills.

Some individuals may also have intellectual or developmental disabilities and/or medical needs.

We want candidates to have a realistic understanding of the work. At the same time, you won’t be expected to figure it all out on your own. Training, teamwork, and individualized support plans are an important part of how we provide services.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for people who:

• Are at least 18 years old

• Have a Valid Drivers License (due to transporting persons served)

• Are comfortable driving company vehicles to transport persons served as required

• Some positions / locations may require own personal vehicle and auto-liability insurance based on the role

• Are patient, dependable, and respectful.

• Believe the people we support should have choice and control over their own lives.

• Can remain calm and make sound decisions during challenging situations.

• Communicate effectively and work well as part of a team.

• Are comfortable learning new skills and following individualized support plans.

• Have a sincere interest in supporting people with complex needs.

• A successful background clearance is required as part of the onboarding/employment process

Prior experience in intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental health, behavioral health, psychiatric services, healthcare, corrections/security, or another human-services setting is strongly preferred, but it is not required.

Dungarvin believes that diversity and inclusion make our organization stronger. Together, we're working to create a culture that supports our employees and the people we serve. We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer.

If you’re someone who wants meaningful work, enjoys building relationships, and can see the person—not just the behavior—we’d love to hear from you.

Join Dungarvin and help people live the lives they choose.

The Medical Editor is responsible for a range of editorial services, including medical editing, copyediting, proofreading and claim (fact) checking of digital and print pharmaceutical advertising materials, internal and external presentations and corporate communications. A Medical Editor understands the project lifecycle of pharmaceutical advertising tactics and promotes editorial consistency and FDA compliance during this cycle through the ownership of an assigned brand(s).

The Medical Editor serves as a brand’s main editorial voice and demonstrates how to successfully complete editing, claim checking and submission tasks for a variety of clients and brands. They also play an integral role in creating, maintaining and communicating brand style guidelines.

jobs.title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin

About Us

At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers trillions of requests per month. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare have all web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was recognized by the World Economic Forum as a Technology Pioneer and named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list.

We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us!

About the Department

Marketing builds awareness, drives acquisition, and expands usage by developing innovative, breakthrough campaigns that are delivered through multiple channels, including our website, blog, emails, social media, events, and advertising. Product Marketing plays a central role by partnering throughout the company to deliver customer insights, take new and existing products to market, and develop content that fuels growth campaigns.

About the Role

Technical Product Marketing Manager

Cloudflare is looking for an experienced technical product marketer to join our Cloudflare One (Our SASE/Zero Trust platform) product marketing team. This is a high-impact, results-oriented role, where you will work directly with sales, product management, engineering and marketing to take new solutions to market. You will develop messaging and campaigns that drive acquisition and expansion. The team building these solutions are currently at the leading of AI security for the enterprise and you will be responsible for helping communicate how they work to our audience.

Successful candidates will have a passion for helping organizations improve their security posture and protect their data from cyberattacks. You will have a drive to understand the cloud security market, articulate product details, and elevate our messaging to deliver breakthrough initiatives and standout content. You will enjoy this role if you like working with fast-paced teams, finding creative ways to tell a story, and having autonomy to drive your initiatives.

This role is a part of our global Cloudflare One team which comprises all the roles we need to take our solution to market, such as sales, technical sales and marketing.. This role reports to our Cloudflare One leader.

Responsibilities include:

• Develop messaging and content that drives awareness, evaluation and adoption of our IT and AI security products

• Leveraging AI to do research, build content and automate tasks

• Own go-to-market activities for key cloud security products.

• Acquire deep customer knowledge through market research, customer interviews and segmentation analysis.

• Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive demand for products and solutions.

• Partner with product management and be the voice of the product.

• Create the internal and external facing content to enable our sales team to effectively position and sell Cloudflare’s security services

• Partner with our analyst relations team to establish Cloudflare as a security leader.

• Successfully launch new services to customers and partners.

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in content or product marketing with at least some experience in an IT or security-focused role

• Aptitude and energy for written and verbal communication, especially to technical audiences

• The ability to understand complex security related trends and applicability to the portfolio.

• Experience with building AI harnesses and automating many aspects of your role. (But not someone who relies on AI to do their job)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to effectively influence both internal and external stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

• Ability to manage ambiguity and navigate unforeseen obstacles gracefully.

• Deep curiosity, excellent listening skills ,empathy, and ability to get things done in a collaborative team environment.

• A passion for Cloudflare’s mission and the success of our customers, partners, and community.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Senior Territory Manager, Independent Agency Channel - Saint Louis  MO Territory
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRANCH

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

About the role

Branch’s Senior Territory Manager owns a defined state (or set of states) and grows the volume and quality of business submitted by independent agencies in that territory. You carry a production target and are accountable for hitting it.

This is a relationship-first, feet-on-the-street role: you'll be the face of Branch to agency principals and producers, responsible for building trust, driving adoption of Branch's quoting tools, and coaching agencies toward writing business that fits our appetite.

The role replaces a remote, digitally delivered agency management model with an in-person, field-based one. Your presence in the territory is the product. You set your own call plan, decide where your time is best spent across your agency base, and defend those choices against your number.

The most successful Territory Managers are commercially direct. They are comfortable asking an agency for a commitment and holding them to it. They diagnose why an agency isn’t producing and they reframe objections around total value. They run a disciplined week without anyone telling them where to be and they bring what they hear in the field back to Branch in a form the business can act on.

This role sits at the center of Branch's IA go-to-market strategy and reports to the Director, Territory Management.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own the territory. Build and segment a target agency list OR Manage a segmented target agency list], and decide where your time goes - which relationships to build, which to rebuild, which to prioritize against your production target. You set and iterate on a territory plan; your manager reviews it.

 - Own the number. Carry a production target for bound premium and policy count in your territory. Maintain a pipeline view of appointed agencies, quoting trends, and bound premium by agency. Track against target throughout the period, flag haps early, and adjust your plan to close them.

 - Get in front of agents. Run and log a consistent cadence of in-person agency visits, lunch-and-learns, and local events to build face-to-face relationships with principals and producers.

 - Ask for commitments: Leave priority agency conversations with specific production commitments

 - Pitch Branch effectively. Clearly communicate Branch's frictionless value proposition, appetite, and differentiators and ensure target producers understand Branch’s core value.

 - Drive quality quoting behavior. Educate agencies on Branch's ideal risk profile so the business they quote binds, retains, and performs.

 - Champion staff-first quoting. Train the relevant stakeholders at agencies to quote in Branch's quoting platform before going into a comparative rater.

 - Activate and retain producing agencies. Grow the share of target agencies that produce with consistency, and re-engage those that go quiet.

 - Address objections directly. Regularly address objections agencies and shoppers may have, repositioning Branch as an ideal choice for their business

 - Report back on the ground truth. Transform what you're hearing in-territory - competitive intel, pricing friction, product gaps - into insights that inform broader IA strategy.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to resolve territory-level barriers to production.

How Success Is Measured

 - Growth: Bound premium and policy count from assigned territory, measured against target

 - Quality of business: % of growth against ideal customer profile (bundled home and auto customers with CovA between $400k-$1.2m)

 - Agent activation: % of target agencies actively producing with consistency

Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

 - 5+ years in a quota- or target-carrying field sales role where you owned a defined geography or book of business. Independent agency distribution, territory/field sales, SaaS sales, or a comparable business development role preferred.

 - Demonstrated accountability to a specific production number.

 - Experience influencing the choices of independent professionals; your success depended on people choosing your product/service over alternatives, not on authority over them

 - Existing relationships with independent agencies in the assigned state(s) are helpful

 - Comfort and experience with managing a high-travel, self-directed field schedule

 - Strong in-person presentation and group training skills, with the ability to quickly establish credibility and rapport with agency principals and producers.

 - Consultative selling acumen; able to diagnose why an agency is/isn't producing for Branch and address the actual barriers and opportunities.

 - Demonstrated ability to learn a technical, regulated product well enough to teach it. P&C insurance experience is preferred but not required - we’ll train the product and expect command of underwriting appetite, rating, and agency workflow in the first quarter.

Why join us at Branch?

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

 - Above-market salary - Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.

 - Pay equity and transparency - Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.

 - Remote-first (with perks) - Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.

 - Flexible YouTime - We don’t just let you control your own time off.  We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.

 - Employee stock options - You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.

 - Medical, vision, dental - Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.

 - 401k and contribution matching - Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

What to expect

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

 - Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch  job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.

 - If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com http://ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.

 - The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.

 - We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Automation and Controls Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Automation and Controls Engineer builds bespoke test infrastructure that qualifies spaceflight hardware for orbit. They design, build, and own sophisticated ground support equipment (GSE) and test systems: propulsion test stands, environmental qualification chambers, spacecraft-level integration testing and more! Our stack is modern, including a custom PLC framework and Beckhoff EtherCAT tooling built in-house. They will have a meaningful impact on architecture decisions, and the chance to define standards that will outlast any single program.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain test systems and ground support equipment (GSE) for flight hardware qualification and manufacturing operations.

• Integrate with a wide range of external hardware, including thermal vacuum chambers, ovens, chillers, pressure systems, data acquisition hardware, and precision instrumentation.

• Develop and extend Varda's internal PLC framework and EtherCAT tooling to support evolving program needs.

• Contribute to architecture decisions on real-time control implementation, including evaluation of PLC-based (TwinCAT 3) versus Linux-based approaches for high-frequency control applications.

• Build cabinets, wire panels, and own systems end-to-end from electrical design through commissioning.

• Partner with propulsion, avionics, GNC, and manufacturing teams to deliver test infrastructure that meets their needs on aggressive timelines.

• Champion sustainable engineering practices that enable new engineers to ramp quickly on the tech stack and maintain production systems reliably.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field.

• 5+ years of industry experience in test automation, controls, and/or industrial automation.

• Hands-on experience integrating with industrial hardware over protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus (TCP/RTU), RS-232/485 serial, or similar communication standards.

• Experience with at least one modern PLC ecosystem - ideally Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 with structured text (IEC 61131-3), or a demonstrated eagerness to develop deep expertise there.

• Comfort working across the full stack: designing electrical panels, wiring cabinets, debugging hardware, and writing control software.

• Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities shift, and end-to-end ownership of problems is expected.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Strong intuition for when to use real-time PLC code versus higher-level Python orchestration, and a strong understanding of the tradeoff.

• Experience working with custom or in-house control frameworks, rather than relying solely on vendor-provided stacks.

• Advanced EtherCAT expertise - including DC sync, ENI configuration, master implementation, or driver-level work.

• Production experience with TwinCAT 3, structured text, and the broader IEC 61131-3 language suite.

• Experience designing deterministic, hard real-time control loops with sub-millisecond cycle times.

• Familiarity with time-series data acquisition and visualization tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, or similar platforms.

• Aerospace experience, particularly in spacecraft testing or GSE development.

• Environmental test experience, including TVAC, thermal cycling, and vibration testing.

• Hands-on experience working with high-pressure gas or fluid systems.

• Experience developing propulsion test stands or other complex, multi-subsystem test infrastructure.

• Familiarity with spacecraft qualification standards and associated documentation requirements.

• Experience developing safety-related control systems and evaluating proposed solutions for reducing safety-related risks.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

Benefits

Consider your benefits covered for launch. At Varda, we invest in benefits and perks that support your health, financial well-being, and life beyond work. Benefits vary by position, with packages designed specifically for our regular full-time employees and interns.

Regular Full-Time Positions:

Health & Wellness

• Flexible PTO policy + 12 paid holidays

• 100% company-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for employees and dependents with FSA and employer-matched HSA options

• Voluntary accident, hospital, critical illness, and pet insurance

• $120/month wellness reimbursement for gym and fitness expenses

• 12 weeks of parental leave (with supplemental disability leave for CA mothers)

• Family building, pregnancy, parenting and menopause benefits via Maven Clinic

• Sponsored One Medical memberships for employees and their dependents

Financial & Retirement

• Substantial incentive equity in a fully funded space start-up

• 401(k) retirement plan with 6% employer match (immediately vested)

• $20/pay period cell phone reimbursement

• Relocation support for new hires, if needed

Workplace Experience & Perks

• Fully stocked kitchen with lunch provided daily and dinner provided twice weekly

• Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and mission-success celebrations

• Complimentary EV charging

Intern Positions:

Health & Wellness

Financial

Workplace Experience & Perks

• Fully stocked kitchen with lunch provided daily and dinner provided twice weekly

• Complimentary EV charging

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Paralegal, Mass Tort
jobs.description:
Johnson Law Group is seeking an experienced Paralegal to join our Mass Tort division in our Houston office.

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented legal professional who can independently manage complex casework and litigation-related responsibilities in a fast-paced environment. This role is ideal for an experienced paralegal who demonstrates strong judgment, takes ownership of their work, and is comfortable managing cases and projects with minimal oversight.

The Paralegal II will play an integral role in case progression through advanced legal drafting, state and federal court filings, litigation support, client communication, and case management. This individual will also contribute to team effectiveness through knowledge sharing, quality assurance, and support of junior team members.

What You’ll Do

• Case Management & Litigation Support – Independently manage complex case assignments and litigation-related responsibilities, ensuring deadlines, court requirements, and internal procedures are met.

• Legal Drafting & Document Preparation – Draft, review, and prepare complaints, motions, discovery documents, Plaintiff Profile Forms, and other litigation-related materials.

• State & Federal Filing – Prepare and e-file pleadings and other legal documents in state and federal courts, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable filing requirements and deadlines.

• Case Ownership – Take ownership of assigned cases and projects from execution through completion, proactively identifying next steps and ensuring deliverables remain on track.

• Client Communication – Communicate professionally and effectively with clients, attorneys, and internal partners, providing updates, gathering necessary information, and accurately documenting case-related communications.

• Quality & Compliance – Review work for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with legal, procedural, and firm standards while proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.

• Project & Process Support – Lead or support special projects, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and contribute to the development of efficient and consistent team processes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or Paralegal Certificate

• 3-5 years of legal experience in Mass Tort

• Experience preparing, reviewing, and filing legal documents

• Experience with state and federal court filing and e-filing processes

• Strong understanding of legal documentation, litigation procedures, court requirements, and deadlines

• Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and case management systems

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who can step into the role with a strong foundation in litigation support and independently drive work forward. You’re proactive, dependable, and comfortable navigating complex assignments without requiring significant day-to-day direction. You take pride in the quality of your work, anticipate what needs to happen next, and communicate effectively with clients, attorneys, and team members.

What We Offer

• Professional Development – Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities designed to support continued growth.

• Compensation & Benefits – Competitive compensation and benefits package. Compensation is based on experience, education, and relevant credentials.

• Meaningful & Impactful Work – Help clients navigate complex legal challenges while contributing to litigation that makes an impact nationwide.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
PayIt is a fast-growing GovTech company on a mission to modernize how residents interact and transact with government, improving the customer experience and helping our client agencies more efficiently and effectively achieve their missions. Our easy-to-implement platform consolidates government services and payments into one connected experience and enables our clients to drive resident trust, collect revenue quickly, and redeploy their staff to more important challenges. This innovative approach to government service delivery has garnered significant recognition in both the public and private sectors, including our inclusion in the GovTech 100 every year since 2017. PayIt solutions cover services including hunting and fishing licensing, DMV, courts, property tax, utilities, tolling, and more.

Our culture welcomes people who exhibit what we call “PayIt DNA”: High integrity, drive, grit, high aptitude, and team orientation. We are collaborative and passionate about the work we do to improve the lives of our government clients and the end users they serve. We have ambitious scaling goals, and we look for team members who are ready to roll up their sleeves, solve problems, and find new opportunities to win with our clients. And we have a lot of fun together.

As a People Operations Coordinator, you will be integral to our small but mighty People Team. You will interact with various organizational stakeholders, deliver world-class service to our workforce, and ensure a positive candidate and employee experience.

You will play a crucial role in ensuring that all of our employees have the best possible experience working here. You will work closely with our People Operations team, focusing on the day-to-day execution of various operations and tasks ranging from data entry to process creation. You'll be involved in onboarding, organizational updates, and supporting our distributed workforce.

This role is a hybrid position based out of Kansas City. This position is ideal for someone eager to grow their human resources and talent management career.

What You'll Be Doing:

General Support:

• Serve as the people point of contact for day-to-day people questions and general employee conversations. Support employee inquiries on policy and process matters throughout their employee lifecycle.

• Provide operational support and maintain accurate employee data and files across all systems in accordance with state and federal laws

• Provide administrative support to PayIt’s people processes, including but not limited to new hire onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, offboarding, payroll, compensation, reporting, tax compliance, and workplace experience

• Document people process changes as needed and continually evolve the people and talent tech stack (HRIS, ATS, Team Communications)

• Building out people process workflows at PayIt to continuously improve our business effectiveness. Leverage automation and AI tools (i.e. Claude, Gemini, and GPT) to streamline processes.

• Administer benefits, including open enrollment, 401(k), and leave management

• Support People and Business leaders in performance org design and management

• Maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion in the handling of sensitive information

Program Management:

• Support planning and coordination of PayIt culture events, both virtual and in-person

• Continuously improve processes and programs that improve the employee lifecycle

• Improve the lightweight systems, documentation, and tooling that keep People operations running smoothly

• Manage initiatives like our wellness budget by planning activities, tracking expenses, and evaluating vendors

Talent Operations:

• Support talent and recruiting operations

• Manage job postings across platforms and keep our employer branding strong across our talent channels

What You'll Need:

• 2-3 years of experience, with a preference for experience in a high-growth-phase organization

• A Bachelor's degree in Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, Business, or Communications

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

• Excellent communication skills and familiarity with tools like Google Suite, Slack, and Generative AI tools

• You Could Be a Great Fit If You

• Are detail-oriented, especially when it comes to data quality

• Investigate problems to determine root causes and define robust solutions

• Work independently, managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively

• Are an excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing

• Are team-oriented, with a collaborative approach to solving problems

• Recognize that Sensitive/confidential information must be handled compliantly

• Have experience with the use of HRIS and ATS systems

Bonus Points For:

• Experience working in a SaaS company

• Strong data skills and/or experience building AI solutions

• Previous experience in recruiting or talent acquisition

• Social media content creation experience

This Role May Not Be a Fit If:

• You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity: You prefer well-defined assignments.

• You prefer to work on a narrow scope, a single project, or tasks at one time

• You enjoy repetitive work

Annual Salary Range:

$55,000—$80,000 USD

Why Work For Us:

• Our mission matters. Your work will make life better for our government agency clients and the millions of residents they serve.

• You’ll do some of the best work of your career here. We tackle complex challenges that are interesting to solve, and you’ll grow a ton working at PayIt

• People are our most important resource. Everyone has a voice. Collaboration is our default setting. And we have fun together.

• We #payitforward with our corporate volunteer program, serving the communities where we work and live.

• Competitive salaries, excellent benefits, flexible working arrangements, and all the resources you will need to do your best work.

What We Care About:

We hire high-aptitude, high-integrity people who are great communicators and want to be part of a growing team.

A Note About AI at PayIt
We love AI. We use it every day and encourage our team to find creative, effective ways to put it to work. If you join PayIt, you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. During the interview process, though, we want to hear from you, not a model. Our goal is to understand how you actually think, solve problems, and communicate, so we ask that your live conversations and assessment responses be your own work.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

PayIt is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law.

PayIt is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an email to the People Operations Team and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

NOTE: U.S. Citizens and all those authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. We are unable to provide sponsorship in the United States at this time. PayIt participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here. Canadian Citizens and those authorized to work in Canada without sponsorship are also encouraged to apply.

To all recruitment agencies: PayIt does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers’ alias, PayIt employees or any other company location. PayIt is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Stay Current on PayIt Happenings: Follow Us On LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

jobs.title: Automation and Controls Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Automation and Controls Engineer II builds bespoke test infrastructure that qualifies spaceflight hardware for orbit. They design, build, and own sophisticated ground support equipment (GSE) and test systems: propulsion test stands, environmental qualification chambers, spacecraft-level integration testing and more! Our stack is modern, including a custom PLC framework and Beckhoff EtherCAT tooling built in-house. They will have a meaningful impact on architecture decisions, and the chance to define standards that will outlast any single program.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain test systems and ground support equipment (GSE) for flight hardware qualification and manufacturing operations.

• Integrate with a wide range of external hardware, including thermal vacuum chambers, ovens, chillers, pressure systems, data acquisition hardware, and precision instrumentation.

• Develop and extend Varda's internal PLC framework and EtherCAT tooling to support evolving program needs.

• Contribute to architecture decisions on real-time control implementation, including evaluation of PLC-based (TwinCAT 3) versus Linux-based approaches for high-frequency control applications.

• Build cabinets, wire panels, and own systems end-to-end from electrical design through commissioning.

• Partner with propulsion, avionics, GNC, and manufacturing teams to deliver test infrastructure that meets their needs on aggressive timelines.

• Champion sustainable engineering practices that enable new engineers to ramp quickly on the tech stack and maintain production systems reliably.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field.

• 2+ years of industry experience in test automation, controls, and/or industrial automation.

• Hands-on experience integrating with industrial hardware over protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus (TCP/RTU), RS-232/485 serial, or similar communication standards.

• Experience with at least one modern PLC ecosystem - ideally Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 with structured text (IEC 61131-3), or a demonstrated eagerness to develop deep expertise there.

• Comfort working across the full stack: designing electrical panels, wiring cabinets, debugging hardware, and writing control software.

• Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities shift, and end-to-end ownership of problems is expected.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Strong intuition for when to use real-time PLC code versus higher-level Python orchestration, and a strong understanding of the tradeoff.

• Experience working with custom or in-house control frameworks, rather than relying solely on vendor-provided stacks.

• Advanced EtherCAT expertise - including DC sync, ENI configuration, master implementation, or driver-level work.

• Production experience with TwinCAT 3, structured text, and the broader IEC 61131-3 language suite.

• Experience designing deterministic, hard real-time control loops with sub-millisecond cycle times.

• Familiarity with time-series data acquisition and visualization tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, or similar platforms.

• Aerospace experience, particularly in spacecraft testing or GSE development.

• Environmental test experience, including TVAC, thermal cycling, and vibration testing.

• Hands-on experience working with high-pressure gas or fluid systems.

• Experience developing propulsion test stands or other complex, multi-subsystem test infrastructure.

• Familiarity with spacecraft qualification standards and associated documentation requirements.

• Experience developing safety-related control systems and evaluating proposed solutions for reducing safety-related risks.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Network
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAPE

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.




THE TEAM

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.




THE ROLE:

Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.

You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON:

 - Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally

 - Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors

 - Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations

 - Pressure-test proposed timelines and BD requests for technical feasibility before commitments are made externally

 - Host vendor meetings and hold vendors accountable to their delivery commitments

 - Deconflict priorities and dependencies across the network team and adjacent teams, including consumer-facing projects

 - Translate technical network work for non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requests back into realistic technical asks for engineering

 - Help define the org model for how program management, technical ownership, and execution responsibilities fit together on the network team as it scales


EXPERIENCE:

 - Technical program management experience in a fast-moving engineering environment, ideally at a startup

 - A track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, cross-team work without slowing it down

 - Comfort learning a new technical domain quickly and deeply enough to challenge engineering judgment and assess feasibility, not just track progress

 - Experience building systems for tracking work, surfacing dependencies, and holding owners accountable to deadlines

 - Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical teams and business/vendor stakeholders

 - Comfort engaging directly with external vendors and holding them to their commitments

 - (Bonus) Experience with network or telco infrastructure: traffic routing, cloud connectivity, configuration, or subscriber provisioning

 - (Bonus) Experience at a company building or operating physical/network infrastructure rather than pure software

 - (Bonus) Prior experience supporting consumer products alongside more technical/infrastructure work


COMPENSATION:

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role based in New York, NY is $190,00 - $210,000 depending on level, experience, and interview performance.

Our benefits include:

 - 401(k) match

 - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents

 - 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)

 - Stipends for

 - Family-forming needs

 - Gender-affirming care

 - Unlimited PTO




OUR CULTURE & VALUES

 - We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.

 - We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.

 - We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.

 - We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.
   
   


HOW TO APPLY
