jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant, CEO
jobs.description:
About Sent

Sent is an infrastructure for sending A2P messages across SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS through a single unified API. Our intelligent routing model automates channel selection based on deliverability and cost, ensuring lower cost and global reach without any channel-specific integrations.

We recently closed a $12M Series A backed by Companyon Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, UIF, and others. We’re hiring to build the best infrastructure to replace multi-channel messaging stacks.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a senior executive assistant to work directly alongside our Founder & CEO. You’re someone who can manage a complex calendar, write a clear response, spot a conflict before it becomes a problem, and keep commitments moving without constant direction. You understand that great executive support depends as much on judgment and trust as it does on organization.

You’ll own the day-to-day coordination behind the CEO’s calendar, inbox, meetings, travel, and follow-through. You’ll learn his priorities, protect time for the work that matters most, and make sure he has the context he needs for each conversation. You’ll also build the systems that make this support more reliable as Sent grows.

This is a full-time, in-office role in NYC. Working hours vary with the CEO’s availability and schedule, so you’ll need flexibility as meetings, travel, and priorities change. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the CEO’s calendar end to end. Prioritize requests, protect focus time, resolve conflicts, and plan ahead across internal meetings, customers, candidates, partners, and investors.

 - Manage delegated inbox work. Triage messages, draft responses in the CEO’s voice, handle routine correspondence where authorized, and surface requests that need his attention.

 - Prepare the CEO for meetings. Gather context, confirm agendas and attendees, coordinate materials, and make the decisions and next steps clear.

 - Track commitments and follow-through. Maintain a dependable system for action items, owners, deadlines, and follow-ups so important work doesn’t get dropped.

 - Coordinate business travel and expenses, including bookings, itineraries, meeting logistics, and last-minute changes.

 - Coordinate scheduling, materials readiness, and follow-ups with the people responsible for the substantive content.

 - Assist the CEO in day-to-day coordination with external contacts and other executive offices, with professionalism, discretion, and prompt communication.

 - Own defined operational projects, such as improving meeting preparation, travel processes, or the CEO’s action tracker. Agree on scope and priorities before taking on new work.

 - Handle sensitive information carefully and use sound judgment about what you can resolve independently and what requires escalation.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive in a fast-changing organization, or comparable experience demonstrating the same level of judgment and responsibility.

 - Strong calendar, travel, and executive-support skills. You’re comfortable managing competing requests and changing plans without losing the underlying priority.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. You can draft concise correspondence, match the right tone, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.

 - High agency. You anticipate needs, ask good questions, solve routine problems independently, and close loops without being managed through every step.

 - Discretion and good judgment. You can be trusted with confidential information and know when to act, push back, or escalate.

 - Reliable organization and attention to detail. You build systems people use and follow through on commitments.

 - Lives in NYC with the ability to work in the office five days per week and adapt working hours to the CEO’s schedule.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting a founder or CEO at a venture-backed  company.

 - Experience coordinating board meetings, investor conversations, leadership offsites, or complex executive travel.

 - Experience using AI and automation for appropriate research, organization, or draft preparation, with careful handling of confidential information and human review of outputs.



OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

 - Annual base salary of approximately $100,000–$150,000, depending on experience.

 - Meaningful equity with high growth potential.

 - Top-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage, fully covered.

 - 401(k) with 100% match up to 4%.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Beautiful NYC workspace with daily meals and unlimited snacks.

 - New MacBook Pro + Apple Studio Display.

 - Wellhub Gold or Equinox stipend.

Sent, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Manager, RF Hardware Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
About Eridan

At Eridan we believe in the power of collaboration and communication to achieve our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. That mission is possible with our patented transmitter which decreases the cost and power required to roll out 5G by 10x when deployed globally. This is all facilitated through our offices: our Sunnyvale headquarters has big windows (even in the lab!), is walking distance to downtown and the Caltrain, and fits the entire team in the cafeteria for our frequent company parties. Learn more about our mission here.

About the Role

The Manager of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is a hands-on technical leadership role driving systems engineering for Eridan's radio product lines. This position is ideal for an engineer who wants to stay deeply engaged in RF hardware design—architecture, lab work, and integration—while taking the next step in their career to mentor and manage a small team. You will serve as the engineering owner of system-level specifications, translating customer needs into rigorous deliverables and ensuring seamless alignment across hardware, software, and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Systems Engineering & Hands-On Design

• Own the architecture, integration, and verification for your product scope. Personally engage in lab work (RF debug, board bring-up) and drive the resolution of cross-subsystem technical issues.

Requirements Ownership

• Take full ownership of system-level specifications, serving as the bridge between Solutions Engineering and R&D. Translate operational and customer requirements into rigorous engineering deliverables.

Team Leadership

• Step up to manage and mentor a small team of systems engineers (2 - 3 direct reports), taking ownership of their technical guidance and career development.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Drive hardware-software alignment by clearly translating hardware design decisions into actionable requirements for software/firmware teams, and coordinate with Test and Operations on qualification activities.

Manufacturing & Vendor Ownership

• Define standardized design protocols and conduct thorough internal reviews. Take complete responsibility for production readiness design outcomes, ensuring internal processes set external partners up for success.

Minimum Qualifications

• Education: B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field

• Experience & Leadership: 5+ years in RF systems engineering (at the radio unit, subsystem, or component level) with a strong desire to step into a leadership role and manage a small team

• Hands-on RF Design: End-to-end hardware development experience (schematic to PCB)—featuring circuit-level fluency in transceiver architectures, cellular TDD/FDD systems, layout impedance best practices, and power distribution analysis (not solely system-level oversight)

• Product Lifecycle: Proven track record of navigating the full hardware lifecycle, scaling products from initial conceptual prototypes to robust, high-volume production-ready designs

• Requirements & Integration: Proven ability to translate customer requirements into rigorous engineering deliverables and drive complex hardware/software co-development

• Communication & Assertiveness: Strong communication skills across cross-functional audiences, including the ability to push back and firmly hold a technical position during rigorous systems design meetings

• 5G Radio Hardware: Experience with 5G systems, including O-RAN, small cell, or macro radio architectures

Nice to Have

• Experience at a startup or growth-stage hardware company

• Experience with CU/DU/RU integration

• Strong understanding of communications theory

• Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, C#, MATLAB) for automation and testing

• Familiarity with 3GPP specifications

• Hands-on experience with advanced lab testing equipment (e.g., VNAs, spectrum analyzers)

Perks of working at Eridan

• Work on new technology that will make a significant impact on global infrastructure

• Ability to learn, develop, and advance within a flexible environment

• Collaborate with smart, passionate, and helpful co-workers

• Celebrate progress company-wide

• Pre-IPO equity

• 401K with automatic match

• Health, Vision and Dental insurance

Salary Range

Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $160,000 and $190,000 plus stock options and benefits.

Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Producer
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales Creative Group, part of Rock Studios, is an industry-leading, award-winning team that develops groundbreaking creative campaigns and premium marketing experiences for the world’s most influential brands. We partner closely with advertisers to deliver custom, multi-platform solutions that leverage the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic content, talent, intellectual property and audiences across linear, streaming, digital, social and live experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Executive Producer to serve as one of the senior production leaders within Rock Studios. You will oversee a significant slate of advertising and marketing productions, partnering with creative, sales, clients and internal business teams to bring ambitious ideas from concept through final delivery.

As an ideal candidate, you will have deep production expertise with strategic leadership, strong creative instincts and exceptional business judgment. You'll need extensive experience producing integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets, timelines and production models and be equally comfortable developing a production approach, negotiating a major production bid, finding smart solutions within limited resources, advising senior stakeholders, managing high-profile talent, leading a set, and solving problems when the unexpected happens.

This is both a hands-on Executive Producer and senior leadership role. You will directly oversee marquee projects while mentoring production teams, strengthening external partnerships and helping evolve how Rock Studios approaches production at scale.

This position reports directly to the Vice President, Production & Operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as Executive Producer across a diverse portfolio of advertising, branded content and integrated marketing initiatives—from lean, fast-turn assignments to complex marquee productions—overseeing work from early creative development and scoping through production, post-production and final delivery.
• Partner closely with creative teams to evaluate concepts for feasibility, identify the strongest production approach and translate ambitious ideas into exceptional, executable work while protecting the creative intent.
• Lead production across a broad range of formats, including custom branded content, digital and social campaigns, talent-led content, original branded entertainment series.
• Own the production strategy for assigned campaigns, including production methodology, schedules, budgets, staffing models, vendor strategy, risk assessment and contingency planning.
• Develop and manage production budgets and estimates across a wide range of scales; oversee competitive bidding, bid leveling, vendor negotiations, cost reporting, change management and final reconciliation while maximizing creative value within available resources.
• Lead director, production company and key vendor searches; identify and negotiate with the right creative and production partners for each assignment while maintaining a strong external network of directors, producers, crews, studios and post-production partners.
• Oversee all phases of production and post-production, including pre-production, casting, locations, talent, crew, technical planning, on-set execution, editorial, motion graphics, VFX, music, sound, color, finishing, versioning and final delivery.
• Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Music Services, Talent Relations and other internal teams to ensure productions meet NBCUniversal standards and business requirements.
• Maintain strong working knowledge of production contracts, rights and clearances, music licensing, releases, insurance, labor requirements and applicable union and guild considerations.
• Serve as a trusted senior production partner to internal stakeholders, clients and agencies, helping teams understand production implications, solve challenges and establish realistic scopes, budgets and timelines.
• Participate in the development and pitching of major opportunities when production strategy, feasibility, budgeting or executional expertise is required.
• Build trusted relationships across NBCUniversal and with clients, agencies and external partners, representing Rock Studios with credibility and authority in senior-level conversations.
• Oversee and mentor producers and freelance production teams, establishing clear expectations and helping develop the next generation of production leaders.
• Partner with the Vice President, Production & Operations on resource planning, production forecasting, staffing strategy, vendor strategy and allocation of production resources across the broader slate.
• Help evolve Rock Studios’ production organization by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, methodologies and infrastructure while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative ambition and responsible financial stewardship.
• Proactively assess creative, financial, logistical, legal and reputational risk and develop solutions before those risks affect the work.

Requirements

• Deep expertise in advertising and marketing production, with significant experience leading multi-platform campaigns across a range of scales and budgets—from lean, fast-turn productions to complex, high-budget work.
• Extensive experience working within an advertising agency, creative agency, production company, brand studio, entertainment marketing organization or comparable creative production environment.
• Ability to operate simultaneously as a strategic production leader and hands-on Executive Producer, leading multiple concurrent productions while maintaining command of creative, financial and logistical details.
• Exceptional understanding of physical production and post-production workflows across live action, editorial, VFX, motion design, music, audio and finishing.
• Strong command of production finance, including estimating, bidding, negotiating, cost management, forecasting and reconciliation, with the ability to maximize production value at varying budget levels.
• Extensive experience managing directors, production companies, freelance producers, crews and post-production partners.
• Strong knowledge of production business affairs, talent agreements, music and footage licensing, releases, rights and clearances, union and guild requirements and other production-related legal considerations.
• Proven experience producing with celebrity or high-profile talent and managing sensitive, high-stakes productions.
• Strong creative judgment with the ability to contribute meaningfully to creative conversations while understanding the distinction between creative leadership and production leadership.
• Exceptional business judgment, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance creative ambition, client objectives, production realities and financial responsibility while working with senior executives, clients, creative leaders and external partners.
• Ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions quickly and remain calm, pragmatic and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments.
• Strong leadership and mentorship skills with experience developing producers and building high-performing production teams.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
• 12+ years of professional production experience, including substantial experience in advertising, branded content, marketing or agency production.
• Significant experience serving as an Executive Producer or equivalent senior production leader on integrated advertising and marketing campaigns.
• Proven track record of delivering complex productions on time, on budget and at a consistently high creative standard.
• Experience managing production budgets of varying scale and complexity and negotiating with production companies, vendors and creative partners.
• Willingness to travel and work outside traditional business hours when productions require it.

Desired Characteristics

• Experience within a leading advertising agency, creative agency, entertainment company, network, streamer or sophisticated in-house brand studio.
• Experience with both traditional advertising production and emerging formats across streaming, digital, social, experiential and creator-led content.
• A deep and current network of directors, production companies, producers, crews and post-production partners.
• A reputation for being an excellent partner to creative teams -- someone who finds ways to make ambitious ideas happen rather than simply identifying limitations.
• Strong executive presence paired with a low-ego, collaborative leadership style.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in an environment where the work, technology and production models continue to evolve.
• Passion for outstanding creative work and a track record of building the teams and production environments required to achieve it.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $130,000 - $165,000 + sales incentive compensation eligible

jobs.title: Sr. Construction Engineer
jobs.description:
Axogen is committed to building and maintaining a strong and gratifying company culture that fosters professional growth. Our hands-on and personal approach makes transitioning to a new job a seamless and enjoyable process. Most benefits are effective on day one!

Axogen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Why you’ll love working at Axogen:

• Friendly, open, and fun team culture that values unique perspectives

• Company-wide dedication to profoundly impacting patients’ lives

• Comprehensive, high-quality benefits package effective on date of hire

• Educational assistance available for all employees

• Matching 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays, including floating holidays, to be used at your discretion

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Referral incentive program

Axogen Mission and Business Purpose

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by making restoration of peripheral nerve function an expected standard of care. We aim to lead the markets we serve by always requiring the solutions we offer patients and caregivers provide an improved benefit-to-risk profile as compared to existing standards of care. To ensure we deliver improved benefit-to-risk solutions, we will guide and expect the market and design requirement specifications underlying our engineering, business development, and clinical research activities, objectively target advancements in standards of care.

Job Summary of the Sr. Construction Engineer

The Sr. Construction Engineer is responsible for coordinating and overseeing capital construction projects to ensure they are executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable codes, regulations, GMP requirements, and quality standards. This position serves as a technical resource during all phases of construction, collaborating with project managers, contractors, architects, engineers, operations, quality, EH&S, and facility teams to resolve engineering and construction challenges while ensuring successful project delivery.

Requirements of the Sr. Construction Engineer

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction engineering, construction management, or a related engineering discipline.

• Minimum of 5 years of construction engineering, project engineering, or related experience preferably in a regulated industry such as medical devices, biologics, tissue-based products, or pharmaceuticals.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects of varying size, complexity, and lifecycle stage.

• Knowledge of design and construction process and methods, materials, engineering principles, and project management practices.

• Knowledge of GMP regulations, commissioning and qualification practices, and change management processes within regulated manufacturing environments.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.

• Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office).

• Experience with engineering and construction software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Primavera P6, Bluebeam

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

• OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification (preferred).

• Physical Requirements:

• Ability to walk, stand, climb ladders, and navigate active construction sites for extended periods.

• Ability to perform field inspections in various weather conditions.

• Capability to bend, kneel, crouch, and access confined or elevated work areas when required.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally.

• Visual acuity sufficient to review construction drawings, inspect work quality, and operate standard office equipment.

• Ability to travel between project sites as required.

Responsibilities of the Sr. Construction Engineer

The specific duties of the Sr. Construction Engineer include but are not limited to:

• Provide engineering support for capital construction projects from conceptual planning through commissioning and project closeout.

• Review project designs, drawings, specifications, and construction documents for accuracy, constructability, GMP compliance, potential utility impacts, and adherence to applicable engineering standards

• Identify impacts to facility utilities and coordinate with facility maintenance team to develop and execute required modifications, outages, and mitigation plans.

• Collaborate with project managers, architects, contractors, subcontractors, Operations, Quality, EH&S, and regulatory agencies to define project requirements, scope, schedules, and execution strategies.

• Support change control processes, impact assessments, and documentation associated with facility modifications in regulated manufacturing environments.

• Coordinate construction activities within active manufacturing environments while minimizing operational disruptions and maintaining compliance with quality and regulatory standards.

• Monitor project scope, schedule, budget and resource; communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders.

• Conduct site inspections to verify work quality, safety compliance, and adherence to approved designs and specifications; identify and resolve technical issues, construction conflicts, and field design changes.

• Prepare and manage engineering documentation, RFIs, submittals, design revisions, and construction records.

• Support procurement activities through review of material specifications and evaluating contractor proposals.

• Ensure construction activities and methods comply with GMP requirements, local, state, and federal codes, environmental regulations, and applicable site safety and quality procedures.

• Promote a culture of safety, quality, operational excellence and continuous improvement across all project activities.

Working & Environmental Conditions

• Combination of office and field-based work environments.

• Regular exposure to active construction sites, including varying weather conditions, dust, noise, and uneven terrain.

• Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, and high-visibility clothing.

• Occasional evening, weekend, or extended work hours may be required to support project schedules and deadlines.

• Compliance with all company safety policies, site-specific requirements, and applicable regulatory standards is mandatory.

Location

913 Industrial Drive Place, Vandalia, OH  45377

#LI-AC1

Benefits/Compensation

This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits offered for this position include Health, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Paid Time Off, 9 Paid Holidays + 3 Floating Holidays, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Medical Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Caregiver Leave, Basic Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Disability Insurance, as described in more detail in summary plan descriptions.

Salary Range

$95,000—$115,000 USD

Company Statements

Axogen follows healthcare system guidelines with respect to credentialing, vaccinations and other employment/compliance related requirements, as well as CDC guidance. Axogen reserves the right to amend its policies from time to time in its sole discretion.

As AI is becoming a common tool throughout the application process, we want to be clear about its appropriate use at Axogen. Using AI to support resume writing, research or interview preparation is perfectly acceptable, provided the content is accurate and genuinely represents your qualifications and skills. For other key parts of your interview process, however, it is important that the ideas, communication, and work you share reflect your own voice, experiences, and thinking. This approach ensures fairness, celebrates your individuality, and allows your authentic perspective to shine. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to learning about the unique contributions only you can bring to Axogen.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Manager, US Growth
jobs.description:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

__________________

Senior/Staff Product Manager, US Growth



About the Role

Back Market's mission is to make refurbished tech the obvious choice — and the US is one of our most strategic bets to prove it at scale.

As a Senior / Staff Product Manager for US Growth, you will own the product strategy for the American market. You are the thought leader and strategic authority on how the Back Market wins in the US: you define what matters, why it matters, and make it happen with the team.

You'll drive transformational, multi-domain initiatives (customer, seller, after sales, data etc) that require both deep US market expertise and the ability to navigate a globally-distributed product organization. You will be Back Market's strongest advocate for the US consumer and sellers — influencing product direction across the company and building frameworks that help every team make better decisions for the American market.

You will report to the Head of Product (based in Europe), with a dotted line to the US Director of Marketing for local mentoring and business alignment. The role is based in our New York office, where you’ll be embedded in the local business team while partnering with product, engineering, and data colleagues across EU, UK, and APAC on a daily basis.

This role sits within the US Leadership Group based locally in the NYC office, giving you a direct seat at the table to shape the American market strategy alongside the local business, marketing, and commercial leaders.



Your Mission

 - Champion the US market within the global organization by developing an authoritative understanding of US consumers, sellers, and the local refurbished tech ecosystem.

 - Shape and sustain a powerful multi-quarter US product vision informed by competitive intelligence, market trends, and customer insights.

 - Identify and validate unique, emerging growth opportunities tailored specifically to the US market that are positioned for our team to own. From initial discovery through rollout and subsequent iteration, orchestrating alignment across engineering, data, supply, marketing, and operations.

 - Turn strategic vision into an actionable, prioritized roadmap backed by strong business cases and thoughtful trade-offs.

 - Drive high-stakes initiatives from Promote cross-functional synergy by identifying leverage points between global roadmaps and US priorities to advocate for mutual value.

 - Formulate clear success metrics and establish robust tracking to evaluate performance and rapidly pivot when needed.

 - Establish scalable frameworks and best practices that elevate product execution standards across the broader organization.



You're the Right Fit If

You have 6+ years of Product Management experience, with a proven track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder product strategies in consumer tech, marketplace, or e-commerce.

 - You have deep US market expertise. You understand the US consumer, the US tech ecosystem, and what makes this market structurally different from Europe.

 - You've driven transformational, cross-functional initiatives at a domain level (not just squad-level features) delivering outcomes that shaped company strategy.

 - You influence without authority: you can make a compelling case to stakeholders and leaders across geographies and turn them into allies.

 - You are a craft-obsessed product builder. You have rigor in discovery, are precise in requirements, are relentless in iteration.

 - You are comfortable with structural ambiguity: regional teams within global orgs are inherently complex. You don't need a clean org chart to make progress.

 - You are willing to work from our Union Square office (NYC) at least 3 days a week.



Why Back Market

 - A clear mission with real stakes: reducing e-waste by making refurbished tech the default choice. The US is central to making that happen at a global scale.

 - Real ownership from day one: you set the agenda, take proactive actions to ensure success, and build the team's credibility through your work.

 - A culture that values depth: The IC track at Back Market exists because some of the most important work comes from individual contributors who go deep and stay hands-on.

 - An international company that is genuinely building for the US, not just translating European success.

 - Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is designed to provide a well-rounded view of the role, the team, and Back Market. Candidates can expect the following conversations, all conducted via Google Meet:

 - Introductory Conversation with the Director of People, US: 30 to 45 minutes

 - Leadership Interview: 60 minutes, focused on project management, collaboration, and soft skills

 - Role Discussion and Live Case Study: 60 minutes, including a discussion focused on the role and a live case exercise

 - Cross-Functional Stakeholder Interview: 60 minutes to discuss your approach to cross-functional collaboration and give you the opportunity to meet potential partners and peers from across the organization

 - Back Market Values Interview: 45 minutes with two cross-functional leaders. This conversation is centered on getting to know the experiences and values that make you who you are, exploring how they align with what we are building at Back Market, and giving you another opportunity to learn about our culture and assess whether it feels like the right fit for you



Back Market is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

__________________


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Enterprise Analyst L1

Our passion for innovation and commitment to excellence fuel the success of our diverse portfolio—from cable networks to digital platforms in news, sports, and entertainment. We take pride in everything we create and represent, and that pride is what makes us uniquely Versant. Here, you’re empowered to build the extraordinary. Come join us.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Biostatistics
jobs.description:
About Us

Kardigan is a heart health company working to make cardiovascular disease preventable, curable and no longer the leading cause of death in the world.

It is Kardigan’s mission to develop multiple targeted treatments in parallel that bring people with cardiovascular diseases to the cures they deserve.

Led by Tassos Gianakakos, Jay Edelberg, M.D., Ph.D., and Bob McDowell, Ph.D., Kardigan’s co-founders have reunited after leading MyoKardia to discover and develop mavacamten, the first cardiac myosin inhibitor, resulting in an acquisition by Bristol Myers Squibb in 2020.

We have a cutting-edge discovery and translational research platform, a pipeline of late-stage candidates, and an industry-leading team that is driven to improve the lives of patients.

At Kardigan, we are motivated by our values which guide how we work, interact, and achieve our goals. Driven by patients and their families, we are deeply committed to improving the lives of patients and prioritizing their needs above all else. We believe in being authentic—leading with truth to bring out the best in others by creating an environment where every person knows they will be fully accepted. With an eagerness to learn, we encourage the highest levels of curiosity and are open to changing our minds. We are committed to winning as a team with urgency, excellence, and intention, and support each other no matter what role we play or where we sit. Lastly, we strive to enable the impossible because patients are counting on us. We are not afraid to take risks to unlock innovation and advance scientific discoveries.

These values are the foundation of our work, empowering us to make a real difference, every day.

Senior Director, Biostatistics

Level: Senior Director

Hiring Manager: Executive Director, Head of Biostatistics

Location: Princeton, NJ

Classification: Hybrid – On-site 4 days per week (Mon to Thurs)

Travel: As needed, up to 15%

About the Team

Kardigan’s Biometrics organization is the analytical backbone of our development portfolio. Working closely with Clinical Development, Medical, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, and Data Management, the team shapes how our studies are designed, how evidence is generated, and how results are interpreted and communicated to health authorities. Biostatistics is a scientific partner in program strategy, not a downstream delivery function.

We are building a team that pairs methodological depth with practical judgment and a strong sense of ownership. Team members have the opportunity to influence trial design and development decisions early, apply innovative analytical approaches in a regulatory context, and help establish the standards and ways of working that will carry Kardigan through multiple registration-directed programs. Our work helps Kardigan move with urgency while safeguarding scientific and analytical integrity, ultimately supporting our mission to bring potentially transformative treatments to people living with cardiovascular disease.

Job Overview

Kardigan is seeking a Senior Director, Biostatistics to serve as the lead statistician for one or more of our late- stage cardiovascular development programs. Reporting to the Executive Director, Head of Biostatistics, this individual owns the statistical strategy and analytical deliverables for their assigned programs, from study design through analysis, reporting, and submission support.

This is a hands-on scientific leadership role. The Senior Director is expected to bring methodological rigor and sound judgment to program design questions, to represent Biostatistics credibly on cross-functional program teams, and to serve as a statistical contributor in health authority interactions in partnership with the Head of Biostatistics. The role carries people leadership responsibility for the statisticians supporting assigned programs, along with oversight of the CRO and vendor statistical work those programs depend on.

The ideal candidate has meaningful late-phase experience — study design through analysis and submission deliverables — and is comfortable operating with a high degree of independence in a small, fast-moving company while escalating and aligning on significant methodological and regulatory positions with the Head of Biostatistics.

Main Responsibilities

• Serve as the lead statistician for one or more late-stage cardiovascular development programs, owning the statistical strategy and analytical deliverables for those programs under the direction of the Head of Biostatistics.

• Contribute to clinical development strategy by informing study design, endpoint selection, estimand frameworks, sample size and power considerations, and evidence-generation plans from protocol concept through submission.

• Author, review, and own core statistical documents for assigned programs, including statistical sections of protocols, statistical analysis plans, randomization specifications, and the statistical content of clinical study reports.

• Prepare statistical content supporting interactions with the FDA and other health authorities — including briefing package sections, meeting preparation materials, and responses to agency queries — and participate in those interactions alongside the Head of Biostatistics.

• Apply late-phase statistical methodology relevant to Kardigan’s programs, including responder and subgroup analyses, adaptive design elements, Bayesian approaches, multiplicity control, and missing data strategies, and recommend approaches that are both scientifically sound and regulatorily credible.

• Serve as the statistical partner to Clinical Development, Medical, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, and Data Management, providing data-driven input on trial feasibility, statistical risk, and program-level decisions.

• Manage, mentor, and develop the biostatisticians supporting assigned programs, providing technical review, coaching, and career development.

• Oversee statistical work performed by CROs and external partners for assigned programs, maintaining scientific ownership and accountability for the quality, timeliness, and integrity of all deliverables.

• Support data monitoring committee activities, interim analyses, and unblinding procedures for assigned programs in accordance with applicable SOPs and regulatory guidelines.

• Contribute to the development and adoption of statistical standards, governance, quality systems, and submission-ready processes established across the Biostatistics function, and support inspection readiness.

• Provide statistical input to evidence-generation, publication, and business development or due diligence activities as needed.

About You

Basic Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline, or a Master’s degree in a comparable discipline with commensurate additional experience.

• 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology drug development with a Ph.D., or 13+ years with a Master’s degree, including substantial late-phase program experience.

• Experience contributing to at least one NDA, BLA, or MAA submission, with direct responsibility for statistical deliverables supporting that submission.

• Experience preparing statistical content for health authority interactions, including briefing documents and responses to regulatory queries.

• Strong working knowledge of late-phase statistical methodology, including estimand frameworks, multiplicity control, missing data approaches, and responder or subgroup analysis.

• Working knowledge of Bayesian methods and simulation-based design evaluation.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and to influence program decisions through scientific expertise, credibility, and clarity of judgment.

• Experience mentoring or managing statisticians.

• Proficiency in SAS and/or R.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical concepts for clinical, medical, regulatory, and cross-functional audiences.

• Experience working in an environment where knowledge of and adherence to SOPs and regulatory guidelines are required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Cardiovascular or cardiometabolic clinical development experience.

• Experience with biomarker-driven trial design and responder subgroup methodology in a regulatory context.

• Hands-on experience implementing adaptive or group sequential designs.

• Familiarity with real-world data and observational study methodology, including approaches to defining or refining target patient populations.

• Working knowledge of CDISC standards (SDTM and ADaM) and submission dataset requirements.

• External scientific presence through publications, conference presentations, or professional society involvement.

• Prior experience in a small, fast-paced, high-growth biotechnology company.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CANALS

Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.

We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 100 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.


THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at Canals, you'll play a central role in shaping the future of distribution through AI-powered products. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and company leadership to turn complex operational challenges into intuitive, high-impact product experiences.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll work across multiple product areas, from core workflows to entirely new capabilities, taking ideas from early exploration through launch and continuous iteration. You'll help shape AI-powered product experiences, designing workflows that help users make smarter decisions and accomplish more with less manual effort.

We're looking for someone who's comfortable with ambiguity, driven by impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape the future of our product while helping design evolve as the company grows.  Our ideal candidate has great product thinking - driven to understand the nuance of a customer's need and deliver an elegant solution.

The tools you use matter. The way you think and make decisions matters more.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the end-to-end design of new products and features, bringing clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges.

 - Work across multiple product areas, balancing shifting priorities while making informed decisions and moving quickly.

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to define problems, shape solutions, and drive products from concept to launch.

 - Get involved early, when problems are still messy and directions aren't set, and shape the conversation, not just respond to it.

 - Prototype ideas, test assumptions, and iterate based on customer feedback and product data.

 - Balance long-term product vision with fast-paced execution, making thoughtful tradeoffs as priorities evolve.

 - Raise the bar for the overall product experience while contributing to the evolution of our design system.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience designing complex B2B SaaS products, ideally involving operational workflows, data-rich experiences, or AI-powered products.

 - A portfolio that demonstrates how you think: framing complex problems and translating them into intuitive, user-centered products.

 - Strong product thinking and the ability to connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes.

 - Exceptional attention to detail, with the judgment to know which details matter most.

 - Confidence to advocate for your ideas, challenge assumptions, and influence product decisions while remaining open to feedback and new perspectives.

 - A curious mindset and a desire to explore how AI and emerging technologies can improve real customer workflows.
   
   


WHY JOIN CANALS

We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.

We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.

You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.

We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.

We're remote-first, flexible, and distributed across North and South America, bringing together talented people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

El GPD Support Officer asistirá en el proceso de despliegue e implementación de productos para el sitio de producción, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los oficiales de GPD en la planta para garantizar la configuración oportuna y eficiente de los productos para el primer pedido (first order readiness). Desempeña un rol clave en la facilitación de las comunicaciones internas y en el apoyo a proyectos e iniciativas de respuesta rápida, orientados a elevar las marcas de nuestros clientes y asegurar la mejora continua interna. Esta posición brinda principalmente asistencia interna con el objetivo de impulsar la agilidad y la simplificación.

ACTIVIDADES REPRESENTATIVAS:

Las actividades y funciones pueden variar según el área funcional asignada e incluir, entre otras:

• Apoyar los esfuerzos de reingeniería en colaboración con los equipos de Ingeniería, Cadena de Suministro y Calidad.
• Garantizar que el equipo local de manufactura reciba todos los elementos necesarios para lograr un proceso de producción eficiente y de calidad (lean production) (especificaciones, estándares de color e instrucciones de trabajo).
• Administrar las órdenes de ensayo, muestreo de productos y pedidos de prueba.
• Apoyar al área de producción en la resolución de problemas durante los primeros pedidos y en las etapas posteriores al despliegue.
• Brindar soporte de configuración e implementación a los oficiales de GPD.
• Facilitar apoyo directo en planta para proyectos especiales o muestras que requieran atención adicional en el área de producción.
• Asistir en la actualización de proyectos de precios.
• Apoyar a los equipos internos en el análisis de materia prima para cambios de sustitución de especificaciones globales a locales.
• Crear requisiciones para troqueles, muestras y artículos diversos.
• Dar de alta nuevas materias primas y otros artículos de compra en el sistema ERP.
• Apoyar las etapas de pruebas de laboratorio.
• Mantener actualizada la base de datos de troquelado.

• Inglés intermedio: Capacidad para redactar correos electrónicos y sostener conversaciones de negocios.
• Educación: Estudiante en curso de Ingeniería Industrial (preferible, más no indispensable) o carreras afines.
• Experiencia: Nivel inicial (entry level), de 0 a 1 año de experiencia en desarrollo de productos, servicio al cliente o áreas de producción.

Habilidades y Conocimientos:

• Pensamiento analítico: Capacidad analítica para el desarrollo de planes de trabajo (roadmaps) y la resolución de problemas numéricos.
• Atención al detalle: Habilidad para organizar información de manera minuciosa y estructurada; facilidad para gestionar situaciones multifuncionales.
• Conocimiento de la industria: Deseable conocimiento en la industria textil/confección (Apparel Industry), sus productos y aplicaciones.
• Herramientas informáticas: Deseable dominio de herramientas de Microsoft Office y G-Suite.
• Habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, con una mentalidad orientada al trabajo en equipo.
• Relaciones de trabajo: Capacidad para construir relaciones laborales sólidas con equipos internos.
• Aptitud técnica: Sólida aptitud técnica.
• Trabajo colaborativo: Capacidad demostrada para trabajar de manera colaborativa en entornos de trabajo dinámicos y de alto ritmo.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Planning | United States | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana’s GTM organization is looking for a Director, Strategy & Planning. Reporting to our VP of Revenue Operations, you will work with a cross-functional team of stakeholders to define growth strategies, provide insights to business performance, and set the standard for data- driven decision making in GTM. Success in this role requires deep experience with consumption-based SaaS. You'll understand how customer adoption and usage translate into revenue over time, and use that understanding to guide GTM capacity, productivity, and investment decisions across Sales, SE, CX, SDR, and Partners. This is a hands-on leadership role with ownership of the planning agenda and the models behind it.

What you'll be doing:

• Establish standard reports and tools to analyze business performance, help set operational targets, and drive planning processes with the Go-To-Market Operations team

• Lead annual and long-range GTM planning, aligning revenue targets with hiring plans, territory coverage, and productivity assumptions

• Develop revenue and capacity scenarios that account for usage variability, customer adoption, and expansion or contraction across cohorts, segments, and regions.

• Work with Global and Regional Sales and Services leaders to evaluate strategic opportunities and/or transformational initiatives; New market evaluation, M&A integration, vertical planning, pricing, etc.

• Become an expert in how our GTM data is captured, how it ties to underlying business processes, and how it impacts key metrics and reports.

• Identify operational gaps in our reporting capabilities and/or inefficiencies in the planning process. Work with Analytics and Business Systems teams to build scalable solutions.

• Help create the connective tissue across our internal stakeholders: Revenue Operations, Marketing, Finance, Data, and GTM leadership

• Build scalable, self-service planning processes that improve consistency and reduce manual coordination across teams.

• Advise GTM leadership on market segmentation, vertical performance, pricing scenarios, and territory strategy, presenting clear recommendations and tradeoffs.

• Partner with Finance to align consumption-based revenue scenarios with workforce budgets and financial targets, reviewing performance and recommending adjustments as usage trends change.

• Set priorities for the planning function and lead cross-functional initiatives with Data and Field Ops to close gaps in reporting and planning infrastructure.

• Identify and implement AI-assisted approaches to consumption analysis, scenario development, and recurring reporting, partnering with data to validate results and improve planning efficiency.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 8+ years in GTM strategy and operations, sales planning, revenue operations, consulting, or a related analytical field, including experience leading a planning function or major cross-functional programs.

• Demonstrated track record of strategic thinking and analysis--seeing over the horizon to identify opportunities, envision models, and strategic paths to capture opportunities, as well as spot emerging risks

• Strong modeling and analytical skills – comfort with complex segmentation analysis and workforce planning

• Excellent communication skills with executive audiences - explain “what it is”, “why it matters” and “what should we do” in terms of your data and analysis

• Experience owning GTM planning through significant ARR and headcount growth at a SaaS company of comparable scale and complexity, including evolving capacity models, coverage strategies, and planning processes as the organization expands.

• Experience in a Sales or GTM organization, and familiarity with common sales methodologies (MEDDPICC or MEDDIC) and models ( rep productivity, rep capacity, campaign influence, and quota modeling)

• High comfort with ambiguity. You identify the right priorities and put in the hard work without need for external motivation

• You think critically and creatively, continually reorienting to obstacles to define a better way to achieve our goals.

Bonus Points For:

• Previous experience in open source

• Experience with Grafana, Tableau or other analysis/BI tools.

• Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ, Zuora, or other CPQ / Q2C / subscription management tools.

• Familiarity with marketing automation (Marketo) or sales productivity tools (Outreach, Clari, People.ai).

• Familiarity with SQL or similar database querying language (you won’t be deep in SQL, but helps to have heard of a LEFT JOIN).

• Experience applying generative AI, predictive analytics, or AI-enabled automation to improve GTM planning, forecasting, and reporting, with sound judgment in validating outputs and underlying assumptions.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $230,000 - $275,000 Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

#LI-Remote

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Relief) - Sandy, UT
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a per diem Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Aesthetic Injector (Nurse Practitioner - Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Peachy’s mission is to clear care barriers and make wrinkle treatment more accessible than it’s ever been through Preventative Botox, Prescription Retinoids, and Daily Use Sunscreen. Our approach? Transparent pricing, unmatched quality of care, and solutions backed by science. Plain and simple.

Job Title: Aesthetic Injector (Nurse Practitioner) Part-time

Location: Brooklyn Heights

Join Peachy

Join one of the fastest-growing medical aesthetics companies in the country. At Peachy, our Nurse Practitioners specialize exclusively in wrinkle prevention through personalized consultations and treatment with FDA-approved neuromodulators.

Whether you're an experienced injector or completely new to aesthetics, we'll provide the training and support you need to build a successful career in medical aesthetics. Through our paid clinical training program, ongoing mentorship, and proprietary technology, you'll deliver exceptional clinical outcomes while creating an outstanding client experience.

Peachy Providers earn a competitive hourly rate plus quarterly performance bonuses. Our top-performing Providers earn 20%+ in quarterly bonus compensation.

Why Peachy?

• Paid aesthetic injector training - no prior aesthetics experience required

• Competitive hourly compensation + quarterly performance bonuses

• 100% employer-paid medical malpractice coverage

• Complimentary quarterly wrinkle treatment + prescription retinoid

• Proprietary AI-powered treatment planning technology

• Ongoing clinical education, mentorship, and professional development

• Career growth opportunities as Peachy continues expanding nationwide

No Aesthetics Experience? No Problem.

Our comprehensive paid training program is designed to teach the clinical and technical skills needed to become a successful aesthetic injector while maintaining Peachy's exceptionally high standards of care.

During training you'll learn:

• Botox®, Xeomin®, Dysport®, and Jeuveau® injection techniques

• Facial anatomy and wrinkle assessment

• Personalized consultation and treatment planning

• Neuromodulator dosing protocols

• Peachy's proprietary AI-powered treatment planning platform

• Clinical documentation and best practices

• Hands-on supervised injection training

You'll be fully compensated throughout your training period to ensure a seamless transition into your new career.

What You'll Do

• Complete Peachy's comprehensive clinical training program and participate in ongoing continuing education

• Deliver exceptional hospitality and customer service during every client interaction

• Perform wrinkle assessments and develop individualized treatment plans

• Educate clients on Peachy's wrinkle prevention offerings, including Botox®, Xeomin®, Dysport®, Jeuveau®, prescription retinoids, sunscreen, and aftercare products

• Perform cosmetic neurotoxin injections in the three FDA-approved treatment areas for facial wrinkles

• Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient charting

• Follow all operational procedures, clinical protocols, and company initiatives

• Maintain infection prevention standards, including proper hand hygiene, PPE usage, and equipment sterilization

• Uphold HIPAA privacy and confidentiality standards

Who You Are

• Communicates Effectively: Communicates clearly and professionally while actively listening and building trust with clients and teammates.

• Drives Results: Takes ownership, overcomes obstacles, and consistently delivers exceptional client outcomes.

• Interpersonal Savvy: Builds genuine relationships with clients and colleagues while creating an inclusive, welcoming environment.

• Situational Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and adjusts quickly to changing priorities and client needs.

• Manages Complexity: Uses sound clinical judgment and critical thinking to make informed decisions.

Lives Our Core Values

• Providing the Positive

• Continually Raising the Bar

• Earning & Keeping Trust

• Being Client Obsessed

• Reveling in the Constraints

What You Have

• Active Nurse Practitioner license in the state where you're applying

• Active Board Certification as an Adult, Family, or Women's Health Nurse Practitioner

• Active BLS Certification

• Strong preference for Nurse Practitioners with at least six months of autonomous clinical practice experience

• Recent procedural experience (such as IV placement, suturing, or other hands-on clinical procedures) is strongly preferred

• Flexibility to work across multiple Peachy studio locations within a reasonable distance of your home studio

• Availability to commit a Part-Time schedule, including weekdays, weekends, and occasional holidays. Part-Time providers are scheduled for approximately 7 shifts per month (about 40 hours), including at least 3 weekend shifts from 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM and 1 weekday shift per week from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM.

• While we make every effort to accommodate scheduling preferences, specific shifts cannot always be guaranteed.

• Must be at least 18 years of age and authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

Ideal Clinical Background

Successful Peachy Providers come from a variety of procedural and patient-facing specialties, including:

• Emergency Medicine

• Urgent Care

• Women's Health

• Family Medicine

• Dermatology

• Plastic Surgery

• ICU

• PACU

• Other procedural clinical environments

Physical Requirements

• Frequently kneel, bend, sit, and stand for extended periods

• Safely administer injections in FDA-approved facial treatment areas

• Lift and transport items weighing up to 30 pounds

• Operate standard office equipment and technology

Pay & Perks

• Competitive hourly compensation

• Quarterly performance bonuses (top Providers earn 20%+)

• Paid clinical training

• 100% employer-paid medical malpractice coverage

• Complimentary quarterly wrinkle treatment + prescription retinoid

• Employee discounts on Peachy services and products

• 401(k) with employer match after 90 days

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits*

• Paid Time Off*

*Benefits apply to Full-Time employees.

The target base pay for the Nurse Practitioner role in New York, NY is $60.00 - 65.00/hour USD. Compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and geographic location. Peachy reserves the right to modify compensation ranges as business needs evolve.

This position includes additional responsibilities not listed here and may evolve over the course of employment.

Curious About a Career in Aesthetics? Whether you're looking to transition into medical aesthetics or continue growing your career as an injector, we'd love to connect. Every conversation is confidential, and no prior aesthetics experience is required.

Questions before applying? Reach out to us at jobs@peachystudio.com.

jobs.title: Medical Appointment Clerk
jobs.description:
Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Medical Appointment Clerk to serve in an on-call capacity supporting the primary hired Clerk at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. This role supports patient scheduling and clinic operations by booking medical appointments, validating patient eligibility, maintaining accurate schedules, and ensuring patients receive timely access to care in accordance with Military Treatment Facility (MTF) guidelines.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Schedule medical appointments via phone, secure messaging, or other approved request methods, ensuring compliance with local appointing guidelines and access-to-care standards.

• Maintain appointment schedules using government medical systems such as CHCS, AHLTA, or MHS GENESIS.

• Validate patient eligibility through the Defense Eligibility Enrollment System (DEERS) and update demographic information; register new patients, including newborns, as needed.

• Keep patient schedules and logs accurate and up to date, using system tools and protocols (detail codes, freezing slots, TRICARE Online) for slot management, rescheduling, and cancellations.

• Contact patients via phone or secure messaging to schedule, reschedule, or cancel appointments as needed.

• Assist in preparing patient notifications for appointment reminders, no-shows, and cancellations.

• Create and deliver telephone messages (t-cons) to Primary Care Managers (PCMs) and clinic nurses in accordance with standard protocols and clinic guidelines.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Education: High School Diploma or General Educational Development (GED) equivalency.

• Experience: GENESIS Experience preferred.

Copper River’s Culture

No matter your role or which operating company you work for, we are ONE TEAM working toward the same goals for our customers and for our collective owner- The Native Village of Eyak. jobs.title: Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Warehouse Associate/Branch Driver I to join our Platt team in Tacoma, WA!

Work Hours 8:00am-5:00pm

Summary:

The Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment
• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims
• Prepare branch orders from the warehouse and ensure that the correct number and type of product is being shipped
• Process paperwork regarding shipments including but not limited to verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct postage tape and label, following customer shipping instructions, and insuring the shipment when necessary
• Operate machinery including forklift, reach truck, and wire cutting machine when required
• Load common carrier and company vehicles
• Inspect and perform minor maintenance on equipment
• Perform inventory counts and reconcile any discrepancies
• Operate delivery vehicles to make deliveries to and from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers
• Inspect company vehicle for visual and operating defects; responsible for completing a daily inspection report
• Keep company vehicle clean, serviced, and maintained; alert supervisor of repair and/or service needed
• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations
• Load or unload vehicle and ensure all material for each order is correct (quantity and type of material) and that material is free of damage before departure
• May assist in preparing orders for delivery
• Ensure all appropriate documentation is thoroughly completed at the time of delivery, including delivery receipt is signed by the customer, packing list and branch/warehouse manifest
• Pick up material returns from customers; responsible for inspecting the condition of the material and verify quantities and catalog numbers
• Pick up material from company suppliers
• Participate in the training of entry level Truck Drivers and provide mentorship and coaching
• May be required to perform other job functions within a branch when required including but not limited to counter sales and customer support
