jobs.title: Consultant
jobs.description:
Candidates must be able to work in a hybrid capacity from one of our office locations in Troy, MI, Tempe, AZ, or Jacksonville, FL

This is a client-facing consulting role focused on supporting organizations with both talent acquisition & extended workforce strategy, program optimization, service design, and technology enablement advisory. Working under the direction of senior consultants, you will contribute to advisory engagements emphasizing problem definition, solution design, and stakeholder decision support rather than hands-on technical configuration. You will support senior HR, Talent, and Procurement leaders in assessing current-state processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and designing scalable future-state models that balance people, process, and technology. This role requires developing consulting discipline, structured analytical thinking, and growing confidence in engaging with client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Client Advisory & Consulting Delivery

• Support client-facing advisory engagements from initiation through delivery and closure under senior consultant direction.

• Apply structured consulting problem-solving to diagnose business challenges and contribute to practical, value-driven solutions.

• Support discovery, assessment, and solution design activities across talent acquisition and Extended Workforce processes.

• Assist in preparing executive-ready insights, recommendations, and decision materials for senior HR and business leaders.

HR/Talent Acquisition & Extended Workforce Strategy and Service Design

• Support assessment of end-to-end HR, talent acquisition, and Extended Workforce processes, operating models, and service delivery effectiveness.

• Contribute to future-state model design aligned to business strategy, scale, and experience goals.

• Support analysis of workforce segmentation, enablement, and service optimization opportunities.

• Assist in building actionable roadmaps spanning people, process, capability, and technology improvements including governance structures, RASCI models, and funding approaches.

Research, Analysis & Design Thinking

• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research including interviews, workshops, surveys, and document reviews.

• Develop current-state and future-state artifacts such as process maps, journey maps, service blueprints, operating model diagrams, and architecture views.

• Apply design thinking techniques to understand user needs and define experience-led solutions.

• Translate research findings into clear, business-relevant insights.

Technology Enablement Advisory

In partnership with the QWA project team and Technology Consultant:

• Advise on the role of technology across the talent acquisition lifecycle and Extended Workforce ecosystem, including HRIS, ATS, VMS, CRM, analytics, AI, automation, and experience platforms.

• Support recommendations for optimization of existing systems or introduction of new tools as part of broader strategy.

• Act as a bridge between business needs and technical considerations, partnering with specialists where required.

Practice Development & Growth

• Contribute to the development of QWA intellectual property including methodologies, playbooks, and toolkits

• Stay current on market trends, talent technology innovations, and leading practices

• Identify opportunities to support clients through additional advisory services and program expansion

• 3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following - management consulting, HR advisory, talent acquisition, Extended Workforce, MSP / RPO, services procurement, or related domains

• Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing discovery, workshops, and solution design engagements

• Understanding of talent acquisition operations, Extended Workforce programs, and enabling technologies including VMS platforms

• Experience working in multi-stakeholder environments with cross-functional teams

• Willingness to travel up to 25%

Core Skills & Capabilities

• Strong advisory and consulting skills with executive-level presence

• Ability to translate complex workforce challenges into structured, practical solutions

• Experience producing high-quality, executive-ready deliverables

• Solid understanding of emerging talent technologies and market trends

• Proven ability to work independently while collaborating within multi-disciplinary teams

jobs.title: Senior Reliability Engineer, Electronics
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring a Staff Reliability Engineer to improve the reliability and lifetime of our iron-air packs and deployed systems.This role reports into our Systems Reliability team, in Berkeley CA. As part of our Systems Reliability team, you will lead reliability test development and design for reliability for several of our pack level subsystems. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Technical Leadership: Act as the primary authority on Design for Reliability (DfR) for critical electro-mechanical plant subsystems that support our battery plant, mentoring peers and guiding cross-functional design failure analyses (DFMEAs)

 - Translate high-level product goals into rigorous reliability requirements. You will define the roadmap for how we validate component and sub-system lifetimes.

 - Design and lead complex experiments to uncover failure mechanisms, determine root causes, and establish methods to accelerate failure rates in tests. Tests will focus on electronics control systems such as PCBs, connectors, and bus bars

 - Be a champion for safety


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Reliability Engineering or related field with 3-7 years of industry experience

 - Demonstrated expertise in developing new tests to evaluate performance and/ or reliability of electrical and electromechanical systems

 - Experience with testing of PCBs and other electronic components

 - Familiar with developing accelerated lifetime tests to assess component reliability across a range of operating conditions

 - Excellent communication and organizational skills

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills within a group of peers and the broader organization, including remote team members
   



#LI-Onsite

#LI-TS1



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Assistant - Port Arthur, TX
jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.

We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.

The Research Assistant (RA) at Iterative Health is an essential on-site member of the clinical research team, working under the direction of the Principal Investigator and site management to support the day-to-day conduct of active clinical trials.

This role assists Clinical Research Coordinators across every phase of study execution from participant screening and enrollment through documentation, data entry, and compliance. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, team-first professional with a healthcare background and a genuine interest in advancing clinical research. This role is a strong entry point into the clinical research field with real exposure to the full study lifecycle.

Where You’ll Drive Impact

• Assist the Study Team with communicating study requirements to all individuals involved in the study.

• Work with the Study Team to develop and implement recruitment strategies in accordance with site policies and IRB requirements.

• Assist with screening subjects for eligibility using protocol-specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, documenting each potential participant's eligibility or exclusion.

• Assist with registering participants in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) to ensure proper billing of study procedures to the appropriate funding source.

• Collect and report ongoing patient recruitment and enrollment progress and metrics to site management and the PI.

• Assist the Study Team in completing study documentation and maintaining study files in accordance with sponsor requirements and site policies, including consent forms, source documentation, case report forms, and investigational material accountability forms.

• Enter all patient visit data in eCRF and CTMS on a daily basis or as directed.

• Arrange secure storage of study documents in accordance with GCP guidelines or the contracted length of time, whichever is longer.

• Maintain inventory of study supplies; follow sponsor protocol and site policies on investigational drug/device accountability when applicable.

• Process and ship specimens per study protocol and IATA regulations as directed.

• Work with the Study Team to manage the day-to-day activities of the study, including problem-solving, communication, and protocol management.

• Aid the Study Team in maintaining effective and ongoing communication with sponsors, research participants, site management, and the PI throughout the course of each study.

• Assist the Study Team in protecting the rights and welfare of all human research participants in accordance with federal regulations.

• Cooperate with site compliance and monitoring efforts regarding the access, use, and disclosure of PHI; report instances of noncompliance to the appropriate compliance office.

• Perform job related duties as requested

What You Bring to the Team

• High school diploma or equivalent required; some college coursework preferred.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in a healthcare setting.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to read, interpret, and apply clinic policies and research protocols.

• Proficiency in standard office software; familiarity with CTMS or eCRF platforms a plus.

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a research team.

• Professional, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining confidentiality and data integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior clinical research experience or exposure to clinical trial operations.

• Familiarity with GCP guidelines and human subject research regulations.

• Experience with specimen processing and shipping per IATA regulations.

• Interest in pursuing a career path in clinical research coordination or research operations.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to sit, stand, and move throughout clinical and office environments for extended periods of time

• Ability to lift and move up to 25 pounds as needed

At Iterative Health, we’re actively working towards creating an environment that is representative of the diversity of patients our technology serves. We are focused on building an equitable and inclusive culture, and by extension, hiring process. If you require any accommodations to make the application process or interviewing experience more accessible to you, please contact CandidateAccommodations@iterative.health.

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. JOB SUMMARY

OpenGov's Head of Platform Marketing owns the platform narrative for the Public Service Platform and ensures it lands consistently across every GTM touchpoint. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the SVP of Marketing, for an expert writer and presenter who understands how B2B SaaS businesses work and can make a complex platform story feel clear and compelling to government buyers, field teams, and executives alike.

 
 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Narrative

 - Own and evolve the platform narrative for the Public Service Platform, translating strategy into compelling content across every format: talk tracks, decks, video scripts, ad copy, onboarding material, and executive presentations

 - Define what the field needs to believe and say about the platform above the product-line level: the story that connects ERP, Community Ops, and AI into something a government buyer actually understands

 - Serve as the primary messaging counterpart to platform leadership: translating what is being built every week into content that resonates externally and keeps the field oriented as the platform evolves

 - Own the narrative for OG Assist as OpenGov's most strategic platform capability; multiple value propositions are emerging and this role ensures they land with clarity and specificity across every audience

 - Provide informed input on pricing and packaging decisions alongside platform leadership and growth marketing; brings the buyer and field perspective into those conversations without owning the outcome

 - Make AI capabilities feel practical and specific to government buyers, not like a feature list

 - Advise on platform narrative consistency across major external moments: analyst briefings, executive keynotes, conference presence

GTM Activation

 - Ensure the platform story is consistent everywhere it shows up: seller pitches, PS and CS decks, onboarding, analyst briefings, press, and customer stories

 - Set and hold the bar for what on-narrative content looks like; this is not about owning every output, it is about making sure nothing leaves misaligned

 - Resolve conflicts before content reaches the field: AEs, CSMs, PS, and Support will surface competing needs and this role makes the call

 - Create the conditions for GTM teams to stay excited about what we are building, not just informed about it; this person sets the pace and energy, not just the content

 - Drive adoption of new capabilities with sellers, implementation teams, and customers; adoption is the metric, not completion of a training session

 - Present and deliver directly when the moment calls for it; this person is credible in a room with AEs, CSMs, and executives alike

Writing & Storytelling

jobs.description:
As a Security Risk and SOC Responsible, your main focus will be Develop, implement and maintain risk-based security and compliance strategies, connected to company policies, global standards, country legislation and sales market risk landscape.

We’re looking for an RCM Team Lead to oversee daily operations for a specific RCM function. • Identify performance trends, recommend process improvements, and assist with documentation updates or audit-related work.

• Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture aligned with Tend’s mission and RCM department goals.

Who You Are:

You embody our Tend values and demonstrate key leadership competencies that drive both operational success and team growth. At Tend, our values aren’t just words on a wall—they guide how we hire, lead, and collaborate. As a leader, you set the tone for your team, modeling the behaviors that shape our culture, performance, and member experience.

• Tend to Others - Lead with empathy and accountability. You consistently achieve results, even in challenging circumstances, by prioritizing the needs of members, teammates, and partners.

• Be Brave Enough to Lead - You speak up about difficult issues, make tough calls, and take smart risks to act with integrity and authenticity. You inspire your team to do the same.

• Savor the Ride - You celebrate wins, create a motivating team environment, and keep energy high—even when tackling complex or high-volume work.

• Embrace Our Differences - You encourage diverse perspectives, listen actively, and adapt your leadership style to different communication and learning needs. You recognize the value that different backgrounds and experiences bring to the team.

• Rooted in Growth - You seek out feedback, reflect on your leadership approach, and continuously improve. You actively develop your own skills while fostering growth in your team.

Additional Leadership Competencies:

• Build Stronger Teams - You create an environment where collaboration thrives, roles are clear, and people are empowered to do their best work. You celebrate collective wins and address challenges quickly to keep the team moving forward.

• Decide with Clarity - You make informed, timely decisions—balancing urgency with accuracy—especially when resolving escalations or reallocating resources. You use data, experience, and team input to guide your choices.

• Deliver on What Matters - You set clear expectations, hold yourself and your team accountable, and ensure work is completed to the highest standard. You track progress against goals, address barriers proactively, and maintain momentum.

What You Have:

• 2+ years of experience in revenue cycle management or finance in a dental organization, with deep expertise in at least one core function (e.g., insurance verification, credits, payment posting).

• Prior experience in a lead, senior analyst, or mentorship role preferred, with proven ability to guide and develop others.

• Proficient in Dentrix, with advanced ledger knowledge and ability to resolve complex account scenarios.

• Comfortable using Excel and Google Sheets to track performance, analyze data, and present insights to leadership.

• Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage shifting priorities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear direction and constructive feedback in real time.

What We Offer:

We believe taking care of people starts with taking care of our own. Here’s how we’ve got you covered at Tend:

• 🩺 Health Comes First - We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance — plus a Dental Wellness Program to keep your smile as sharp as your skills.

• 💰 Plan for the Future - 401(k) plan because your future matters just as much as your now.

• 💡 Support, When You Need It - Life & AD&D insurance, health advocacy, legal support, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) — all designed to have your back when life gets real.

• 🛍️ Smart Spending Options - We’ve got Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), and pre-tax transit/parking benefits to make your dollars go further.

• 🌴 Time to Recharge - Enjoy generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and company holidays — because rest is productive.

• 💸 Bonus Eligible - This role includes annual bonus potential based on both company performance and your impact.

jobs.title: Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Health Coach
jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options:

• Central, Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time: 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm

• Eastern Time: 9am to 6pm ET only

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

• An active NBHWC health coaching certification is required.

• At least 1 year of experience as a health coach is required.

• Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

• Fluency in Spanish is required.

• Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this role is $22 - $26 per hour, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive pay & equity*

• Fully remote

• Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision

• Paid time off

• 401k plan + matching

• Paid parental leave

• Home office stipend

*benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Senior
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Who you are:

As a Business Analyst, you will serve as a critical bridge between stakeholders and development teams, translating complex client and user requirements into actionable user stories that drive our AI solution's evolution. You will collaborate with Product Management, federal clients, and end users in an agile environment to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, shaping features that support large language model deployment, AI-powered workflows, and enterprise integration.

What you do:

• Elicit and analyze business and functional requirements from federal clients, end users, and stakeholders through interviews, workshops, and documentation review.

• Translate complex requirements into clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria for agile development teams.

• Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and daily standups to support agile development processes.

• Validate user story completion and ensure deliverables meet acceptance criteria and stakeholder expectations.

• Draft functional specifications, business requirements documents, process flows, use cases, and requirements traceability matrices.

• Facilitate communication between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring shared understanding of requirements and constraints.

• Conduct gap analysis identifying differences between current state and desired future state capabilities.

• Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and documenting results.

• Analyze business processes and workflows to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and optimization.

• Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize features based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder needs.

• Document system functionality, user workflows, and integration requirements supporting both development and compliance activities.

• Support demonstration and training activities by documenting features and creating user-facing materials.

• Maintain requirements documentation ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with evolving project scope.

• Facilitate requirements reviews and validation sessions with stakeholders to ensure alignment and approval.

• Track requirements changes and manage scope through change control processes.

• Support compliance documentation efforts by providing functional descriptions and requirements traceability for security authorization processes.

What you need:

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in a Business Analyst role.

• Strong understanding of agile development methodologies.

• Proven ability to translate complex requirements into actionable user stories.

• Excellent communication skills to facilitate collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with requirements documentation, gap analysis, and user acceptance testing.

• Ability to analyze business processes for AI-driven solutions.

• Experience working with large language model deployment and AI-powered workflows is a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is hiring a Director, Product Marketing, Life Sciences to own go-to-market for our life science product portfolio. You will set positioning and launch strategy for closed-loop AI and autonomous lab capabilities, including mRNA design, DNA construct optimization, and AI-driven medicinal chemistry.

The audience is senior and technical: biopharma and advanced therapy companies, R&D and CMC leaders, data science teams, and scientific IT. Your job is to make complex science legible and commercially compelling, then build the evidence that moves prospects from curiosity to committed programs.

You will work as an individual contributor embedded with the LS Product team, partnering closely with Commercial, Business Development, and Brand. Success looks like a coherent portfolio narrative, a real plan behind every major capability launch, and a field team equipped to sell.

What You'll Be Building

• Own go-to-market strategy for the full life science product portfolio

• Define positioning for RNA, DNA, protein, and small molecule capabilities

• Lead launches end to end, from pilot framing through general availability and expansion

• Build offer constructs with Product and Commercial, including pilot scopes and access models

• Turn pilots into case studies that show measurable scientific impact

• Equip Commercial and BD with narrative decks, talk tracks, and competitive positioning

• Synthesize customer and competitive signal into prioritization recommendations for Product

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 10+ years in product marketing, including portfolio-level ownership at a technical company

• Track record launching complex scientific or AI products to biopharma and R&D buyers

• Working knowledge of the life science value chain, discovery through early development

• Ability to translate AI and lab automation concepts into credible commercial narratives

• Exceptional writing, with examples aimed at scientific and executive audiences

• Proven influence across Product, Commercial, and Brand without formal authority

• Experience supporting or leading sales motions into top 20 pharma accounts

Bonus Points For

• Advanced degree in life sciences, bioengineering, or a related field

• Experience marketing lab automation, assay platforms, or AI-driven discovery tools

• Familiarity with CMC, translational, or bioinformatics buying processes

• Early-stage experience where the category and product are still being defined

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$168,000—$238,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Survey Data Technician
jobs.location: 10777 Westheimer Road, Suite 400, Houston, Texas 77042; 1450 Lake Robbins Drive, Suite 310, The Woodlands, TX 77380; 23501 Cinco Ranch Blvd., Suite A-250, Katy, Texas 77494
jobs.description:
Your future begins here! BGE, Inc. is a nationwide civil engineering consulting firm offering diverse career opportunities in a wide range of disciplines for public and private infrastructure projects. Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes outstanding health care, generous 401(k) match, professional career resources, and highly competitive work-life balance programs, including personal-time allowances, dependent care, and flexible Fridays.

In addition, BGE provides unlimited sick leave, floating holidays, and robust career growth guidance, including organization-wide leadership and mentorship programs to help you build connections and shape your career. BGE goes beyond competitive benefits to attract and retain the best in an environment that inspires excellence.

Position is for in house and can be located at our Houston, Katy or The Woodlands, TX office.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Survey Data Technician to support the Survey team by managing, processing, reviewing, and preparing field-collected survey data. This position serves as a key link between field crews and project deliverables, helping ensure that survey information is complete, accurate, well organized, and ready for mapping, modeling, design support, and client delivery.

The ideal candidate will have practical experience with survey data processing, topographic data, field documentation, surface modeling, and quality assurance/quality control procedures. Strong organization, technical judgment, and communication skills are essential for success in this role.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Field Data and Logbook Management

• Manage, maintain, and track daily field logbooks and associated project records.

• Receive, organize, and archive daily field files using established project naming and filing standards.

• Confirm that required field documentation has been submitted and is complete.

• Coordinate with field crews to resolve missing information, unclear notes, or data discrepancies.

Survey Data Processing

• Download, import, process, and organize daily topographic survey files.

• Post-process survey data and prepare files for drafting, mapping, surface development, and deliverables.

• Review feature coding, descriptions, linework, and collected attributes for consistency.

• Maintain orderly working files and preserve supporting data in accordance with company standards.

• Review construction plans and prepare staking calculations for field crews

Quality Assurance / Quality Control

• Perform QA/QC reviews of field notes for completeness, clarity, and consistency with collected data.

• Identify potential errors, omissions, outliers, or conflicts in field data and supporting documentation.

• Coordinate needed corrections with field personnel, technicians, and project managers.

• Follow established quality processes and document significant corrections or assumptions.

Topographic Data and Deliverables

• Occasionally help create field packets and line out our survey crews for jobs

• Clean up topographic survey data and linework for mapping and final deliverables.

• Input and verify utility and drainage invert information.

• Enter temporary benchmark (TBM) notes, elevations, locations, and descriptions.

• Prepare finished survey topo data products, including topographic deliverables and surface models, as assigned.

• Assist with post-construction and as-built data processing when required.

Surface Modeling

• Create and review terrain and surface models for QA/QC, design support, and project deliverables.

• Inspect surfaces for gaps, spikes, voids, crossing breaklines, and other anomalies.

• Compare surface results with field notes, source data, and project requirements.

• Prepare surface files and supporting information for internal and external project teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED.

• Working knowledge of land surveying practices, terminology, and field-to-finish workflows.

• Experience processing survey data, reviewing field notes, or supporting survey drafting and deliverables.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality.

• Ability to organize multiple projects, priorities, and daily data submissions.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Good computer skills and the ability to learn company software, standards, and procedures.

• Valid driver’s license.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree or technical coursework in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering Technology, GIS, CAD, or a related field.

• Three or more years of Survey Drafter, Survey Data Technician, CAD, or related experience.

• Knowledge of basic civil engineering concepts.

• Experience supporting topographic, transportation, utility, municipal, land development, or as-built surveys.

Some of our Benefits:

• 401k Match: 100% up to 4% of your contributions with immediate vesting + 3% Safe Harbor Contribution with immediate vesting

• Merit-Based Bonus Compensation

• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; BGE contributes to HSA on eligible plans

• 9 paid Holidays, including 3 Floating holidays

• Personal Time Allowances

• 2 to 4 weeks of Vacation, depending on experience-level. Unused vacation carries over to the next year.

• "Unlimited" Sick Days.

• Mentorship Program – Provides you with the opportunity to learn and receive guidance from seasoned professionals.

• Employee Referral Program that pays you for bringing great people into the BGE family

BGE is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We prohibit discrimination and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, Vietnam Era Veteran Status, Disabled Veteran Status, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: CNC Programmer
jobs.description:
Position Summary & Objective

A CNC (Computer Numerical Control) programmer develops and modifies computer programs to control the operation of CNC machines, translating blueprints and design specifications into instructions for the machine to cut and shape materials into desired forms. They work with software, choose cutting tools, and ensure the machine functions correctly and produces high-quality parts.

Essential Functions Performed by the Position

Interpreting Blueprints and Designs:

• Understanding technical drawings, specifications, and design models to determine the desired shape, dimensions, and tolerances of the final product.

Developing CNC Programs:

• Creating and modifying G-code or other programming languages to instruct the CNC machine on how to cut and shape the material, including toolpaths, speeds, feeds, and other machine parameters.
• Optimize program efficiency to fully utilize machine capabilities including adjusting tool paths, speed and feed rates.

Choosing Cutting Tools and Fixtures:

• Selecting appropriate tools, fixtures, and other equipment based on the material, part geometry, and required accuracy.

Setting Up and Adjusting Machines:

• Configuring the CNC machine for specific jobs, including tool selection, clamping, and other preparations.

Testing and Troubleshooting:

• Verifying that the program functions correctly, identifying and resolving errors, and adjusting the program or machine settings as needed.

Staying Current with Technology:

• Keeping up with advancements in CNC technology, programming languages, and manufacturing processes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Troubleshooting:

• Addressing any issues that arise during the manufacturing process, such as tool breakage, or program errors.

Maintaining Tooling and Documentation:

• Keeping track of tooling inventory, maintaining tooling databases, and documenting the manufacturing process.

Collaborating with Others:

• Working with engineers, machinists, and other team members to ensure efficient and accurate production of parts.
• Proactive communication with vendors to ensure tooling availability for production.

Required Education and Experience

• Degree or certification or equivalent job experience.
• Five years’ experience programming CNC lathes and/or mills.
• Blueprint reading is required with a high level of experience.

The benefits of joining our team

Because we seek to hire the best people, we work hard to provide benefits that make their lives better, so we offer a comprehensive benefit program which features:

• health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental, and vision plans
• a 401(k) plan in with a generous company match
• financial protection through disability, life, and accidental death & dismemberment insurance plans
• tax advantages through flexible spending accounts that allow you to pay for specific health-care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars
• a generous paid time off program in which the benefits increase along with your tenure with the company

When you join our team, you do more than simply switch companies to progress your career. You become part of our family, a group of talented women and men who drive business success.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist II, Biotransformation and Disposition
jobs.description:
The Biotransformation and Disposition team within AbbVie’s Quantitative Translational and ADME Sciences organization is seeking a driven Senior Scientist II to support AbbVie’s drug discovery and development programs through the design, execution, interpretation, and communication of in vitro and in vivo biotransformation and ADME studies. The successful candidate will apply expertise in drug metabolism, metabolite profiling, mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography, and structure elucidation to answer key scientific questions, guide project strategy, and advance compounds across the pipeline. This role requires strong scientific judgment, hands-on laboratory capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to translate complex analytical data into clear conclusions for project teams, management, and regulatory submissions. Duties will be focused on laboratory work, and the applicant will collaborate across various disciplines within AbbVie. Additional expertise in peptide chemistry, structural elucidation, and mass spectrometry is preferred.

Key responsibilities and desired skills include:

• Design, conduct, interpret, and report in vitro and in vivo biotransformation studies to identify metabolites, metabolic pathways, and clearance mechanisms.
• Perform metabolite profiling and structural elucidation using LC-MS/MS, high-resolution mass spectrometry, and complementary analytical techniques.
• Develop, optimize, maintain, and troubleshoot chromatographic and mass spectrometric methods, including assays involving radiolabeled compounds where applicable.
• Integrate metabolite data with broader DMPK, ADME, pharmacokinetic, toxicology, chemistry, and clinical findings to support compound selection and development decisions.
• Represent Biotransformation and Disposition on cross-functional project teams and communicate scientific findings through presentations, technical reports, publications, and regulatory documents.
• Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, study designs, automation approaches, and analytical methods to improve data quality, sensitivity, throughput, and scientific impact.
• Collaborate effectively with internal and external partners while maintaining rigorous documentation, data integrity, regulatory compliance, and laboratory safety standards.
• Contribute to a collaborative learning environment by mentoring colleagues, sharing technical expertise, encouraging innovation, and supporting continuous improvement.

Additional preferred skills:

• Design and interpret peptide biotransformation experiments to identify enzymatic cleavage sites, metabolic pathways, and structural modifications across relevant in vitro and in vivo systems.
• Apply expertise in peptide mass spectrometry, including LC-MS/MS and high-resolution MS, to characterize intact peptides, metabolites, and degradation products in biotransformation studies.
• Specific hands-on expertise in handling high-end high-resolution Thermo and Sciex mass spectrometers and software are desired.

• Ph.D. in Chemistry, Life Sciences or a related field with 4+ years; alternatively, a Master’s degree with 8+ years or a Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of relevant academic or industry research experience in small-molecule drug development.
• Demonstrated expertise in mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography, structure elucidation, core DMPK processes, including analytical method development, metabolite profiling, and biotransformation.
• Strong written (peer reviewed publications), verbal, presentation, interpersonal, and collaborative skills, with the proven ability to work independently and effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
• Proven leadership capabilities, including mentoring others, fostering a learning environment, driving innovation, building strong cross-functional relationships, and continuously raising scientific and performance standards.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Mechanical Engineer

Who We Are

Boston-based company Piaggio Fast Forward Inc. (PFF) was founded in 2015 by the Piaggio Group (the Italian manufacturer that created the iconic Vespa scooter). We are on a mission to build technology products that move the way that people move. To bring products to market today, PFF is solving the problem of robotic interaction with people in dynamically changing environments. We’re innovators, neighbors, and creators with a passion for local living and pushing the limits on urban transportation. We support a sustainable mobility ecology with healthy lifestyles and social connectivity available to all, regardless of age or abilities.

The Role

We are looking to add an innovative and motivated individual to our mechanical engineering team with a thorough understanding of mechanical principles, as well as demonstrated leadership capabilities working on / ability to work in interdisciplinary engineering teams. In this role, you will work with the Mechanical team in the design & development of new products and sustaining existing programs. You will be working collaboratively with both the Test Engineer to evaluate functionality of the machines and the Manufacturing Engineer to formalize the assembly process, working with the entire robotic system will also provide an opportunity to work closely with the Electrical Engineering and Software teams. You will be expected to communicate technical information across all levels in order to effectively assist your coworkers and present your work and findings across multiple teams. You’ll have the opportunity to create, fabricate, integrate and test hardware and systems, and be part of a team that is dedicated to creating new transportation and robotic solutions. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Mechanical Engineering Manager.

What You Need

• BS degree in mechanical engineering or related field

• Minimum of five years’ experience in a mechanical engineering role with a focus on electro-mechanical systems

• One to two years of experience working with robotic systems is preferred, but not required

• Ability to innovate and develop new designs and methods

• Extensive understanding of mechanical engineering principles and analytical skills

• Drivetrain/systems, steering, chassis is a must, suspension is a plus

• Electromechanical systems including motors, actuators, and solenoids

• Vehicle Design for commercial applications

• Includes 2+ wheeled robotic platforms, automobiles, motorcycles

• Prototype Component Development

• Experience with rapid prototyping/3D printing of plastic and metal parts is required

• Ability to work in an iterative and prototype-focused development style

• Drawing creation via ISO or ANSI standards

• Familiarity with CAD file exchange platform and shared assemblies

• 3D CAD Modeling and structural and thermal analysis

• Experience with Autodesk Inventor and/or Fusion 360 preferred

• A working knowledge of machine and fabrication shop equipment and techniques

• Experience with metals, plastics and composite materials and manufacturing methods

• Experience with metals, plastics and composite materials and manufacturing methods is preferred

• Familiarity with design for the following processes: injection molding, die-casting, sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining

• Familiarity with working on interdisciplinary and cross-functional teams

• Highly analytical self-starter with good communication skills (both written and verbal)

• If you've been deeply involved with a collegiate design competition (solar car, FSAE, robotics, AIAA DBF), that experience will be especially relevant here

Applicants will be asked to provide a portfolio or examples of projects completed.

What You’ll Do

You will be working closely with the other engineers on a small, collaborative development team. Example tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Lead development and productization of components and systems from conception to launch

• Interdisciplinary communication with the other engineering and design teams

• Creation and release of documentation of components and systems required

• CAD Design for production components

• Communicating with vendors to optimize design for manufacturing

• Interacting with production on prototype designs and confirming designs

• Developing an expert familiarity with the mechanics within current and future pipeline products

• Perform root cause analysis, and troubleshoot mechanical issues with corrective action recommendation

• Working with the Test Engineer to evaluate the performance of mechanical systems for our new & existing products

• Work on executing the tests, analyzing data, and reporting results to the team

• Technical development work on complex mechanical design challenges

• Assisting other members of the engineering team through meetings or design reviews

• Completing documentation required for releasing materials to manufacturing

• Supporting our factory in the assembly and manufacturing of current products

• Work on the physical design & fabrication of test fixtures in our in-house machine shop

• Experience with test equipment, Arduino projects, Python, and Matlab preferred

We like you just the way you are.
Diversity fuels our innovation. Inclusion, belonging, equity, and neurodiversity drives our best-in-class culture. We strive to create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, grow at their own pace, and work together towards a shared vision while holding each other to a higher standard. For us, DEI&B is the only way forward.

Employment Eligibility Verification
Piaggio Fast Forward participates in E-Verify, an electronic employment verification program operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA), to verify the employment eligibility of newly hired employees. Piaggio Fast Forward is an E-Verify Employer, and as such, the company will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value banking and fintech partners on Wise Platform — driving continuous improvement in how payment solutions are delivered, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:

• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio — continuously improving how payment solutions are delivered, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the strategic relationship).
• Executing cross-functionally: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with Wise operational teams plus product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be owning Wise Platform partner volume retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners receive the most value from our product, operationally stable and ready to grow. You will also work with other functions, including product management, tech, legal, compliance, implementation and business development.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Own volume retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners — leading operational initiatives with Wise teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out straightforward processing for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution — ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimizing churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximize the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Own incident resolution & communication — leading response for your partner portfolio, acting as the liaison between partners and internal teams during service disruptions, and driving clear, timely communication throughout. This goes beyond managing a single incident: you drive fixes that address the root cause, working cross-functionally to resolve related and recurring issues affecting broader NAM operations — not just the immediate partner impacted.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimize internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organizations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyze the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.

• At least 5+ years in Fintech/Banking and experience working with enterprise banking clients or large companies in the payments or financial services industry.
• Experience driving projects to improve customer experience and achieve tangible measurable results (example: speed accuracy improved by X% for Wise.com clients on X currency)
• Deep operational expertise in cross-border payments, including knowledge of payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP), reconciliation processes, and knowledge of the technical implementation of API-based solutions.
• Data-driven decision-maker with the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to prioritize operational improvements and measure success.
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the experience influencing C-level executives and working cross-functionally with internal teams (e.g., Product, Compliance, and Engineering) to deliver outcomes.
• Technical fluency – you understand APIs, webhooks, and system integrations. While you won’t be coding, you’ll work closely with engineers and be comfortable discussing technical solutions with partners.
• Exceptional communication skills – you can explain complex technical and operational concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Autonomous and adaptable – you’re comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities effectively.
• You must have examples of how you have unblocked solutions with product and engineering teams by articulating data, examples how you have overcome pushback

Nice to have:

• Comprehensive understanding of Correspondent banking product and solutions
• Have experience working directly with Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks or large fintechs in an enterprise environment.
• Are familiar with regulatory frameworks (e.g., AML, KYC, PSD2) affecting cross-border payments and banking operations.
• Have led technical onboarding or implementation projects for complex payment systems.

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Analyst I
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company committed to establishing the leading, fully integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. To achieve this vision, Beam has assembled a platform with integrated gene editing, delivery and internal manufacturing capabilities. Beam’s suite of gene editing technologies is anchored by base editing, a proprietary technology that is designed to enable precise, predictable and efficient single base changes, at targeted genomic sequences, without making double-stranded breaks in the DNA. Beam is a values-driven organization committed to its people, cutting-edge science, and a vision of providing life-long cures to patients suffering from serious diseases.

• Build and maintain reporting across enterprise applications to provide operational oversight, measure performance, and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.

Qualifications:

jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.



About The Role

As a Partner Solutions Engineer at EliseAI, you'll scope, design, and launch the integrations that connect our partners' systems to our platform. You'll work directly with our partners’ engineering teams to understand their product, guide them through our APIs, and shape how our systems connect. Internally, you'll coordinate with partnerships, engineering, and product teams while staying the partner's technical point of contact from kickoff through launch. With each integration, you'll turn what you learn into patterns, docs, and tooling that make the next partner faster to launch. You'll be building with a team that ships quickly, while shaping our partner ecosystem and directly contributing to our growth.



Key Responsibilities

 - Be the technical lead for partners from discovery through production, getting to know their systems and workflows. Bring customers into the conversation when needed

 - Manage several integrations at once as the technical project manager, prioritizing across competing go-live dates and keeping partners moving toward launch

 - Architect how EliseAI connects with each partner, including how data flows between systems and which APIs are used. Build toward standard patterns so partners in the same category can launch faster

 - Own testing and launch readiness so integrations go live successfully, then monitor performance after launch to catch issues before partners or customers do

 - Identify gaps in our own APIs and work with Engineering and Product to scope and prioritize the right solutions

 - Contribute to our developer docs, playbooks, and tooling, and turn recurring partner pain points into improvements that help shape what we build next
   
   

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.



Requirements

 - 3+ years in a partner or customer facing technical role, such as technical consulting, solutions engineering, technical partnerships, integrations, or software engineering in a high growth tech environment or an adjacent field

 - Deep familiarity with APIs, webhooks, system architecture, and modern integration patterns. You can read and reason about code (Python or similar)

 - Experience working directly with external technical stakeholders, such as vendor or customer engineering teams

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Manage industrial and commercial electrical field service and project-based work from RFP through closeout. This role owns project scope, schedule, budget, customer communication, field coordination, and financial performance. This position will also support estimating, customer site walks, proposal development, change-order pricing, and other Solutions Team priorities. This position will primarily work in and around our service area in Minnesota, with the possibility of needs across the Midwest or the continental United States at times.

Responsibilities

• Manage assigned electrical projects from initial opportunity and pre-construction through final closeout, with accountability for safety, scope, schedule, budget, customer expectations, and financial results.
• Partner with Business Development and customers to qualify opportunities, understand project drivers, define technical needs, and establish practical pursuit strategies.
• Lead and participate in customer discovery meetings, site walks, field investigations, and constructability reviews to develop clear scopes of work and identify risks, assumptions, exclusions, and schedule constraints.
• Support pre-construction design by coordinating with customers, engineers, vendors, and field leadership to develop conceptual layouts, design criteria, equipment selections, installation approaches, and value-engineering options.
• Create complete, competitive electrical estimates using drawings, specifications, site conditions, historical data, and defined customer requirements.
• Perform and validate quantity takeoffs, labor calculations, material and equipment pricing, subcontractor scope, vendor quotations, indirect costs, contingencies, escalation, and project-specific risk allowances.
• Develop proposal packages, clarifications, alternates, allowances, qualifications, and pricing narratives that clearly communicate KE’s scope, value, and commercial position.
• Provide estimating support across the Solutions Team by reviewing scopes, takeoffs, labor plans, vendor pricing, proposal strategy, and estimate completeness; assist with bid reviews and turnover preparation.
• Review estimates, proposals, contracts, purchase orders, drawings, specifications, and customer requirements before startup; lead internal handoff and kickoff activities to align estimating assumptions with project execution.
• Develop and maintain project schedules, manpower plans, material needs, shutdown requirements, work sequencing, procurement plans, and key milestones.
• Monitor labor productivity, material, equipment, subcontractors, purchase commitments, billing, cost to complete, and forecasted margin; address concerns early.
• Identify scope changes, develop and validate change-order pricing, submit and track change orders, and communicate approved changes to the field and project team.
• Serve as a primary KE contact and communicate project status, schedule, risks, required decisions, and changes clearly and professionally while developing long-term customer relationships and identifying follow-on opportunities.
• Conduct regular site visits, maintain strong working relationships with field leadership, and remove roadblocks affecting safe and efficient execution.
• Coordinate vendors, subcontractors, procurement, long-lead materials, equipment, and critical delivery dates.
• Maintain complete project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, schedules, correspondence, photographs, cost information, and as-built requirements.
• Lead punch-list completion, project closeout, final financial review, estimate-versus-actual analysis, and lessons-learned activities; apply findings to improve future estimates and execution plans.
• Support safe project planning and partner with field leadership and KE Safety to address project-specific risks.
• Support Project Coordinators and developing team members by sharing estimating, pre-construction, project-controls, and customer-management practices.
• Participate in KE Project Manager meetings and operating cadences for pipeline review, estimating, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, risk management, change management, and project controls.

What You'll Bring

*This position is based in Minnesota and requires up to 20% travel to customers and project sites. This includes potential travel in the Midwest as well as across the United States.

The requirements listed in job descriptions are guidelines, not fixed rules. You do not have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If you feel you are an excellent candidate, we encourage you to apply!

• Previous electrical construction project-management experience strongly preferred; industrial electrical or Field Services experience is a plus.
• Associate or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical Technology, Engineering Technology, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
• Working knowledge of electrical construction methods, materials, equipment, project sequencing, and jobsite execution.
• Demonstrated understanding of project scope, schedule, budget, forecasting, job-cost management, and change orders.
• Electrical estimating, and or project management experience preferred.
• Strong customer communication, relationship-management, organization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while working effectively with field and office teams.
• Experience with Procore, Microsoft Project, Dynamics, estimating platforms, or similar systems preferred.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Valid driver's license and ability to travel to customer and project locations.
• Ability to support occasional shutdown, evening, or weekend activities when project needs require.

Pay Range

We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in.

Total Rewards Statement

• As a full-time employee at KE, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.
• 100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees
• HSA contributions to support your medical expenses
• Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
• 401(k) with competitive company match
• Paid weekly with competitive wages
• PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement
• Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage

We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities.

Typical requirements may include:

• Ability to sit, stand, kneel, stoop, walk, and work on your feet for long periods of time
• Ability to work in outdoor conditions, including extreme hot and cold temperatures
• Ability to dig, backfill, and manually move materials
• Ability to lift and carry up to 80 pounds

Accessibility: If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact KE Human Resources at HR@KEway.com.
