jobs.title: Senior Director, New Product Planning
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx Pharmaceuticals is seeking a Senior Director, New Product Planning to provide strategic leadership across new product planning, pipeline commercialization strategy, and long-range growth opportunities for Amylyx. The Senior Director will partner closely across Program Leadership, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical Development, Business Development, Market Access, and other cross-functional teams to assess market opportunities, define differentiated product strategies, and inform enterprise investment decisions from early development through lifecycle management.

Responsibilities

• Lead Commercial new product planning strategy for Amylyx pipeline assets and support lifecycle management planning for marketed products, ensuring alignment with broader portfolio strategy.

• Lead insight generation and market analysis, including landscape assessments, unmet need evaluation, stakeholder research, competitive intelligence, opportunity sizing, and scenario planning.

• Develop commercial strategy recommendations that inform development plans, target product profiles, indication sequencing, investment decisions, and long-range business planning.

• Serve as an active member of program teams generally for programs in Ph 1 and 2 and prepare for seamless asset hand-off to brand leadership generally during Phase 3.

• Partner with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, and Market Access to ensure commercial perspectives are integrated into evidence-generation plans, development milestones, regulatory strategy, and access considerations.

• Define priority markets, customer segments, patient populations, stakeholder needs, value drivers, and potential positioning to support differentiated asset strategies.

• Collaborate across Amylyx to support potential Business Development for external opportunity assessments, due diligence, and strategic fit evaluations as needed.

• Build new product planning capabilities, processes, and ways of working that enable consistent, rigorous, and collaborative commercial input across Amylyx’s portfolio.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field required; advanced degree such as an MBA, MPH, or equivalent preferred.

• Minimum of 15 years of progressive pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare marketing experience with demonstrated success in brand management and commercial launch strategy.

• Demonstrated brand leadership resulting in successful product launches in biotechnology or specialty pharmaceuticals.

• Demonstrated success developing integrated healthcare provider, patient, caregiver, and disease awareness marketing strategies.

• Experience managing significant commercial budgets and external agency partnerships.

• Experience leading and working cross-functional commercial teams and influencing executive leadership on enterprise-wide strategic decisions. Demonstrated contributions as a member of program and lifecycle teams, integrated evidence generation planning group, pricing committees, and other strategic cross-functional bodies.

• Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, leadership, problem-solving, executive communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

• Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing teams in a fast-paced, evolving commercial environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Rare disease, endocrinology, metabolic disease, neurology, or specialty pharmaceutical experience preferred.

• Experience in a growing biotechnology organization, strategic consulting environment, or cross-functional portfolio planning role preferred

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska, Arizona, Hawaii, Michigan and Tennessee.

jobs.title: Freelance Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

HaloBraid is a technology company using breakthrough engineering to help people perform routines faster. We’re building the world’s first robotic hair-braiding that works with professional stylists to reduce braiding appointments from hours to minutes and grow their business.  Billion hours are spent braiding hair each year. HaloBraid exists to give that time back.

Our product has already gone viral, generating millions of views across social platforms, building a fast-growing community of stylists, braid wearers, beauty lovers, and early believers excited for what’s next. This role will help transform our early traction into a dedicated and nurtured community.

We’re looking for a social media-obsessed highly creative Freelance Social Media Manager to help bring HaloBraid to life across social platforms and in the community. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves creating content, following trends, shooting and editing short-form video, writing captions, engaging with audiences, and building digital community from the ground up.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own HaloBraid’s day-to-day organic social strategy, including content calendars, platform planning, posting cadence, and creative testing.

 - Concept, create, shoot, edit, caption, and publish social content across TikTok, Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms.

 - Identify trends, sounds, memes, conversations, and cultural moments that HaloBraid can participate in authentically.

 - Develop recurring content ideas and series that build awareness, trust, community, and excitement ahead of launch.

 - Capture behind-the-scenes content with the HaloBraid team, stylists, community members, product demos, events, and brand moments.

 - Own day-to-day community engagement, including comments, DMs, tagged posts, mentions, and social listening.

 - Track social performance, report on KPIs, and use data to adjust strategy, improve content, and drive growth.

 - Support community events, interviews, creator moments, and brand storytelling across the broader marketing and community team.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, community, influencer marketing, brand marketing, or a related role.

 - Experience creating or growing your own or brand TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or other platform from scratch. 

 - Loves social media, is chronically online and enjoys keeping up with trends.

 - Deep fluency in TikTok, Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and emerging social platforms.

 - Strong short-form video instincts.  You understand hooks, pacing, captions, trends, sounds, memes, and what makes people share.

 - Hands-on content creation experience, including concepting, shooting, editing, writing copy, and posting.

 - Comfortable being on camera and helping others feel comfortable on camera too.

 - Passion for beauty, hair care, hair trends, textured hair, braiding, salons, and community.

 - Strong taste level and an understanding of what feels fresh, premium, funny, culturally relevant, and socially native.

 - Independent, organized, proactive, and excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Work experience at a beauty, hair care, fashion, lifestyle, consumer, or creator-led brand.

 - Experience with CapCut, Canva, Figma, Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Lightroom, or similar tools.
   
   

Working Style

 - Low ego, adaptable, and collaborative spirit

 - Excited to learn in a fast-paced environment

 - Passionate and community drive
   
   

Benefits of Working with Us:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - 100% medical premium coverage

 - Meaningful equity

 - 12 company holidays and unlimited PTO

Remote / Hybrid Work

HaloBraid is based in Cambridge, MA. We have a preference for candidates who are NYC-based candidates who can work remotely day-to-day and travel to Cambridge regularly for team meetings, content shoots, events, and key brand moments.



Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align with every single part of the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, Weather & Aviation
jobs.description:
The Role:

Spire's Weather & Aviation business delivers global weather forecasts, flight tracking, and aviation data to customers who rely on it every day to make operational decisions. As we grow, we're investing in the engineering foundations that keep our platform fast, secure, and dependable at scale.

We're seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer who has helped production systems scale, harden, and stay reliable as usage and expectations grew. You'll own critical services end to end, contribute to the architecture behind our weather and aviation data services, and help raise the engineering bar as we grow. This role suits someone with experience in an established organization with production customers, uptime commitments, and compliance obligations, where a well-designed, observable, recoverable system matters more than the fastest prototype.

What You'll Do as a Senior Backend Software Engineer:

• Build and improve AWS-based backend services with a focus on availability, fault tolerance, and performance as load grows

• Design and implement authentication and authorization features using OIDC and OAuth 2.0, including token handling, service-to-service auth, and access control

• Develop and maintain the REST APIs and streaming endpoints (e.g., WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or Kinesis/Kafka-backed feeds) that deliver Spire's weather and aviation data to customers

• Improve observability across metrics, logging, and tracing, and help define and track SLOs for the services you own

• Share ownership of production operations, including participation in an on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, as part of an engineering team that runs what it builds

• Apply secure engineering practices day to day, and help our systems meet the NIST and ISO/IEC 27001 standards we operate under

• Take the technical lead on projects within your area, from design through rollout

• Mentor other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions

• Contribute to team practices for testing, deployment, infrastructure-as-code, and change management

• Collaborate closely with product owners and data scientists to align backend services with customer and mission needs

• Create and maintain clear documentation for APIs and system architectures

Basic Skills/Qualifications:

• 6+ years' experience in professional backend software development, with significant time operating and scaling production systems that customers rely on

• A track record of taking systems from "working" to "reliable": improving uptime, reducing incidents, and handling growth in data volume, traffic, or customers

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, VPC networking) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation)

• Strong knowledge of OIDC and OAuth 2.0, including identity providers (e.g., Cognito, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak), JWT handling, and secure session and token management

• Experience designing and operating both REST APIs and streaming or real-time data endpoints

• Experience working in environments governed by NIST or ISO/IEC 27001 security standards, with an understanding of how they shape engineering decisions

• Proficiency in Python or another backend language such as Go, Java, or TypeScript/Node.js

• Excellent documentation, collaboration, and communication skills, and comfort making and defending architectural trade-offs

Nice to Have:

• Experience with the Pangeo ecosystem (xarray, Dask, Zarr, Jupyter) or other large-scale scientific and geospatial data tooling

• Background in the weather or aviation domains, including familiarity with data formats such as GRIB2 and NetCDF, aviation products such as METAR/TAF or ADS-B, or regulatory contexts such as the FAA

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Final base salary for this role will be based on the location, skills, experience and qualifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for commissions and annual equity awards. This role is also eligible for our employee benefits program, including vacation, sick, and personal time off; optional medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage; a 401(K) plan; health and wellness reimbursement program; and participation in Spire’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Base Salary Range

$171,000—$202,500 USD

Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire’s data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.

Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. jobs.title: Senior Concept Artist
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

We are looking for a Concept Artist to support the pre-production and visual development of our core game titles, creating concepts and artistic references that help align production teams around a clear visual direction. The role focuses on projects inspired by the visual standards of Disney Speedstorm and Asphalt Legends.

What it means on a daily basis

• Visual Concept Generation: Create character designs and illustrations, including line art and 3D blockouts, in line with project requirements and the distinct visual styles of Asphalt, and Disney.
• Creative Ideation: Generate and develop artistic ideas while maintaining each game's unique visual identity.
• Collaborative Design: Collaborate with fellow artists and designers to develop and enhance the game's visual style.
• Feedback Integration: Work under the Studio Art Director's guidance, iterate on designs based on feedback, and deliver work in line with project goals and timelines.
• Art Asset Planning: Plan the creation of art assets for characters, environments, and props, and clearly communicate the approach and requirements to the relevant team members.

What success will look like

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the projects visual directions and production workflows. After 6 months, you will independently deliver concepts and references that support production decisions. You will also contribute consistently to the evolution of the games' visual identity and support effective collaboration across art and design teams.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with concept artists, artists, designers, and production teams. Your concepts and visual references will support local and international collaborators throughout the production process.

Your recruitment journey

• HR Screen Call: An initial conversation with our HR team.
• First Interview: A 20-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to discuss your previous projects and experience.
• Test: You will have one week to complete a practical test.
• Second Interview: A discussion with the Hiring Manager to review your test, explore your approach in more detail, and share feedback.
• Final Interview: A meeting with the Studio Manager to discuss alignment and answer any remaining questions.

Where this role can take you

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in concept art, explore broader artistic responsibilities, and access development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Demonstrated advanced expertise in concept art or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio
• Advanced proficiency in Photoshop for digital art creation and proficiency with Blender or similar 3D software for concept development.
• Solid ability to produce clear and efficient sketches and develop concepts for characters, environments, and props.
• Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating closely with artists, designers, and production teams
• Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

WHO YOU ARE

• You are comfortable developing ideas and adapting them based on feedback.
• You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different team members.
• You can manage your work independently while contributing to a collaborative creative process.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year
• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card

Benefits

• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• Free language courses
• Birthday day off!
• 1 month of remote work
• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career-development opportunities.
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

jobs.title: Fire Alarm Mechanic
jobs.description:
Copper River Technologies is seeking a qualified Fire Alarm Mechanic to help protect critical facilities, personnel, and property as a Fire Alarm Technician supporting Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Mid-Atlantic (NAVFAC MIDLANT). In this hands-on role, you’ll perform the installation, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair of fire alarm and life safety systems. You’ll work independently to diagnose system issues, restore equipment to proper operation, and ensure fire alarm systems remain reliable and compliant with applicable requirements.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Install, inspect, test, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair fire alarm and life safety systems.

• Work with master fire alarm systems, fire alarm control panels, annunciators, initiating devices, notification appliances, detectors, modules, circuits, and associated equipment.

• Diagnose fire alarm system faults and malfunctions using schematics, wiring diagrams, testing equipment, and manufacturer documentation.

• Perform functional and operational testing of fire alarm systems and components.

• Identify and repair wiring, circuit, device, panel, and system-level issues.

• Replace defective detectors, modules, notification appliances, control components, wiring, and other fire alarm equipment.

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to keep systems operational and reliable.

• Maintain and update fire alarm circuit drawings, system documentation, inspection records, and maintenance records.

• Verify proper system operation following repairs, testing, and adjustments.

• Coordinate with facility personnel and other trades as necessary to troubleshoot and resolve fire alarm system issues.

• Provide technical guidance to junior employees and trainees when assigned.

• Respond to emergency and after-hours fire alarm service calls as required.

• Perform limited electrical work associated with fire alarm systems and related life safety equipment.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Licensure: Valid state driver's license

• Education and Certification: A recognized fire alarm or fire protection qualification, such as NICET, journeyman training, or a comparable credential CPR certification or ability to obtain and maintain certification

• Required Experience: Journeyman-level experience in electrical, electronic, or fire alarm systems Experience troubleshooting and repairing electrical and electronic systems

• Required Skill and Competencies: Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings Journeyman-level experience in fire alarm systems, fire alarm maintenance, or electrical/electronic systems, with significant hands-on fire alarm experience. Demonstrated experience troubleshooting, testing, repairing, and maintaining commercial or industrial fire alarm systems. Working knowledge of fire alarm control panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, circuits, and associated components. Knowledge of applicable fire alarm codes, standards, and maintenance requirements. Preferred: Familiarity with UFC 3-601-02, NFPA 72, and NFPA 25

• Physical Requirements: This is an on-site, hands-on position that may involve working outdoors, in equipment rooms, confined spaces, and at various heights. You should be comfortable lifting up to 40 pounds, climbing ladders, working in tight spaces, and using appropriate personal protective equipment. The role may involve exposure to noise, extreme temperatures, dust, and electrical hazards Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and reaching for extended periods. Using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Additional Requirements Employees must be available to work at assigned sites within their commuting area and may be required to support emergency operations, including after-hours callouts and essential personnel duties Ability to pass a pre-employment and annual physical examination

Responsibilities:

• Estimating and negotiating change orders throughout the construction lifecycle.
• Provide estimate and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan.
• Review and participate with the design services team and general contractor in the development of cost estimates.
• Reconcile changes and assist the general contractor to ensure that their data is accurate.

• Participate effectively with post-contract cost variances and the change of control processes.
• Manage Cost impact / contingency management and commitment tracking logs.
• Prepare funding data presentations and coordinate VE sessions with stakeholders.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Security Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

TENEX is an AI-native, automation-first, built-for-scale Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider. We are a force multiplier for defenders, helping organizations enhance their cybersecurity posture through advanced threat detection, rapid response, and continuous protection. Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

We’re a fast growing startup backed by industry experts and top tier investors led by Crosspoint Capital Partners and also backed by Shield Capital, DTCP (formerly Deutsche Telekom Capital Partners), Deepwork Capital, and the Florida Opportunity Fund. Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you’ll play a meaningful role in defining and building our culture. Get in on the ground floor. We’re a small but well-funded team that just raised a substantial round – joining now comes with limited risk and unlimited upside.

Culture is one of the most important things at TENEX.AI http://TENEX.AI—explore our culture deck at culture.tenex.ai http://culture.tenex.ai to witness how we embody it, prioritizing the irreplaceable collaboration and community of in-person work.

Reporting to Software Engineering, the Forward Deployed Security Automation Engineer owns the integration layer between our AI agents and the security platforms they work with. You will deploy and maintain SIEM, SOAR, and EDR environments across a wide range of vendors, and build the software, automated response workflows, and internal tooling that connect them.

Location: San Jose, CA or Overland Park, KS. We will require 4 days onsite M-TH. 

You will:

 - Operate security platforms across vendors: Deploy, configure, and maintain sandboxes of SIEM, SOAR, and EDR environments across vendors such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and Google SecOps. Manage prevention policies, host groups, custom IOAs, and exclusions on EDR platforms, detection content on SIEM platforms, and connectors on SOAR platforms.

 - Resolve platform issues: Troubleshoot and resolve EDR agent problems across our environments, managing performance impacts, kernel or driver conflicts, upgrade rollouts, and false positive tuning.

 - Build production software: Develop, test, and deploy production Python services (not just scripts). Manage the full lifecycle including APIs, workers, queues, tests, CI, and containers.

 - Automate detection and response: Partner with other teams in engineering to build automated containment or remediation workflows, including host isolation, process kills, file quarantine, account disabling, and ticket creation.

 - Design safety guardrails: Architect strict guardrails on automated response actions—this is the strongest signal of success in the role. You will build approval thresholds, allow lists for critical hosts, rate limits on isolation actions, audit trails, and safe release or rollback paths.

 - Own the platform in production: Take end-to-end ownership of the platform's reliability and latency outcomes (such as time from alert to containment), and participate in the on-call rotation for security tooling.

 - Build internal tooling: Create and maintain tools utilized by other teams, ensuring they are observable by debugging your own software with logging, metrics, or alerting you put in place.



Requirements:

 - Deep, hands-on experience operating multiple SIEM/SOAR/EDR platforms

 - Proven software engineering experience building and maintaining production Python services and APIs.

 - Experience integrating with complex vendor APIs and managing auth, rate limits, and retries.

 - Demonstrated experience building automated detection and response workflows with carefully designed safety guardrails.

 - Track record of taking end-to-end production ownership of a platform, rather than just a component.



Nice-to-haves:

 - Experience managing multi-tenant EDR structures

 - Proficiency in Go and/or Python

 - Detection-as-code experience (rules in version control, testing, CI deployment).

 - Background working at MDR/MSSP providers, SOAR vendors, EDR vendor engineering teams, or on the detection and response teams of security-mature technology companies.




EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 - Relevant certifications (AWS/GCP Professional Engineer, Kubernetes, or security-related credentials) are a plus.



Why Join Us?

 - Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI-driven cybersecurity technologies and Google SecOps solutions.

 - Collaborate with a talented and innovative team focused on continuously improving security operations.

 - Competitive salary and benefits package.

 - A culture of growth and development, with opportunities to expand your knowledge in AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.
   
   

If you're passionate about combining cybersecurity expertise with artificial intelligence and have experience with Google SecOps and Chronicle, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Director, Cost Accounting
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Dyne Therapeutics is focused on delivering functional improvement for people living with genetically driven neuromuscular diseases. We are developing therapeutics that target muscle and the central nervous system (CNS) to address the root cause of disease. The company is advancing clinical programs for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) and myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) as well as preclinical programs for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), Pompe disease and multiple DMD mutations. At Dyne, we are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. Learn more at https://www.dyne-tx.com/, and follow us on X, LinkedIn and Facebook.

Role Summary:

The Director, Inventory / Cost Accounting leads Dyne’s inventory and cost accounting strategy and established the financial infrastructure required to support commercial launch and continued portfolio growth. This role owns the development, implementation and governance of cost accounting processes, inventory valuation, and related controls across clinical and commercial products manufactured through third-party CMOs and CDMOs.. The Director serves as the company’s subject matter expert for inventory and cost accounting, providing strategic guidance on product costs, capitalization, reserves, gross margin, and complex accounting judgments.  This highly visible role influences business decisions by translating manufacturing and supply chain activity into clear financial insights and recommendations for senior leadership.

The Director partners closely with Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, external manufacturing partners, and auditors to ensure accurate, scalable, and audit-ready processes. This role sets priorities, directs cross-functional initiatives, and develops the capabilities and resources needed to support Dyne’s transition from clinical development to a multi-product commercial organization.

This is a full-time position based in Waltham, MA without the possibility of being remote.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

Cost Accounting & Costing Methodology

• Develop, implement, and maintain cost models for commercial product(s) manufactured through third-party CMOs/CDMOs

• Establish and maintain bill of materials (BOM) and routing cost structures in collaboration with Supply Chain and Technical Operations

• Perform periodic cost updates and manufacturing/production variance analysis

• Analyze and report on cost of goods sold (COGS)

Inventory Accounting

• Own inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, clinical supply, and finished goods held at third-party locations

• Direct the period-end inventory and accounting close, ensuring accurate reporting, appropriate review, and timely resolution of issues

• Manage inventory reserve methodology and perform periodic assessments

• Manage physical inventory counts and cycle count programs across CMOs,CDMOs, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers

• Determine and document appropriate accounting treatment for inventory used across clinical and commercial operations

CMO/CDMO Cost Management

• Serve as the finance leader for cost-related aspects of CMO/CDMO relationships, including invoice review, cost true-ups, and technical transfer cost accounting

• Partner with Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Commercial Operations, and FP&A to incorporate cost insights into operating plans, forecasts, launch decisions, and gross margin strategy.

• Support cost impact analysis for manufacturing process changes, scale-up activities, and technology transfers

Financial Reporting & Controls

• Establish and maintain a scalable control environment for inventory and cost accounting that complies with U.S. GAAP, SOX requirements, and public company standards

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting analyses and reporting packages for FP&A and senior leadership

• Design and maintain internal controls over inventory and cost accounting processes

• Partner with the Corporate Controller on technical accounting memos related to inventory capitalization, cost absorption, and related judgments

Cross-Functional Partnership & Process Building

• Act as a key finance partner to Supply Chain, Technical Operations, and Commercial Operations teams

• Build scalable cost accounting processes, systems, and reporting tools appropriate for a growing commercial-stage company

• Support ERP system configuration and enhancements related to cost accounting and inventory modules

• Provide cost-related input to gross-to-net, gross margin analysis, and product profitability reporting

Education and Skills Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA required

• 10+ years of progressive cost accounting experience, including at least 3-5 years in a leadership/managerial capacity

• Direct experience with cost accounting in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences manufacturing environment

• Experience managing cost accounting for products manufactured through CMOs/CDMOs (outsourced manufacturing model)

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP as it relates to inventory, standard costing, and COGS

• Experience with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and cost accounting/inventory modules

• Advanced Excel skills; experience building cost models

• Experience supporting a commercial product launch and scaling cost accounting processes from a pre-commercial or early-commercial stage

• Experience with SOX compliance and public company reporting requirements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable building processes from the ground up

• Excellent cross-functional communication and ability to translate operational activity into financial impact

• High attention to detail balanced with the ability to operate in ambiguity typical of an early-commercial company

#LI-Onsite

MA Pay Range

$200,000—$230,000 USD

The pay range reflects the base pay range Dyne reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Individual compensation depends on factors such as education, experience, job-related knowledge, and demonstrated skills.

This is a highly visible role that partners closely with Commercial, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure accurate, timely, and well-controlled revenue accounting as the company scales. The ideal candidate has deep industry revenue accounting experience, including hands-on knowledge of gross-to-net estimates unique to the specialty pharmaceutical industry.

Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting

Gross-to-Net (GTN) Accounting

• Implement, maintain, and continuously refine GTN estimation models covering rebates, chargebacks, distribution fees, prompt-pay discounts, returns, and copay/patient assistance programs.

• Partner with Market Access, Trade, and Commercial teams to ensure GTN assumptions reflect current contracts and market dynamics.

• Monitor actual-to-estimate variances and true up accruals as new data becomes available.

Controls, Compliance & Audit

• Implement and maintain SOX-compliant internal controls over the revenue and GTN accrual process.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors on all revenue-related matters; manage audit requests and support technical accounting positions.

• Ensure compliance with relevant SEC reporting requirements (10-Q/10-K revenue disclosures).

Cross-Functional Partnership & Reporting

• Partner with FP&A to support revenue forecasting, budgeting, and board/investor reporting.

• Collaborate with Commercial Operations and Supply Chain on distributor/specialty pharmacy inventory data (channel inventory, sell-through) used in revenue and GTN calculations.

• Present revenue and GTN results to senior leadership, including trend analysis and risk commentary.

Process & Systems

• Lead the evaluation and implementation of systems/tools to automate revenue and GTN accounting as sales volume grows (e.g., contract management, rebate management software, ERP revenue modules).

• Build and document scalable processes as the company transitions from pre-commercial to multi-product commercial operations.

• Manage external vendors supporting the end-to-end revenue cycle.

Education and Skills Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA required.

• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant time in biotech/pharmaceutical revenue accounting.

• Big 4 public accounting background and industry experience strongly preferred.

• Deep, hands-on experience with gross-to-net accounting (rebates, chargebacks, distribution fees, copay programs) in a specialty or branded pharma setting.

• Strong technical knowledge of ASC 606 and its application to pharmaceutical product sales.

• Experience designing and operating 404B SOX-compliant controls.

• Experience working with distributors, specialty pharmacies, and/or GPOs and interpreting channel data.

• Experience with rebate/contract management systems and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite)

• Experience in a company scaling from single-product launch to multi-product portfolio.

#LI-Onsite

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to join our team in supporting our strategic growth initiatives and enterprise capability development in McLean, VA.

• U.S. citizen
• Ten years experience leading technical solution development for large, complex federal pursuits
• Must be on-site in McLean, VA every Wednesday; local candidates preferred

The Principal Solutions Architect will play a key leadership role in designing innovative, mission-driven solutions that help our customers solve complex challenges across the federal and defense sectors. Partnering closely with capture, proposal, business development, engineering, and operations teams, you will shape winning technical strategies, influence growth initiatives, and drive the development of differentiated solutions that deliver real mission impact.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic technologist who thrives at the intersection of innovation and execution. The ideal candidate brings broad expertise across enterprise IT, cloud, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, AI/ML, automation, and modernization initiatives, along with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into practical, mission-enabling capabilities. Your insights and technical leadership will directly support high-priority pursuits, corporate growth objectives, and the advancement of next-generation solutions for our customers.

Job Responsibilities:

• Lead the development of innovative, compliant, and executable technical solutions supporting strategic federal and defense opportunities.
• Serve as the technical lead for priority captures and proposals, partnering with capture, business development, proposal, operational, and engineering teams.
• Translate customer mission requirements into differentiated technical architectures, delivery strategies, and scalable operational solutions.
• Drive technical solutioning sessions, architecture reviews, and collaborative workshops with internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure proposed solutions balance innovation, technical maturity, operational feasibility, cost realism, and competitive differentiation.
• Support the evolution of our company's technical capabilities, service offerings, and strategic technology roadmaps.
• Identify and assess emerging technologies, market trends, and mission requirements to support corporate growth objectives.
• Develop reusable solution components and standardized approaches that improve delivery efficiency, scalability, and competitive positioning.
• Provide technical leadership across cloud, cybersecurity, AI/ML, automation, DevSecOps, digital modernization, and enterprise IT transformation initiatives.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications aligned with customer missions and business priorities.
• Communicate complex technical concepts to executives, engineers, customers, and non-technical stakeholders.
• Represent the company as a trusted technical advisor during customer engagements, technical exchanges, oral presentations, and strategic growth activities.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

• U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline (advanced degree preferred).
• Ten (10+) years of experience in solutions architecture, enterprise architecture, systems engineering, or related technical leadership roles.
• Demonstrated experience leading technical solution development for large, complex federal pursuits.
• Experience supporting DoD, Navy, Federal Civilian, or other federal agency environments.
• Proven experience developing technical strategies and solutions aligned to federal mission and modernization objectives.
• Deep familiarity with enterprise technologies, cloud ecosystems, cybersecurity principles, DevSecOps practices, data architectures, and emerging technology trends.
• Experience collaborating with capture, proposal, business development, and operational teams in a federal contracting environment.
• Experience developing differentiated technical approaches and competitive solution strategies.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage executive leadership, customers, and technical teams.

Preferred:

• Active Secret Clearance.
• Experience supporting large federal growth organizations and strategic capture programs.
• Experience with cloud modernization, cybersecurity transformation, AI/ML, DevSecOps, and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
• Experience supporting high-value, competitive federal pursuits and proposal efforts.
• Ability to serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, customers, and growth teams.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation incentive program, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V. We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Accounting
jobs.description:
ServiceNow is seeking a Manager, Technical Accounting, to join our Technical Accounting team in our next phase of growth. This is a high-visibility position that will play an important role in researching and documenting a wide variety of complex technical accounting matters, supporting purchase accounting for an active M&A pipeline, and other related topics. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders throughout the Company to support the successful execution of key initiatives within the Finance organization. This role will report to the Director, Technical Accounting, who reports to the Sr. Director, Technical Accounting and M&A. The Sr. Director has responsibility for all technical accounting matters and leads Finance’s M&A process from diligence through integration.

What you get to do in this role:

• Research and prepare technical accounting memos documenting the Company’s technical accounting issues and conclusions, supported by authoritative US GAAP guidance; support the presentation and resolution of the Company’s positions on critical accounting issues with internal leadership and external auditors

• Monitor and assess new accounting pronouncements applicable to the Company; partner with stakeholders to analyze the impact and support implementation

• Key contributor throughout the M&A process, supporting pre-letter of intent review, financial diligence, purchase accounting, and valuation, as well as post-close accounting integration

• Develop and apply deep technical knowledge in areas such as business combinations, investment accounting, goodwill and intangible asset impairment testing, accounting for share-based compensation programs, revenue accounting matters (e.g., payments to a customer, gross versus net), and hedge accounting, amongst a variety of other complex accounting areas

• Draft and review SEC disclosures on relevant technical accounting topics

• Execute the quarterly and year-end close process for technical accounting matters, including preparation of journal entries, reconciliations, and SEC disclosure support

• Be a trusted business partner and advisor to various stakeholders within Accounting, Finance, Legal, Corporate Development, and other cross-functional teams

• Take initiative for process improvements to scale and optimize the technical accounting process, including the implementation of AI initiatives

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of effective global accounting policies, processes, procedures, and internal controls

• Serve as a day-to-day technical accounting contact for external auditors, supporting resolution of complex accounting matters

• Support special projects and workflow process improvements

• Involvement in the SEC reporting process to help ensure the financial statements are in compliance with US GAAP

To be successful in this role you have:

• Total experience of minimum 6 years, including Big Four public accounting experience and/or technical accounting experience at a public company

• BS/BA degree in Finance or Accounting and active CPA license is required

• Manager role in a Big Four public accounting firm and/or technical accounting role at a public company

• Positive, service-oriented attitude, highly motivated to learn and to make an impact within the organization

• Experience mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members; prior team leadership experience is a plus

• Strong technical accounting background with a knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting standards, and SOX 404, as well as experience performing technical research and preparing technical accounting memos

• Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills

• Relationship builder across all levels of the organization

• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Corporate Development) on technical accounting positions without direct authority

• Strong organizational skills to manage numerous workstreams at once and complete work timely

• Self-starter and a great team member

• Proactive approach to identifying root causes and implementing durable solutions, including escalation when appropriate

• Ability to be flexible and work analytically in a dynamic environment

• Meticulous and superior attention to detail

• Strong Excel knowledge

• Familiarity with emerging AI tools for accounting automation is valued

• Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems is a plus

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $126,800 - $198,150, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Solar Landscape is the leading commercial rooftop solar developer in the U.S. Only 4% of commercial rooftops host solar today — we’re changing that, fast. jobs.description:

Duluth, GA - Hybrid 3 days per week

Must be currently enrolled full time in a university degree program pursing a bachelor, master, or PhD degree.  (MSEE preferred) Must not have graduated before September 2027.

Renesas is looking for a talented individual for their memory interface products. These memory interface products mainly go to datacenters for AI and cloud computing, providing the highest bandwidth for intensive computing while consuming low power. This exciting role is responsible for the development of digital sections of leading-edge memory data buffer chips for DDR5, DDR6 and beyond.

• Be able to integrate and test on System-level and block level using UVM methodology
• Support in developing verification plan based on specifications.
• Support in Verification planning, maintenance, feature extraction, verification tests, coverage and checker development.
• Develop efficient, reusable state-of-the-art verification environments and testbench structures.
• Optimize solutions for key indicators such as reusability, performance and ease of use
• Identify and communicate improvements that may ease verification and/or improve design behavior.
• Support in optimizing UVM based testbench.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the Memory interface products verification effort, including defining the verification strategy, developing test plans, coverage, and executing tests.
• Drive and quality control the creation of a verification test plan.
• Work closely with the design team to ensure that the design meets the requirements and is testable.
• Identify and drive improvements to the verification process to ensure the highest levels of quality and efficiency.
• Drive and monitor coverage of design verification.
• Provide regular updates to management on the status of the verification effort.

• Must be currently enrolled full time in a university degree program pursing a bachelor, master, or PhD degree. (MSEE preferred) Must not have graduated before September 2027.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Operations (Warehouse & Materials) - 2nd shift
jobs.description:
Axogen is committed to building and maintaining a strong and gratifying company culture that fosters professional growth. Our hands-on and personal approach makes transitioning to a new job a seamless and enjoyable process. Most benefits are effective on day one!

Axogen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Why you’ll love working at Axogen:

• Friendly, open, and fun team culture that values unique perspectives

• Company-wide dedication to profoundly impacting patients’ lives

• Comprehensive, high-quality benefits package effective on date of hire

• Educational assistance available for all employees

• Matching 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays, including floating holidays, to be used at your discretion

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Referral incentive program

Axogen Mission and Business Purpose

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by making restoration of peripheral nerve function an expected standard of care. We aim to lead the markets we serve by always requiring the solutions we offer patients and caregivers provide an improved benefit-to-risk profile as compared to existing standards of care. To ensure we deliver improved benefit-to-risk solutions, we will guide and expect the market and design requirement specifications underlying our engineering, business development, and clinical research activities, objectively target advancements in standards of care.

Job Summary of the Operations Supervisor

The Operations Supervisor is a shop floor leader for the growing Axogen Processing Center Operation. The scope includes a varying level of direct reports of several different job titles. Key accountabilities include day to day management of the shop floor personnel, executing the production schedule, ensuring all product is produced in a manner meeting safety and quality requirements and hiring and retaining a talented workforce. Ensures that the activities being performed in an area of responsibility is respectful of the gift of life, protects patient safety, and meets quality standards.

Requirements of the Operations Supervisor

• Available to work 1st shift (Monday - Friday, 3pm - 1130pm EST)

• High School Diploma required, with a minimum of 3+ years of experience in a regulated manufacturing environment (FDA regulated industry preferred).

• Bachelor’s or Associate’s Degree preferred.

• Experience leadership ability and experience coaching, leading and managing teams and individuals.

• An aptitude for understanding process technology, manufacturing equipment, and packaging equipment.

• Candidate must be flexible and respond positively to constantly changing conditions, priorities, situations, and personnel to meet varying department goals and production schedule adjustments.

• Highly motivated self-starter, able to identify what needs to be done, and then reliably see this work through to successful outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization with strong interpersonal, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Excellent leadership, documentation, and multi-tasking skills.

• Analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Understand the importance of quality management systems.

• GMP, Tissue Processing, Cleaning and Sterilization, and/or distribution experience a plus.

• Continuous Improvement experience such as, lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, DMAIC methodology experience.

Responsibilities of the Operations Supervisor

The specific duties of the Operations Supervisor include but are not limited to:

• Supervises employees and contractors who are engaged in the production and support functions related to a tissue biologic product in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), and federal, state, and local regulations.

• Responsible for effective leadership of the work team which includes managing the daily operation ensuring that applicable safety guidelines and policies are followed; ensuring production SOP’s are upheld, and production schedules are met.

• Relays all new or revised policies, procedures and processes to shift leads and personnel in a timely manner to ensure they have the most up-to-date and current information regarding operation, policy, procedural changes.

• Resolves problems, issues, and concerns at the lowest level possible by establishing an effective communication exchange between him/herself and all personnel at every tier. This should occur initially when problems arise, not in concurrence or thereafter.

• Assess and records individual and team training while working with the Senior Supervisor and/or Manager to develop a plan of action to eliminate gaps, discrepancies, and past due training to always remain in compliance.

• Assists the Senior Supervisor and Manager to hire, transfer, promote, discharge, discipline, and delegate assignments for assigned employees with the assistance of Human Resources.

• Identifies practices that are/are not working, make recommendations to Senior Supervisor to sustain/correct and aid to resolve the matter(s).

• Responsible for one-on-one meetings with direct reports, which include counseling and supporting developmental success, supporting all colleagues to enable them to reach their full potential, and to provide corrective action when necessary.

• Ensure each team member is engaged with an ownership mentality and feels their work is valued, appreciated, and meaningful to the success of the Axogen Processing Center and Axogen as a whole.

• Must be able to cover call schedule, to include holidays, as assigned.

• Other duties as assigned.

Location

913 Industrial Drive Place, Vandalia, OH  45377

#LI-AC1

Benefits/Compensation

This position is eligible for shift differential pay.

This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits offered for this position include Health, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Paid Time Off, 9 Paid Holidays + 3 Floating Holidays, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Medical Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Caregiver Leave, Basic Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Disability Insurance, as described in more detail in summary plan descriptions.

Salary Range

$63,030—$78,786 USD

Company Statements

Axogen follows healthcare system guidelines with respect to credentialing, vaccinations and other employment/compliance related requirements, as well as CDC guidance. Axogen reserves the right to amend its policies from time to time in its sole discretion.

As AI is becoming a common tool throughout the application process, we want to be clear about its appropriate use at Axogen. Using AI to support resume writing, research or interview preparation is perfectly acceptable, provided the content is accurate and genuinely represents your qualifications and skills. For other key parts of your interview process, however, it is important that the ideas, communication, and work you share reflect your own voice, experiences, and thinking. We ask that you participate in our live interviews and complete any assessments without AI assistance unless instructions explicitly indicate otherwise or a specific exception is discussed and approved in advance. This approach ensures fairness, celebrates your individuality, and allows your authentic perspective to shine. Behaviors that do not align with these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process or termination of employment if later discovered. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to learning about the unique contributions only you can bring to Axogen.

jobs.title: Senior, ML Engineer - Tracking
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team:
Accurate and highly available information about other actors and objects is fundamental to the safe operation of autonomous trucks. Core capabilities depend on accurate tracking estimates to ensure safe and efficient vehicle behavior.
The Tracking Team develops the ML models, state estimation algorithms, and production software responsible for associating and estimating the kinematics of other actors and objects in real time. Our solutions fuse information from multiple sensors and maintain robust performance despite sensor imperfections, environmental challenges, and system degradation. As part of this team, you will develop and deploy production-ready tracking solutions and help solve the challenges of bringing autonomous vehicle technology to real-world commercial applications.

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and deploy production ML models for mulit-object tracking, including association, learned pose and kinematic estimation, and sensor fusion using camera, LiDAR, radar, and other vehicle sensors.

• Develop scalable training and evaluation workflows using PyTorch, distributed training infrastructure, and large-scale real-world datasets.

• Design and improve tracking and sensor fusion algorithms for robust vehicle pose and kinematics

• Analyze large-scale vehicle data to characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive model and system improvements.

• Develop robust, efficient production software in modern C++ and Python across the full development lifecycle.

• Define evaluation, verification, and validation strategies to ensure Tracking quality, robustness, and safety across diverse operating conditions.

• Make technical design and architecture decisions, balancing model performance, computational efficiency, robustness, and production constraints.

• Collaborate with perception, mapping, planning, controls, and platform teams to deliver integrated autonomous driving capabilities.

• Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and development of engineering best practices.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience, or a PhD with 1+ year of relevant industry experience.

• Experience with AV or robotics perception systems (tracking, detection, SLAM, scen modeling, ect.).

• Strong experience developing and deploying ML models for perception, localization, or sensor fusion domains.

• Proficiency with PyTorch and modern ML tooling for training, inference, and optimization.

• Solid understanding of 3D geometry, probabilistic estimation, coordinate transforms, and robotics fundamentals.

• Demonstrated ability to work with large multimodal datasets and build scalable pipelines for processing, labeling, and evaluation.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and C++, including algorithms, data structures, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively on cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points

• Experience with state estimation techniques such as factor graphs, Kalman filtering, nonlinear optimization, or related probabilistic estimation methods.

• Familiarity with distributed computing tools such as Ray, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration frameworks.

• Knowledge of embedded and real-time constraints for on-vehicle deployment.

• Experience in simulation, synthetic data generation, and uncertainty-aware ML modeling.

• Contributions to open-source robotics, perception, or ML frameworks.

• Familiarity with functional safety standards and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262.

jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

The Role

Group Director, Client Partner

The tl;dr: You’ll be the beating heart of one of DEPT® 's Paid Social strategy and activation teams to one of the world’s most iconic brands in the social media space. At DEPT®, we don't just fill roles, we create careers. If you're ready to redefine what Paid Social strategy and activation looks like for brand awareness media leadership, we'd love to meet you.

We’re hiring a Group Director, Client Partner to be at the heart of the operation for one of our flagship global partnerships to drive brand awareness and user influence in the social media space. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of changing user’s brand perceptions, has an affinity with pushing the barriers around topics such as brand lift studies and user influence. This person is someone who thrives on partnering closer with both Paid Social strategists and activation teams to drive end-to-end media excellence and redefine how user awareness is achieved and measured.

As a Group Director, you oversee a team of extremely passionate, qualified and experienced Paid Social awareness specialists. You are the connecting tissue between the sheer brainpower of the specialists and the strategic lead(s) on the client, ensuring alignment with the client’s vision. You drive incremental influence and user awareness leveraging Meta Ads, and have a deep understanding of Paid Social strategy, test methodologies, and thrive on out-of-the box thinking to disrupt best practices.

To achieve your goals in this role, you will maintain senior-level agency relationships with the client’s counterparts and consult on the best path forward to achieve tactical goals developed in relation to the client vision with the other cross-channel leads. Furthermore, you have experience building top-of-class teams and processes to adapt to client needs fast.

You are experienced in consulting for varied clients in the digital marketing space, inclusive but not limited to public affairs, retail, technology, and user privacy. You are capable of influencing user perception leveraging targeting and creatives within DEPT®’s Paid Social offering.

Success in this role after 12 months looks like:

• You’ve built strong relationships with key client stakeholders and your DEPT team, and are seen as the go-to expert for all things Paid Social strategy and activation.

• Your team is firing on all cylinders, delivering consistently excellent performance across Meta Ads with clarity, accountability, and collaboration.

• You’ve successfully launched an expanded team and broken down silos across the entire planning and activation process, ensuring we are at the forefront of all applicable conversations.

• You have successfully positioned yourself and team as partners as not order takers, identifying and building processes and documentation to better help unify the clients businesses, eliminating individual business silos and more continuity across campaigns.

• You’re helping the client push the edge of what’s possible whether through a new targeting model, a measurement approach, or new platform feature.

• You’re laying the groundwork for the next chapter, whether that’s deeper measurement, test and learn roadmaps, and bold POVs on how the client can drive the strongest brand lift possible.

• You’ve successfully helped support the team in navigating up to twelve different sub-units within the clients business at once and can work autonomously on larger initiatives.

Key responsibilities & Essential duties (Other duties may be assigned)

• Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of awareness focused Paid Social programs across Meta Ads; partnering with specialist leads to ensure executional excellence and innovation.

• Co-create and drive the global Paid Social roadmap for the client in close collaboration with DEPT® strategists, project managers, and media planners based in the United States and United Kingdom.

• Act as a senior lead across all client and internal touchpoints, ensuring seamless integration of processes and updates across teams in the United States and United Kingdom for a variety of different audiences inclusive of consumer and some B2B.

• Oversee the teams that translate brand and product strategy into activation plans that drive measurable outcomes, especially in awareness and consideration.

• Lead the integration of brand lift study data and results into broader marketing and performance strategies, tying these types of data points to business impact.

• Work closely with client stakeholders across Paid Social strategy, media planning, activation, and marketing stakeholders media to align on budgets, KPIs, and evolving changes in planned versus delivered outcomes.

• Be the strategic voice within the cross-functional team, advocating for its role in shaping category leadership.

• Own and nurture senior-level client relationships; become a trusted partner that is not just focused on short term commercial success but a long lasting partnership.

• Provide resourcing recommendations and continuously monitor the effectiveness and bandwidth of the team (in collaboration with Project Manager).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

What you bring & your qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in consumer media or performance marketing ideally at a leading agency, consultancy, or platform.

• Deep understanding of Paid Social mechanics and how audience, creative, and measurement impact each other.

• Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams of specialists with accountability for strategy, performance, and operational quality.

• Ability to confidently navigate client-side marketing, measurement, and planning teams, providing strategic clarity and earning trust.

• An analytical mindset with experience using data to tell stories, inform decisions, and optimize investments.

• Collaborative, empathetic leadership style with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and shared outcomes.

• Experience working with complex, matrixed client orgs with multiple stakeholders and objectives.

• Profound comprehension of brand lift studies: what they are, how to properly assess set-up, measurement, and how to translate learnings into tests or future iterations.

• Extensive knowledge on Meta Ads activation and strategy: current best practices, up and coming features, and the ability to view a campaign and identify improvement opportunities.

• Willingness to travel to client sites on a quarterly basis.

Bonus points if you:

• Experience working across multi-market or global accounts, with fluency in regional dynamics.

• Have partnered with internal teams located in different regional markets (EX: United Kingdom) to drive cohesive processes and alignment on narratives around new innovations, process updates, etc.

• Bring experience navigating the consumer marketing category and understand how to reach users based on known and desired brand perception.

• Are passionate about building team culture, mentoring others, and raising the bar in how awareness media is perceived and executed.

• Thrive in disrupting media best practices to craft unique learnings and best practices at a client and business unit level.

Education/Experience: 10+ years of media activation, in a digital marketing and brand awareness focused environment with brand lift studies at the forefront. Bachelor's degree or equivalent degree of education relevant to the industry.

Language Ability: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.  Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.  Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

Supervisory Responsibilities: The Group Director, Client Partner may directly supervise employees on the strategy and Paid Social activation teams. They carry out supervisory responsibilities by following the organization’s policies and applicable laws.  Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our  benefits package:

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401k plan, plus matching

• PTO

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work.  Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

For more than 50 years, ENSCO has been providing leading-edge engineering, science and advanced technology solutions to governments and private industries worldwide.

ENSCO prides itself in creating and applying advanced technologies for mission success. We provide systems engineering, integration, and advanced technology services to transform the future safety, security, and resiliency of critical missions on the ground, in the air, in space, and in the information systems that connect these domains.

Position Description

ENSCO, Inc. is seeking a Scientific Data Analyst with direct experience in analytics regarding time series data sets and all source analysis. The successful candidate must be able to understand waveform propagation, data fusion, and be able to apply it to conduct analysis of data sets. Demonstrated understanding of digital signal processing, mathematics and in-depth knowledge of time series analytical expertise is required.

ENSCO's Mission System Group (MSG) Division provides innovative customized products and services vital to national safety and security. A primary focus area is the development of software systems for multipurpose geophysical and other data collection, processing, and analysis.

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience + Minimum 3 years' experience as a 9S100 seismic analyst in the United States Air Force

• Demonstrated experience in seismo-acoustic waveform analysis and experience using seismo-acoustic analysis software such as ARS (Analyst Review Station), Geotool/Seatools, SAC (Seismic Analysis Code).

• Detailed understanding of local, regional, and teleseismic seismic phases.

• Understanding of digital signal processing including spectral analysis.

• Observational ability to interpret time series waveform data, identify seismic, infrasonic, and hydroacoustic phases, distinguish signals from background noise.

• A self-starter with excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Experience navigating within the Linux environment
