jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
About Flamingo

Flamingo is an award-winning body, hair, and care brand delivering high-performance, thoughtfully designed products at an accessible price. Since launching in 2018, we’ve become the #3 player in women’s shave in the U.S. and expanded our assortment to offer products for every routine: razors, wax steps for face and body, shave gel, and body lotion. Our products and campaigns have been covered by Vogue, Vanity Fair, Elle, and InStyle, and we’ve won major beauty accolades from Allure  and Essence. With a mission to empower women, Flamingo is committed to partnering with nonprofit partners working to help women and girls build healthy relationships with their bodies and has helped connect over 200K people to quality mental health and wellbeing resources.

Flamingo is part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,”  the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.

We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.

About the Team

The Regulatory team is responsible for the compliance of Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume and Mando brand products. The Regulatory team works cross-functionally and across all geographies to advise on all regulatory issues.

About the Role:

The Regulatory Affairs Manager will serve as a key contributor to the Regulatory Affairs team, owning end-to-end regulatory strategy and compliance across our product portfolios. This role is responsible for both bringing new products to market and maintaining compliance throughout the product lifecycle for our current markets, as well as any new international markets. The ideal candidate is a proactive regulatory professional who can translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable business guidance and partner seamlessly with cross-functional teams to keep launches on track.

What you will accomplish:

• Lead regulatory review of new product launches across cosmetic, OTC, and general product categories- evaluating formula compliance, artwork accuracy, labeling requirements, and claims substantiation prior to market release.

• Own OTC drug product listing registration, annual renewals, and establishment documentation

• Oversee domestic and international registration and compliance activities

• Support post-market activities, including change control, product reformulations, and ongoing compliance monitoring throughout the product lifecycle.

• Monitor, interpret, and communicate new and evolving regulatory requirements across all target markets, translating changes into practical business impact and strategic guidance for cross-functional stakeholders.

• Lead regulatory market entry strategy for new countries- researching cosmetic regulations, registration pathways, labeling requirements, and ingredient restrictions to enable successful product launches.

• Provide competitive intelligence reporting from a regulatory perspective to inform product and business strategy.

• Respond to regulatory inquiries from internal and external partners.

• Partner closely with internal teams and external regulatory partners to ensure compliance across the supply chain.

• Review documentation for accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance across product lines.

• Develop, implement, and maintain regulatory SOPs and internal processes

Experience and Qualifications:

• B.S. in Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

• 3+ years of regulatory affairs experience in the cosmetic, personal care, or consumer products industry.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. and international cosmetic and personal care regulatory requirements, including FDA, MoCRA, Health Canada, EU Cosmetics Regulation, UK Cosmetics Regulation, and other applicable global market requirements.

• Hands-on experience with OTC drug regulatory requirements, including product listing, establishment registration, and annual renewals.

• Demonstrated track record supporting new product development, launch readiness, lifecycle management, and change control activities.

• Proven ability to monitor evolving regulations and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable guidance for cross-functional teams.

This Should Describe You:

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Clear, confident communicator, able to distill complex regulatory topics for non-regulatory audiences at all levels of the organization.

• Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to flex as priorities shift.

• Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively across diverse teams.

Here’s Who You’ll Work With:

• Reporting to the Head of Regulatory Affairs

• You’ll be a team member of the Regulatory Team

• Cross-functional partners include Program Management, Product Development, Brand, Design, Retail, Sourcing, and Legal.

• External partners include regulatory consultants and contract manufacturers.

Benefits and perks

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401k match

• Equity in Mammoth Brands

• Flexible time off and working hours

• L&D stipend

• 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years

• 20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood

• Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop

• Free products from our family of brands

The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Our beautiful 70,000 square foot SoHo office is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday.  Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!

We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. That said, our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive set of benefits and our equity program. The base salary hiring range for this position is $120,000-$150,000, but the final compensation offer will ultimately be based on the candidate’s location, skill level and experience.

Mammoth Brands is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do great work together.

Mammoth Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We recruit, hire and promote into all job levels the most qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), parental status, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, transgender status, sexual orientation, marital, family or partnership status, political affiliation or activities, military service, domestic violence victim status, arrest/conviction record, sexual or reproductive health decisions, caregiver status, credit history immigration status, unemployment status, traits historically associated with race, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles or any other status protected under applicable federal, state and local laws. Mammoth Brands' commitment to providing equal employment opportunities extends to all aspects of employment, including job assignment, compensation, discipline and access to benefits and training.

We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our company.

If visa sponsorship is required for work authorization, please note that Mammoth Brands in collaboration with immigration counsel will manage and submit all necessary legal filings on behalf of the candidate.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator (RN)
jobs.description:
Position Objective:

Coordinates the activities of the nursing service and other departments; provides clinical expertise and oversees management activities during his/her shift in consultation with the Unit Manager/Director for that unit, when appropriate. Provides direction for problem solving in nursing and in other departments during the absence of their supervisor. This individual will provide direct and indirect patient care and may have to rotate various shifts within a 24-hour period.

Essential Job Duties:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Directs hospital operations on assigned shifts by maintaining effective working relationships with and between departments.

• Ensures that staffing coincides with patient census and acuity.

• Enters assignments, call outs, and cancellations for the Flex Nursing Unit in the electronic scheduling system.

• Effectively implements the nursing process based on the Staff Nurse job description to provide care to patients.

• Demonstrates competency to provide age related care specific to the patient populations of the initiative

• Participates in compliance and implements AAMC policies and procedures.

• Acts as a role model to support the vision and mission of AAMC through behaviors that foster professionalism, empowerment, teamwork, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

• Directs patient care delivery in all nursing units by utilizing supervisory and leadership skills.

• Serves as a liaison between patients, family, staff, and professional staff in clinical and administrative situations when indicated.

• Attends mandatory departmental meetings, pertinent hospital in-services, and continues to develop their leadership skills through continuing education.

Educational/Experience Requirements:

Required Minimum Education: Bachelors Degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred Experience:  Critical Care and Med/Surg background.

Required Minimum Experience: Three years of active nursing experience in an acute care setting with one-year progressive charge/supervisor responsibilities. Maintains current skills validation as required by the Department of Nursing. Demonstrates the knowledge of principles of Growth and Development over the Lifespan.

Skills & Abilities Required:

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel.

Strong interpersonal skills required to communicate with various departments and staff members.

Required License/Certifications:

Required License:  Registered Nurse

Required Certification:  American Heart Association Health Care Provider BLS (CPR), and ACLS certification.

Working Conditions, Equipment, Physical Demands:

Medium work.  Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move object.

There is reasonable expectation that employees in this position will be exposed to blood-borne pathogens.

jobs.title: Spa Supervsior
jobs.description:
The Spa Supervisor is responsible for delivering exceptional spa treatments while providing hands-on leadership and operational support to the Spa Therapist team.

This role combines the expertise of a highly skilled Spa Therapist with the responsibilities of a Supervisor. The position ensures consistency in treatment standards, guest experience, hygiene, team performance, and daily spa operations while embodying the wellness philosophy and values of Our Habitas Ras Abrouq.

Spa Treatments & Guest Experience

• Perform a range of professional spa and wellness treatments, including massages, body treatments, facials, and other services in accordance with qualifications and property standards.
• Conduct guest consultations to understand individual needs, preferences, medical considerations, and treatment expectations.
• Recommend appropriate treatments, wellness experiences, and retail products based on guest needs.
• Deliver personalized and intuitive service while maintaining guest privacy, dignity, comfort, and confidentiality.
• Maintain thorough knowledge of all spa treatments, wellness experiences, packages, products, and promotions.
• Respond professionally to guest feedback and support the resolution of any service concerns.
• Build positive guest relationships and encourage repeat visits through exceptional service.

Team Leadership & Development

• Provide day-to-day leadership, guidance, and support to the Spa Therapist team.
• Lead by example by consistently demonstrating excellent treatment techniques, grooming, professionalism, and guest service.
• Conduct daily briefings and ensure therapists are prepared for scheduled treatments and activities.
• Coach and train therapists on treatment protocols, product knowledge, service standards, and guest engagement.
• Monitor treatment quality and consistency and provide constructive feedback where required.
• Support the Spa & Wellness Manager with onboarding, training, performance reviews, and development plans.
• Assist in preparing team schedules and ensuring appropriate therapist coverage based on business levels.
• Act as the primary point of contact for the therapist team in the absence of the Spa & Wellness Manager.

Spa Operations

• Support the smooth day-to-day operation of the Spa and Wellness facilities.
• Monitor treatment schedules to ensure appointments run efficiently and on time.
• Ensure treatment rooms are correctly prepared before and reset after every treatment.
• Conduct regular checks of treatment rooms, relaxation areas, and therapist preparation areas.
• Ensure sufficient availability of linens, amenities, oils, treatment products, and other supplies.
• Report maintenance concerns and equipment issues promptly.
• Support opening and closing procedures and ensure required operational checklists are completed.

Health, Safety & Hygiene

• Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, sanitation, and infection control.
• Ensure all therapists comply with established treatment, hygiene, health, and safety procedures.
• Ensure equipment, treatment tools, and treatment areas are appropriately cleaned and sanitized.
• Follow all relevant Qatar health and safety regulations and property policies.
• Ensure contraindications and relevant guest health information are properly considered before treatments.
• Immediately report any accidents, incidents, injuries, hazards, or guest health concerns in accordance with established procedures.

Retail & Revenue

• Support the achievement of treatment and retail revenue targets.
• Recommend retail products and additional treatments based on genuine guest needs rather than a transactional sales approach.
• Encourage therapists to identify appropriate opportunities for treatment upgrades and product recommendations.
• Assist with stock monitoring, inventories, and product requisitions.
• Monitor treatment product usage and minimize unnecessary wastage.
• Support spa promotions, wellness programs, packages, and other revenue-generating initiatives.

Administration & Collaboration

• Maintain accurate guest consultation and treatment records.
• Assist with therapist schedules, treatment assignments, inventories, and departmental reports.
• Communicate guest feedback, operational issues, and team concerns to the Spa & Wellness Manager.
• Work closely with Guest Experience, Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest journey.
• Participate in departmental meetings, training programs, property activities, and wellness initiatives as required.

• Recognized qualification or certification in Massage Therapy, Spa Therapy, Beauty Therapy, Holistic Therapy, or a related discipline.

Experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of professional Spa Therapist/ Team Leader experience, preferably within luxury hotels, resorts, lifestyle hospitality, or premium wellness environments.
• Previous experience as a Senior Spa Therapist, Lead Therapist, or Team Leader is preferred.
• Strong practical knowledge of massage techniques, body treatments, facials, and wellness therapies.
• Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, treatment contraindications, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
• Experience coaching or training other therapists is highly desirable.
• Strong command of English; additional languages are an advantage.
• Previous experience in a luxury resort or wellness-focused environment is an advantage.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description

The ISSE will work as part of a team reviewing and assessing Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization body of evidence for classified information systems, to include: System Security Plan (SSP), Security Control Traceability Matrix (SCTM), Continuous Monitoring Plan, Incident Response Plan, Access Control Plan, Security Assessment Plan, etc.

Key Responsibilities

• Review new and existing systems for technical compliance with directives and protection of data at all classification levels. Advise on in-depth security design review and threat/risk assessments

• Provide inputs to technical artifacts, including Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), Security Control Traceability Matrices (SCTM), and Risk Assessment Reports (RARs)

• Conduct site visits and assessments to inspect plans and security control implementations and support Incident Response Team (IRT) activities

Here's what you need

• DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification or higher (Sec+, CISSP, CASP, etc.)

• 5+ years of implementing NIST 800-53, Rev 4 and the Risk Management Framework (RMF)

• 5+ years of experience with Windows and Linux environments.

• 5+ years of experience with virtualization or cloud environments

• 2+ years of using information security and assurance practices and principles

Bonus points if you have

• Other Security related certification (Cloud, SIEM, forensics, Linux, Windows, etc)

• Experience working in a DevSecOps project environment

• Formerly or currently a system administrator, developer, or engineer

• Experience with OpenRMF, eMASS, MS Active Directory, Splunk, ACAS/Nessus, McAfee, Windows, Linux, AWS Security, etc

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Able to engage with users in a professional manner and present technical concepts plainly to semi-technical customers

• Ability to interface with seasoned Government personnel

• Ability to work in a matrixed team environment and support multiple different efforts as needed

• Desire to learn new technologies and tools and willing to share your experience with the team

• SIG or ICD 503 compliance

Clearance Requirements

• Secret level or higher

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Regulations Analyst
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, we are a tech pioneer offering world-class adult entertainment and games on some of the internet’s safest and most popular platforms. With the support of an international team of dynamic and collaborative innovators, we are on a mission to enable safe user experiences and empower our communities by celebrating diversity, inclusion, and expression — all while maintaining robust trust-and-safety protocols.

We embrace the best of both worlds! Local talent can thrive in our collaborative office space with the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, while remote team members play an integral role in shaping our dynamic culture from afar. We have offices in Montreal (Quebec), Austin (Texas) and Nicosia (Cyprus).

*A select number of positions require full-time in office attendance*

As a Trust & Safety Regulations Analyst, you will support a team of regulatory and compliance subject matter experts by helping to track new and changing requirements, keep internal guidance up to date, coordinate implementation activity, and ensure relevant teams receive clear and timely regulatory updates. Recent examples include the European Union’s Digital Services Act and the UK’s Online Safety Act.

Our organization processes predominantly recurring subscriptions in an industry categorized as high risk. You will develop knowledge of the regulatory requirements affecting our products and services and work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety and other business teams to support regulatory implementation, communications, launch reviews and day-to-day compliance activities.

What you'll be doing:

• Track new and developing laws, regulations and regulatory guidance, and maintain clear internal Wiki pages setting out the obligations that apply to our products and services.

• Support communication between the Trust & Safety Regulations team and other departments, helping ensure the right teams are informed when new requirements arise, when action is needed, and when implementation work has been completed.

• Help start and coordinate regulatory implementation projects by identifying the teams that need to be involved, arranging initial discussions, tracking actions and supporting the development of appropriate approval processes and workflows.

• Support launch and feature approval checks by reviewing proposed launches and product changes against documented regulatory requirements and confirming that required reviews and approvals have taken place.

• Maintain clear records of regulatory actions, project status and completed implementation work so that stakeholders can easily understand what has changed, what is required and what has been delivered.

• Support ad hoc regulatory and compliance requests, including research, information gathering, internal coordination and preparation of concise summaries or guidance.

What you'll need to be successful:

Must haves:

• 0-2 years of experience in a regulatory, compliance, policy, legal operations, project coordination or similar role.

• Ability to read and understand legislation, regulatory guidance or other detailed written requirements, with support from more senior team members where needed.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to turn detailed information into clear internal updates, guidance and documentation.

• Excellent organization, time management and attention to detail, with the ability to track multiple actions and deadlines.

• Confidence working with colleagues across different teams, including Product, Engineering, Legal and Trust & Safety.

• Comfort using data, documentation and internal systems to track work, maintain records and provide status updates.

Nice to haves:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field is a plus.

• Experience supporting projects, maintaining internal documentation or working in an online platform / technology environment is a plus.

As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

In this role you may be exposed to adult content

jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer (12 Month FTC)
jobs.description:
Role OVO-View

Team: Attack Surface Management

Location: Hub Based - Hybrid for all

Salary banding:  £105,000 - £150,000 / 12 month FTC

Experience: Expert

Working pattern: Full-Time

Reporting to: Deputy CISO

Sponsorship: Unfortunately we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

This role in 3 words: Pragmatic, Proactive, Engineer

Top 3 qualities for this role: Data-driven, Communication, Automator

Where you’ll work:

Depending on the needs of your business area, we expect hub based people to be in the office at least once a week, and to go to OVO Connection events in-person.

You’ll be assigned to the closest one of our three hub offices, Bristol, Glasgow, or London; unless your role requires field-based work. Each hub has accessible spaces to park your laptop, is designed to inspire people, help them connect and bring big ideas to life.

Everyone belongs at OVO:

At OVO, we are on a mission to solve one of humanity's biggest challenges, the climate crisis. And we know it takes all of us to change the world. That's why we need diverse people from all abilities, gender identities, ethnicities, ages, sexual orientations, life experiences and backgrounds to join us.

Teamworking for the planet:

Everything we do here spins around Plan Zero. So, naturally, the team you’ll be joining plays a gigantic role in making that happen. Here’s how:

In this individual contributor role, you will be on the frontline of OVO's security. You'll lead the reduction of our attack surface through technical leadership of a consolidated identity and access roadmap and highly automated amplification loops for security exposure management. This work is pivotal to maintaining a proactive and resilient posture, collaborating closely with engineering, procurement, risk and security teams across OVO to build better observability, and deterministic and non-deterministic workflows to better defend our mission to transition to a zero-carbon future.

This role in a nutshell:

As a Principal Security Engineer (Attack Surface Management) at OVO, you will be the key technical leader responsible for shaping the enterprise-wide strategy for zero trust access, attack surface observability and security weakness amplification workflows. This involves deep hands-on expertise, driving the innovation of exposure management practices, guiding architectural decisions for zero trust access and data loss prevention controls, and leading the way in solving complex, emerging security challenges. You will ensure OVO maintains a proactive and automated defence posture, setting the direction for critical security initiatives, and championing the integration of security standards embedded in configs and code and near miss retros to improve our resilience. You will be recognised as a trusted authority in your field, particularly in building automated, AI-enabled attack surface reduction workflows, leading critical vulnerability remediation incidents and leading complex control improvement initiatives.

Your key outcomes will be:

• Weakness management: Lead and execute security defect discovery operations, vulnerability management (VM), remediation governance, and recurrence prevention across the enterprise with the aim of continuously improving compliance with policies, procedures, and guidelines. Drive organisational and technical change by defining and implementing changes where required to internal processes & tooling to enhance proactive security controls.

• Identity-focused access security: Lead the development, revision, implementation and monitoring of security IAM policies, processes and related tooling across OVO. The principal SME and strategic leader for IAM, defining and developing policy, influencing major strategic tech decisions, governs implementation of those solutions. Defines enterprise identity and access management and governance strategy.

• Supply chain security: Champions and is a catalyst for improving secure supply chain management controls. Minimises the cost of meeting third party risk management compliance while developing strategies to measure and reduce supply chain risk reduction. Utilises principal-level expertise and perspectives to influence vendor relationships and security of third-party contracts.

• Security risk treatment prioritisation: Serve as a trusted challenger and SME, including to senior stakeholders, on trade-offs that appear in designing enterprise-level security systems that carefully balance risk appetite and conflicting priorities (e.g. cost, speed, rigour). Able to innovate with more efficient and effective ways to protect, detect, respond and recover from security threats. Coaches others in security architecture. Defines attack path mapping frameworks that scale and can align organisational risks and mitigation priorities. Directly influence OVO’s core model architecture with security best-practice in mind, utilising engineering-first approaches to solve complex security problems.

• Mentor Senior Technical Staff & Elevate Practice: Mentor staff and senior engineers across OVO in advanced security disciplines, strategic thinking, architecture, and technical leadership. Actively contribute to internal communities of practice, develop training for senior staff, and elevate the overall security engineering practice at OVO.

• Community of Practice: Drive the Community of Practice (CoP) for your role by actively leading, cultivating and growing the CoP as a result of your industry engagement and thought leadership. Create content, engage in knowledge exchange / cross-pollination to further your craft Mentor and coach individuals in the role-based competencies associated with a CoP Input to upskilling and learning pathways based on the CoP that will aid individuals' career progression

You’ll be successful in this role if you…

• Inspire and lead cross-functional teams, driving a culture of excellence and collaboration.

• Think critically and strategically to align security initiatives with business goals.

• Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, effectively conveying complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrate strong influencing skills to drive security adoption and change across the organisation.

• Apply advanced problem-solving and analytical skills to address complex security challenges.

• Anticipate and adapt to changes in the internal and external business context and evolving security landscapes and emerging threats.

• Dedicate time and thought to mentoring and developing other senior security professionals and technical leaders.

• Exhibit a drive to find novel, effective, and potentially unconventional solutions to hard security problems.

• Are recognised internally and potentially externally as an expert and forward-thinker, contributing to security communities or publications.

• Are able to balance security ideals with practical business/engineering realities to achieve tangible outcomes.

• Demonstrate a keen understanding of how security enables and impacts broader business objectives, strategy, and risk management.

Let’s talk about what’s in it for you:

We’ll pay you between £105,000 and £150,000, depending on your specific skills and experience.

We keep our pay ranges broad on purpose to give us, and you, flexibility to match your experience to our zero carbon mission.

You’ll be eligible for an on-target bonus of 15%. We have one OVO bonus plan that focuses on the collective performance of our people to deliver our Plan Zero goal.

We also offer plenty of green benefits and progressive policies to help you feel like you belong at OVO…and there’s flex pay. We'll give you 9% Flex Pay on top of your salary – 4% of this is auto enrolled into your pension, and the remaining 5% is yours to do what you like with. You can use this to buy from our extensive range of flexible benefits, including our green benefits which we've put at the heart of our offering, add to your pension or even take it as cash.

Here’s a taster of what’s on offer:

For starters, you’ll get 34 days of holiday (including bank holidays).

For your health
With benefits like a healthcare cash plan or private medical insurance depending on your career level, critical illness cover, life assurance, health assessments, and more

For your wellbeing
With gym membership, travel insurance, workplace ISA, will writing services, dental insurance, and more

For your lifestyle
With extra holiday buying, discount dining, home & tech loans, and supporting your favourite charities with give-as-you-earn donations

For your home
Get up to £400 towards any OVO Energy plan, plus great discounts on solar, smart thermostats and EV chargers

For your commute
Nab a great deal on ultra-low emission car leasing, plus our cycle to work scheme and public transport season ticket loans

Want to hear about our full range of flexible benefits and progressive people policies? Our People Team can tell you everything you need to know.

For your Belonging

To find better ways to support our people, we need to listen to each other’s experiences and find ways to build a truly inclusive and diverse workplace. As part of this, we have 8 Belonging Networks at OVO. Led by our people, for our people - so when you join OVO, you can play a part - big or small - with any of the Networks. It's up to you.

Oh, and one last thing...

We’d be thrilled if you tick off all our boxes, yet we also believe it’s just as important we tick off all of yours. And if you think you have most of what we’re looking for but not every single thing, go ahead and hit apply. We’d still love to hear from you!

If you have any additional requirements, there’s a space to let us know on the application form; we want to make the process as easy and comfortable for you as possible.

jobs.description:
CE VEI FACE​

În calitate de Manager Departament, vei fi liderul care își sprijină și încurajează întreaga echipă. Prin promovarea unei culturi incluzive care promovează colaborarea și spiritul antreprenorial, Acționând în conformitate cu valorile noastre, vei conduce atât succesul magazinului, cât și succesul companiei.

Va trebui să:

• Conduci echipa pentru a oferi clienților o experiență remarcabilă, asigurând standarde operaționale și vizuale excelente prin promovarea și vânzarea produselor noastre în mod activ.
• Îți asumi responsabilitatea pentru punctele forte ale magazinului și departamentului tău, analizând performanța vânzărilor, identificând oportunități comerciale, stabilind obiective și făcând planuri pentru a optimiza rezultatele, profiturile și nivelurile stocurilor.
• Gestionezi planificarea și organizarea echipei și să asiguri rutinele de deschidere și închidere fără probleme.
• Recrutezi, integrezi și dezvolți echipa ta, promovând în același timp o cultură incluzivă și colaborativă care promovează creșterea și inovația.

• Te reprezinți pe tine și brandul nostru în mod pozitiv în toate interacțiunile cu clienții.
• Asiguri experiența OMNI generală a clienților prin promovarea activă a programului nostru de loialitate ( Hello Member).

CU CINE VEI LUCRA​

Magazinele sunt inima companiei noastre, locul unde clienții experimentează direct brandul nostru. Ca parte a echipei dinamice a magazinului, fiecare rol - de la consilieri de vânzări, manageri de departament, de magazin și visual merchandisers și până la cash office responsible - contribuie la crearea unui mediu inspirațional și primitor. De asemenea, vei păstra legătura și cu echipa mai mare a Ariei, colaborând între magazine pentru a împărtăși informații și a contribui la succes împreună. Alături de echipa ta, vei juca un rol vital în a-i ajuta pe clienți să se simtă încrezători și să-și exprime individualitatea cu cele mai recente tendințe și stiluri atemporale. Prin construirea de conexiuni semnificative cu clienții din magazinele noastre, facem moda accesibilă și durabilă pentru toți.

CINE EȘTI​

Suntem în căutare de persoane cu…​

• Experiență în managementul și operațiunile de retail.
• Experiență în planificarea, analiza și urmărirea vânzărilor, folosind instrumente și raportare centrate pe client.

Și persoane care sunt…​

• Lideri puternici și încrezători care își inspiră, antrenează și dezvoltă echipele, exemplificând în același timp valorile și cultura companiei.
• Prospere în medii colaborative, dinamice, cu o mentalitate axată pe soluții.
• Motivate să creeze experiențe excelente pentru clienți în timp ce promovăm și vindem produsele noastre.
• Interesate în mod deosebit pentru tendințele modei, comercialitate și informații despre concurență pentru a stimula vânzările.
• Comunicatori eficienți, creativi și curioși.
• Flexibile, analitice și orientate spre realizări, cu capacitatea de a gestiona statistici și de a lucra cu cifre.

​CINE SUNTEM NOI​

H&M Group este o companie globală de branduri și întreprinderi puternice de modă. Scopul nostru este să demonstrăm că nu există compromisuri între designul excepțional, prețurile accesibile și soluțiile sustenabile. Vrem să facem moda accesibilă pentru mulți, iar clienții noștri sunt în centrul fiecărei decizii pe care o luăm.​

​Suntem un grup alcătuit din mii de colegi pasionați și talentați, uniți de cultura și valorile noastre comune. Împreună, vrem să ne folosim puterea, amploarea și cunoștințele pentru a împinge industria modei către un viitor mai incluziv și mai sustenabil. ​

​DE CE-ȚI VA PLĂCEA SĂ LUCREZI AICI ​

La H&M Group, suntem mândri să fim o companie vibrantă și primitoare. Oferim angajaților noștri beneficii atractive cu oportunități extinse de dezvoltare în întreaga lume. ​

• 25% discount pentru angajați pentru brandurile H&M Group, atât în magazine, cât și online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories și ARKET).​

ALĂTURĂ-TE

jobs.title: Executive Assistant and Office Manager - Greenwich, CT
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Soros Fund Management LLC (SFM) is a global asset manager and family office founded by George Soros in 1973. With $28 billion in assets under management (AUM), SFM serves as the principal asset manager for the Open Society Foundations, one of the world’s largest charitable foundations dedicated to advancing justice, human rights, and democracy.

Distinct from other investment platforms, SFM thrives on agility, acting decisively when conviction is high and exercising patience when it’s not. With permanent capital, a select group of major clients, and an unconstrained mandate, we invest opportunistically with a long-term view in a wide range of strategies and asset classes, including public and private equity and credit, fixed income, foreign exchange, and alternative assets. Our teams operate with autonomy, while cross-team collaboration strengthens our conviction and empowers us to capitalize on market dislocations.

At SFM, we foster an ownership mindset, encouraging professionals to challenge the status quo, innovate, and take initiative. We prioritize development, enabling team members to push beyond their roles, voice bold ideas, and contribute to our long-term success. This culture of continuous growth and constructive debate fuels innovation and drives efficiencies.

Our impact is measured by both the returns we generate and the values we uphold, from environmental stewardship to social responsibility. Operating as a unified team across geographies and mandates, we remain committed to our mission, ensuring a meaningful, lasting impact.

Headquartered in New York City with offices in Greenwich, Garden City, London, and Dublin, SFM employs 200 professionals.

Job Overview

SFM is seeking an administrative professional to work full-time, in person, out of our Greenwich, CT office. This role combines executive-level administrative support with office management responsibilities. The successful candidate will provide high-touch administrative support to investment professionals and key business leaders while also overseeing day-to-day operations of a 10-20 person office space.  This individual will also serve as back-up to the US Office Manager and to other executive/administrative assistants as needed, and will take on ad-hoc projects as they arise. The ideal candidate is highly organized, discreet, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Major Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day office operations Coordinate with the US Office Manager on service calls and third-party vendors to resolve facility issues (HVAC, electrical, minor repairs, etc.) Control office inventory and manage relationships with food service, mail room, and cleaning vendors Review and process invoices related to CT office facilities Serve as back-up to the US Office Manager when out

• Provide Administrative support to up to four (4) senior investment professionals/key business leaders Triage incoming calls, handling directly where possible and escalating as needed Manage complex calendars with discretion, scheduling and confirming meetings, sending reminders, and assisting with material preparation and distribution Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements Build and maintain external relationships critical to the teams' success (e.g., brokers, company management teams) Prepare meeting summaries, notes, presentations, memos, board reports, and other correspondence Process travel and expense reports via Workday Support department projects as needed Provide back-up coverage for other executive/administrative assistants Handle occasional personal tasks

• Support ad-hoc projects across the office and broader team as needed.

What We Value

• Must show an owner’s mindset and a strong willingness to take on new tasks and responsibilities as needed

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Advanced PowerPoint skills, with experience creating slide decks for senior executives

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Fandango
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Versant is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Finance team supporting Fandango and its portfolio of businesses. Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role will play a critical part in financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and strategic decision support across domestic and international operations.

This position is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys translating complex data into actionable business insights, and is motivated by influencing decisions that drive growth and operational excellence.

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Financial Analyst will help business leaders understand performance drivers, identify opportunities for growth, and make informed strategic decisions. Through rigorous financial analysis, forecasting, and executive-level reporting, this role directly contributes to the company's ability to achieve its financial and operational objectives.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid position based in Orlando, FL with an expectation of working from the office a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Do

• Support financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and cash management across domestic and international business operations.
• Develop, refine, and monitor key business performance indicators (KPIs), delivering data-driven insights and recommendations that influence strategic decision-making.
• Build and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into business performance and growth opportunities.
• Partner with Finance leadership and business stakeholders to support annual operating plans, long-range strategic planning, and financial goal setting.
• Prepare executive- and leadership-level presentations, analyses, and reporting materials that clearly communicate financial performance and business trends.
• Evaluate strategic initiatives and partnership opportunities through financial analysis and scenario modeling.
• Maintain and optimize financial planning systems, databases, and reporting structures to improve efficiency and accuracy.
• Build strong cross-functional relationships across finance, operations, and business leadership teams to support organizational priorities.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
• 3+ years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), accounting, consulting, corporate development, or a related discipline.
• Demonstrated experience developing financial models, analyzing business performance, and preparing executive-level reporting and presentations.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Hyperion Essbase, SAP, or similar financial planning and reporting systems.
• Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and business leaders to drive financial and operational outcomes.
• Experience supporting media, digital, technology, entertainment, or consumer-facing businesses.

How We Do It at Versant

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• Trust by delivering accurate financial analysis, exercising sound judgment, and maintaining the highest standards of integrity.
• Teamwork by building strong relationships and collaborating effectively across Finance, Operations, and business teams.
• Transparency by communicating insights clearly, proactively sharing information, and supporting data-informed decision-making.
• Agility by adapting quickly to changing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and balancing multiple business needs.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit by identifying opportunities for improvement, driving efficiencies, and bringing innovative solutions that create value for the business.

Why You'll Love It Here

• Opportunity to contribute to a portfolio of industry-leading media, entertainment, sports, and digital brands.
• Exposure to senior leadership and strategic business initiatives that shape company performance.
• Collaborative culture focused on growth, innovation, and continuous learning.
• Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other employee programs and resources.
• Hybrid work environment based in Orlando, FL with regular in-person collaboration opportunities.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Rune

Rune Technologies builds mission-critical software for military logistics and sustainment. Our flagship product is TyrOS, an AI-enabled logistics command and control platform that gives commanders a single, real-time operating picture of their sustainment fight, from inventory and distribution to medical and operational planning, even in degraded and contested environments.



We're not a traditional defense contractor. We're a small, fast-moving team that combines deep operational experience in and with the DoD with the software discipline of the best product companies, and we apply that combination to a customer set that desperately needs it. We stay close to our users by embedding directly with military units during exercises and rotations, and we ship constantly based on what we learn.



The U.S. military and its allies face a real logistics modernization problem. We're building the software to solve it.



About the Role

As a Technical Operations Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of quality assurance (QA) testing, customer training, deployment support, and field operations. This role is designed for someone who understands military operations, cares deeply about the user, and wants to help bring modern technology to the soldiers, Marines, airmen, and operators still in the field.

You will support Rune’s Mission Success organization by helping test new software releases, prepare deployment packages, train users, collect product feedback, and assist with software and hardware deployments at customer sites. At headquarters, much of your work will focus on QA testing, training material development, and product readiness. In the field, you will help deploy Rune products, support software updates, train military users, and capture feedback that informs future product improvements.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to learn quickly, operate in high-stakes environments, and help ensure Rune’s products work reliably for the users who depend on them.



What You’ll Do

 - Validate new Rune software releases before they reach customers, ensuring workflows make sense for real military users.

 - Exercise the product like an operator would: planning missions, managing sustainment data, updating statuses, moving through workflows, and identifying where the software breaks down or becomes confusing.

 - Test end-to-end scenarios across TyrOS and other Rune products to confirm that the system is ready for exercises, demos, deployments, and customer use.

 - Identify bugs, workflow gaps, confusing product behavior, and training issues, then clearly communicate what happened and why it matters operationally.

 - Prepare deployment packages, including software, hardware, documentation, and training materials, for field use.

 - Provide hands-on technical support for Rune software and hardware products in forward-deployed environments.

 - Assist with installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of deployed Rune systems; manage software updates in support of customer deployments.

 - Develop practical training materials that help new users understand and adopt Rune products quickly; train military users virtually, in classrooms, and in field environments.

 - Capture user feedback during training sessions, exercises, and deployments, and translate that feedback into clear product observations for the product and engineering teams.

 - Build and maintain deployment runbooks and a troubleshooting knowledge base, capturing field fixes so they are repeatable by others.
   
   

Qualifications

 - 1 to 4 years of relevant hands-on technical experience, such as help desk, field service, systems administration, or military signal, automation, or logistics roles.

 - Availability to work onsite in Rosslyn, VA  

 - Active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 - Basic understanding of computer hardware components such as CPUs, RAM, storage, cables, peripherals, and networking equipment.

 - Basic understanding of operating systems, especially Windows, Linux and command-line navigation.

 - Familiarity with fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP addresses, connectivity troubleshooting, and basic network configuration.

 - Strong attention to detail and willingness to methodically work through software workflows, edge cases, and operational scenarios.

 - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with military users, operators, and non-technical stakeholders; interest in teaching new software technologies through classroom instruction, field training, virtual sessions, and written materials.

 - Ability to operate effectively in high-stakes environments while maintaining a strong bias toward execution and delivery.

 - Eagerness to learn new technologies, products, and processes in a fast-moving, collaborative environment; strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues.
   
   

Desired Qualifications

 - Associates Degree preferred.

 - Familiarity with Army, Marine Corps, Air Force, or joint logistics systems, reporting processes, maintenance workflows, or sustainment operations.

 - Experience training military personnel on new systems, processes, equipment, or procedures.

 - Comfort troubleshooting computers, radios, networks, software, printers, servers, tactical systems, or other technical equipment in the field.

 - Comfort working with Linux, logs, databases, basic scripting, or other technical tools — or strong willingness to learn.

 - Experience operating in field environments, exercises, command posts, tactical operations centers, maintenance bays, supply rooms, or deployment settings.

 - Ability to travel to customer sites, military bases, exercises, and field events as required.
   
   

Why This Role

 - You will help bring modern software to the military users who need it most.

 - You will turn your operational experience into better products, better training, and better deployments.

 - You will be one of the people making sure Rune’s software actually works for soldiers and operators in the real world.

 - You will work directly with Mission Managers, engineers, product teams, and customers, giving you broad exposure across a fast-growing defense technology company.

 - You will gain hands-on experience in software testing, deployment, training and customer operations at an exciting, mission-focused defense technology startup.
   
   

Benefits

Rune offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees to include a full suite of insurance options at no cost for employees and low-cost to spouses and dependents. Highly competitive equity grants are also  included in the majority of full time offers and are considered part of Rune's total compensation package. Benefits include:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans; premiums 100% covered by Rune for all employees; exceptionally low premiums for spouses and dependents

 - Basic life insurance and disability 100% covered for all employees by Rune; option to purchase additional life insurance available

 - ‘Take the time off that you need, when you need it’ paid time off, not accrual based

 - Generous company holiday calendar including a holiday shutdown in December

 - Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service, medical events, and parental leave

 - Full 401(k) retirement plan for all full-time eligible employees

 - Company-funded commuter benefits

 - Free access to on-site gym at office

jobs.title: Junior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
About Mammoth Brands

Mammoth Brands (formerly Harry’s Inc.) is the modern CPG company behind brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. We’re building a new model—and home—brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives, and ultimately challenge the status quo. Our mission is to “Create Things People Like More.” Simply put: everything we do should be better than what already exists. If it’s not, we don’t do it. This guides everything we do, from developing the best product experiences, to making Mammoth Brands a great place to work, to exploring innovative ways to give back to our community.

We got our start in 2013 when our co-founders created Harry's. They built the brand differently—online first, prioritizing direct relationships with customers—and in the process learned they’d created something bigger: a playbook and platform that could help other brands grow and scale to their full potential, and a vision to reimagine consumer packaged goods. Today, Mammoth Brands is a growing portfolio of brands and the largest CPG company built in the last 20 years. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: to create a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. As a company, we’re also committed to making a positive impact and have donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.

We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.

About the Role

We're looking for a hungry, curious Junior Creative Strategist to work as a close partner to our Head of Creative/Growth Director. This role exists to multiply great creative thinking — owning the full creative planning cycle from performance analysis through to brief. You'll run monthly brainstorming and planning sessions, translate insights into structured plans with clear territory and style splits, and build high-level briefs that editors and production can move against with confidence. You'll lead monthly Creative Insight Analytics sessions, help pilot AI creative tools, and serve as the creative anchor the team comes to for direction. You'll also be a connector: between creative and performance, between strategy and execution, and between our growth team and the social commerce and TikTok ecosystem teams we work closely with.

What You'll Do

• Own the full monthly creative planning cycle — run brainstorming and planning sessions, bring the data, drive the ideas, and leave with a plan the team can execute against.

• Translate performance insights into a structured monthly plan with clear territory and style splits.

• Build high-level briefs for editors and production — clear enough that the team can move with confidence and without hand-holding.

• Lead monthly Creative Insight Analytics sessions: what worked, what didn't, and what to chase next. Partner closely with the growth and creative leadership teams on this.

• Act as a strong cross-functional partner to our social commerce and TikTok teams — syncing on creative needs, feeding insights upstream, and helping ensure creative output is built for the right platforms and moments.

• Study competitor creative, read customer reviews and comments, and stay in the communities we're trying to reach. Every brief should start from a genuine customer insight, not just a creative instinct.

• Pick up new tools quickly — AI creative platforms, performance analytics, scripting tools — and build light workflows that speed up concepting and briefing.

• Support Trybe with creative briefs and strategic direction.

Who You Are

• Genuinely creative, with taste, opinions, and ideas you can defend. You think in hooks, territories, and angles — not just executions.

• A natural cross-functional partner. You communicate clearly, keep people informed, and know how to work across teams with different priorities and rhythms.

• Obsessed with the customer. You think about who you're talking to before you think about what you want to say.

• A "whatever it takes" operator who doesn't wait to be told what to do and finds a way to get things done.

• Fast. You move quickly without sacrificing quality, and you know the difference.

• Energized by AI and new tools. Not intimidated by new platforms — excited to figure them out.

• Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a rough idea, a data pattern, or a half-formed brief and run with it.

• A clear, clean communicator. Your briefs are easy to read and your handoffs don't require follow-ups.

What You Bring

• 1–3 years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative, brand or growth marketing, or a related discipline.

• Fluency in Meta Ads Manager or similar performance platforms. You can read the data and draw clear conclusions from it.

• Exposure to direct-response or performance advertising. You understand what makes an ad convert, not just look good.

• Familiarity with short-form video formats and an instinct for what works on platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels — you don't need to be a TikTok expert, but you should be a fluent consumer of the format.

• Familiarity with AI creative tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar). You don't need to have used all of them, but you should be the kind of person who will try them.

• Basic editing literacy (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) is a plus — being able to mock up a rough cut can help unblock a concept.

Why This Role

You'll get a front-row seat to how performance creative strategy gets made — with direct access to senior creative and growth leadership. If you want to grow quickly, take on real creative ownership early, flex across formats and channels, and work on brands that millions of people love, this is the role for you.

Benefits and perks

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401k match

• Equity in Mammoth Brands

• Flexible time off and working hours

• L&D stipend

• 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years

• 20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood

• Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop

• Free products from our family of brands

The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Our beautiful 70,000 square foot SoHo office is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday.  Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!

We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. That said, our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive set of benefits and our equity program. The base salary hiring range for this position is $90,800-$113,500, but the final compensation offer will ultimately be based on the candidate’s location, skill level and experience.

Mammoth Brands is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do great work together.

Mammoth Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We recruit, hire and promote into all job levels the most qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), parental status, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, transgender status, sexual orientation, marital, family or partnership status, political affiliation or activities, military service, domestic violence victim status, arrest/conviction record, sexual or reproductive health decisions, caregiver status, credit history immigration status, unemployment status, traits historically associated with race, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles or any other status protected under applicable federal, state and local laws. Mammoth Brands' commitment to providing equal employment opportunities extends to all aspects of employment, including job assignment, compensation, discipline and access to benefits and training.

We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our company.

If visa sponsorship is required for work authorization, please note that Mammoth Brands in collaboration with immigration counsel will manage and submit all necessary legal filings on behalf of the candidate.

It is important to us that every candidate has a positive and safe experience with Mammoth Brands. Please be aware of the possibility of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, and employment offers that are designed to collect personal information or charge fees for recruitment or training services.

Mammoth Brands will never charge any application, processing, or training fee at any point in our hiring process. Every genuine opportunity we have will be listed on our careers page. If something ever feels off, trust your instincts and don't hesitate to reach out to us directly to verify.

• Acompanhar de perto os projetos estratégicos mais críticos: status, prazos, riscos, dependências e decisões.

• Organizar e conduzir ritos de acompanhamento, como kick-offs, checkpoints e comitês.

• Destravar dependências entre times e escalar riscos a tempo.

• Apoiar líderes técnicos e de produto a adotarem os padrões no dia a dia.

• Usar IA e automação para ganhar eficiência na coleta de informações e na geração de reports.

O que buscamos

Obrigatórios:

• Experiência em gestão de projetos, programas ou PMO em empresas de tecnologia, acompanhando vários projetos e stakeholders ao mesmo tempo.

• Experiência criando ou implantando padrões de gestão: ritos, templates, status reports, gestão de riscos e decisões.

• Comunicação executiva e capacidade de síntese, na escrita e em apresentações.

• Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira.

• Excel ou Google Sheets avançado.

• Uso frequente de ferramentas de IA generativa no trabalho.

• Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Desejáveis:

• Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de grande porte.

• Inglês intermediário.

• Certificações como PMP/CAPM, Scrum, Kanban ou SAFe.

• Experiência com dashboards e ferramentas de BI.

• Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA para gestão de projetos.

• Vivência com projetos internacionais.

Benefícios

• Vale-alimentação e Vale-refeição

• Plano de saúde e odontológico

• Seguro de vida

• DayOff de Aniversário

• Baby On Board e Sala de Amamentação

• Licença parental estendida

• Auxílio-creche/babá e/ou auxílio para filhos com deficiência

• Wellhub e Grupo de Corrida Inter

• Espaço CARE4U (Belo Horizonte): serviços de autocuidado com valores exclusivos, área de descompressão, jogos e minicampo de golfe

• Vantagens no nosso SuperApp, como Duo Gourmet

• Cartão Prime Inter

• Programas de treinamento e capacitação internos

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

• Proposta de Contratação (Offer);

jobs.title: Project Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our team. The ideal individual will have prior experience supporting large-scale construction projects.

Responsibilities:

• Manage stakeholders including architects, engineers, and supply chains to deliver compliant projects.
• Can analyze, track, and effectively manage critical milestone activities to avoid schedule slips.
• Verify that effective project governance, processes and systems are utilized
• Ensure application of best practice on all projects.
• Production of formal project status reports and other reports as required.
• Monitor the progress of multiple construction projects simultaneously to ensure that the approved design standards are applied correctly.
• Manage the interface between all suppliers through monthly trackers and weekly reviews.
• Manage the flow of project information between the project team through regular meetings and written communications.
• Forecast and update key project milestones.
• Manage and monitor local design teams in accordance with commission criteria.
• Provide technical support to owners, architects, general contractors and regional stakeholders.
• Rapid response to RFIs from the field.
• Provide expertise for cost control, value engineering, and constructability guidance where required.
• Independent review of status reports, drawing submittals, timelines and costs from architects, contractors and suppliers.
• Client management – assist in developing excellent working relationships with Clients, with a view towards maximizing new opportunities.
• Strategic Thinking - provides advice to project teams on approaches that can be adopted to successfully achieve both clients’ objectives and business objectives.
• Knowledge management – ensure that key information and learnings generated from each project are captured.
• Process improvement – Identify ways to improve internal systems and processes.

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, civil engineering, or applicable bachelor’s degree and or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5-7 years of relevant project management experience.
• Strong organizational and management skills – the ability to work effectively and collaboratively with the broader team.
• Effective presentation skills.
• Proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Procore, and construction project management tools.
• Excellent communication skills.

*On site requirements might change based on client needs*

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

jobs.title: HIL Engineer - Bench Setup & Integration
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Job Overview

• We are seeking a HIL Engineer responsible for building, setting up, integrating, and commissioning Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test benches for automotive electronic control units (ECUs).

• The engineer will be responsible for the complete HIL bench setup, including hardware installation, electrical wiring, ECU connections, I/O configuration, communication networks, power supplies, signal interfaces, and system integration. The role requires a hands-on engineer who can troubleshoot the bench at the hardware and software level and prepare the HIL environment for testing and validation.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and configure HIL test benches for automotive ECU testing and validation.

• Install and integrate HIL hardware, including HIL simulation systems, ECU interfaces, I/O modules, power supplies, signal conditioning units, load boards, relay/switching systems, and measurement equipment.

• Perform electrical wiring and physical connections between ECUs, HIL systems, breakout boxes, loads, sensors, and other test equipment.

• Configure ECU power, ignition, ground, analog, digital, PWM, frequency, and other required signals.

• Configure and troubleshoot automotive communication networks such as CAN, CAN FD, LIN, FlexRay, and Ethernet.

• Set up communication interfaces, network termination, routing, and signal connections.

• Configure HIL I/O channels and map ECU signals to the simulation environment.

• Support ECU installation, removal, and connection to HIL benches.

• Perform bench commissioning, bring-up, and functional checks before testing begins.

• Verify wiring, pinouts, connectors, voltage levels, signal integrity, and communication interfaces.

• Troubleshoot HIL bench hardware, electrical, communication, and configuration issues.

• Use electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, ECU pinouts, interface specifications, and system documentation to build and troubleshoot test setups.

• Configure and maintain HIL system software and associated test environments.

• Support integration of plant models and real-time simulation environments.

• Work with test and validation engineers to prepare the HIL bench for automated and manual testing.

• Document bench configurations, wiring, hardware changes, issues, and troubleshooting activities.

• Maintain HIL benches and support upgrades, modifications, and new ECU integrations.

Required Qualifications

• Engineering degree or equivalent technical background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience building, configuring, integrating, or troubleshooting HIL test benches.

• Strong understanding of automotive electrical and electronic systems.

• Experience working with ECUs, sensors, actuators, I/O systems, and test equipment.

• Strong knowledge of automotive communication protocols, particularly CAN/CAN FD and LIN.

• Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, ECU pinouts, and connector documentation.

• Experience with electrical wiring, harnesses, connectors, breakout boxes, and test interfaces.

• Understanding of ECU power supply, grounding, signal conditioning, and electrical troubleshooting.

• Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with HIL platforms such as dSPACE, Vector, NI, ETAS, or Speedgoat.

• Experience with dSPACE SCALEXIO / MicroAutoBox or similar real-time simulation platforms.

• Experience with Vector CANoe/CANalyzer.

• Experience with MATLAB/Simulink and real-time simulation.

• Experience configuring HIL I/O and signal mapping.

• Knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, UDS, and diagnostics.

• Experience with ECU flashing, diagnostics, and communication testing.

• Experience with automotive network databases such as DBC files.

• Experience with test automation and scripting using Python, CAPL, MATLAB, or similar tools.

• Understanding of plant models and real-time simulation.

Key Technical Skills

• HIL Bench Setup & Integration

• HIL Bench Build

• HIL Hardware Integration

• ECU Integration

• I/O Configuration

• Signal Mapping

• Electrical Wiring

• Bench Commissioning

• Hardware Troubleshooting

• Automotive Communication

• CAN / CAN FD

• LIN

• FlexRay

• Automotive Ethernet

• UDS / Diagnostics

• CANoe / CANalyzer

• HIL Platforms

• dSPACE

• Vector

• NI

• ETAS

• Speedgoat

• Software / Automation

• MATLAB / Simulink

• Python

• CAPL

• Test Automation

• Real-Time Simulation

• Ideal Candidate Profile

• The ideal candidate is a hands-on HIL Engineer who has physically built and commissioned HIL benches, rather than only executing tests on an established HIL environment.

• The candidate should be comfortable with wiring ECUs, configuring I/O, connecting sensors and actuators, setting up CAN/LIN/Ethernet communication, configuring HIL hardware, troubleshooting electrical signals, and bringing the complete bench into an operational state.

House of Rohl is the portfolio you will carry: ROHL, Perrin & Rowe, Shaws, Victoria + Albert, Riobel, and the decorative hardware brands Emtek and Schaub. Perrin & Rowe still builds taps and showers in England. Shaws has been making fireclay sinks in Lancashire since the 1890s. Victoria + Albert baths are cast from a volcanic limestone composite and finished by hand. That is the story you get to tell.

As Luxury Sales Manager, you own your territory and the relationships that decide what ends up in the specification: showroom partners, builders, architects and the wider design community. You will grow the territory by finding new business, protect how the brands are presented everywhere they appear, and become the person your showrooms call first.

• · Identify and develop new business within luxury showrooms and across the broader trade network, including dealers, builders and distributors.
• · Build relationships across the specification community, including architects, designers, builders and hospitality clients, to position House of Rohl products early.
• · Partner with Customer Service, Technical Support, Sales Management and Marketing to address territory needs and get customers’ answers quickly.
• · Make sure House of Rohl brand standards show up consistently in showroom displays and in every customer interaction.
• · Share market insight and customer feedback that sharpens business development and strengthens how we are positioned.
• · Deliver against your sales targets and annual performance goals.

• 5+ years of sales experience, including at least 2 years in outside sales.
• · Prior experience calling on interior designers, architects, luxury kitchen and bath showrooms, builders or plumbers.
• · The ability to build and hold relationships with luxury clientele, and to communicate credibly with designers, architects and showroom owners.
• · The ability to read market conditions and competitive activity and turn that into a plan for your territory.
• · Availability for occasional evening and weekend commitments, such as showroom events and industry functions.
• · Valid driver's license.
• · Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

Nice to Haves

• · A bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or a related field.
