When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Services Architect is an advanced individual contributor within the Services Architecture team, contributing to the technical direction, quality, and delivery of content across the Professional Services Portfolio. Operating with a high degree of autonomy while aligning with the overarching portfolio strategy, this role leads the design and execution of net-new consulting service offerings, courses, and enablement programs, and helps establish standards for the broader team. In this position, the architect provides technical guidance across team projects, handles content and offering escalations, and actively mentors Associate Services Architects. Working in close collaboration with portfolio leadership, the role supports offering strategy and product roadmap alignment, while periodically teaching customer classes or delivering service engagements to ensure content remains grounded in real-world customer experience.

Your Opportunity:

Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

• Portfolio Direction: Shape the Professional Services Portfolio by identifying gaps and opportunities and proposing and prioritizing new offerings aligned with corporate strategy and product roadmaps.

• Offering Ownership: Design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, enablement content, educational material, and technical presentations for webinars and events, and lead development of the most complex and strategic net-new offerings.

• Standards & Quality: Maintain high technical, content, and lab quality standards across the portfolio, ensuring that project outputs and contributions, including work from Associate Services Architects, consistently adhere to established team standards and templates.

• Roadmap Alignment: Stay informed about Tenable product changes, evaluate requirements for offering updates, and plan portfolio updates well ahead of product release.

• Advisory: Advise the Senior Director, Services Portfolio, on offering strategy, resourcing, and delivery risk.

Content Development & Delivery

• Requirements Review: Review user and technical requirements for completeness and clarity.

• Collateral: Create collateral for new offerings and evaluate existing offerings and content for accuracy and relevance.

• Pre-Production Training: Deliver pre-production training sessions to evaluate product suitability and gather early feedback.

• Live Demonstrations: Create live demonstration recordings for the Tenable product suite.

• Content Review: Perform content reviews with peers in Services, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Management to ensure quality and alignment with customer needs, and act as the final technical approver for release.

• Customer Experience: Periodically teach customer classes or deliver service engagements to obtain intimate knowledge of the customer experience.

Strategic Engagement & Support

• Field Perspective: Collaborate with Professional Services peers to understand the field perspective on service and training offering requirements.

• Customer & Partner Engagement: Engage with customers and partners to analyze market trends and the competitive landscape, and translate findings into portfolio decisions.

• Problem Solving: Provide solutions to a wide range of difficult problems while maintaining a positive attitude and positive working relationships, gathering information to support data-driven decisions.

• Escalation Support: Act as the final escalation point for Customer Care, Services, and Product escalations relating to portfolio content that the Associate Services Architect cannot resolve.

• Staying Current: Remain abreast of corporate direction and strategy, product roadmaps, messaging, and emerging trends in the security industry.

Project, People & Process

• Delivery Oversight: Independently manage assigned projects and provide delivery oversight of team members’ projects to ensure delivery on schedule and on budget.

• Mentoring: Mentor and develop Associate Services Architect colleagues, including setting expectations for the Associate role’s intake and review.

• Process Improvement: Remain abreast of educational learning frameworks, content development approaches, and technologies that may reduce cost or shorten development timelines, and drive adoption where they do.

• Other Duties: May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

What You'll Need:

Experience

• Security Foundations: 5+ years of overall experience in Information Security.

• Vulnerability Management & Cybersecurity: 1+ years of experience in vulnerability management and broader cybersecurity operations, ideally utilizing enterprise assessment tools such as the Tenable product suite.

• Services Experience: 3+ years of professional services, technical support, or sales engineering experience.

• Curriculum Design: Proven experience designing and delivering technical curricula, training, and customer enablement programs, as well as leading others to do so.

Knowledge and Education

• Education: B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

• Technical Depth: In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems and of TCP/IP networking.

• Emerging Domains: Working knowledge of web application security, container security, cloud environments (AWS/Azure), and ICS/SCADA systems, with in-depth expertise in at least one.

• Security Tools: Familiarity with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Kali Linux, and Metasploit.

Other Requirements

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior internal and customer audiences.

• Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including at a senior level.

• Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both in a self-directed manner and as part of a geographically distributed team, setting direction for others without day-to-day supervision.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Clinical Operations Manager

DEPARTMENT: Monitoring

Ora Values the Daily Practice of …

Prioritizing Kindness * Operational Excellence * Cultivating Joy * Scientific Rigor

At Ora, we are building the future of ophthalmic clinical research. As the world’s leading full-service ophthalmic drug and device development firm, we guide our clients across all phases of clinical research to efficiently bring new products and therapies to market. Over the past 45 years, our expert teams have helped earn more than 85 new product approvals. Ora's pre-clinical and clinical models, unique methodologies, integrated clinical data solutions, and global regulatory strategies have been refined and proven across thousands of global projects. Today, our team continues to expand across the globe, with over 600 employees across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

The Role:

The Clinical Operations Manager is a key operational leader within the Clinical Monitoring organization, responsible for overseeing and optimizing Clinical Trial Associate (CTA) support activities across Ora clinical studies. This role serves as a liaison between CTA teams, CRAs, Project Managers and Clinical Operations leadership to ensure efficient, compliant and high-quality trial execution.

The role provides operational leadership, mentorship, training, process oversight, resource coordination and continuous improvement support for CTA activities while driving operational excellence and inspection readiness.

What You’ll Do:

Clinical Trial Associate Operational Leadership

• Serve as the operational lead and subject matter expert for CTA functions within the Clinical Monitoring organization.

• Partner with Leadership to implement operational strategies, departmental objectives and process improvements.

• Oversee resource forecasting and workload assessments for the CTA group

• Provide functional leadership, guidance, mentoring and day-to-day support to CTA staff.

• Support onboarding, training and professional development initiatives for CTAs.

• Approve time reporting and expenses for direct reports

• Act as an escalation point for CTA operational issues and collaborate with Monitoring leadership to resolve challenges.

Monitoring Operations Support

• Partner with Project Managers, CTMs and CRAs to ensure CTA activities support project plans and study timelines.

• Monitor CTA-related performance metrics and operational indicators.

• Support inspection readiness and audit preparedness activities.

• Provide operational oversight of CTA deliverables to ensure quality and compliance.

Process Excellence and Continuous Improvement

• Lead initiatives focused on standardization, optimization, automation and continuous improvement.

• Support development and maintenance of SOPs, work instructions, training materials and operational tools.

• Promote effective utilization of CTMS, eTMF and other clinical technologies.

• Identify operational risks and recommend solutions.

Study Oversight and Compliance

• Oversee CTA support activities related to study startup, maintenance and closeout.

• Ensure study documentation and TMF activities remain complete and inspection-ready.

• Support compliance with sponsor requirements, SOPs, ICH-GCP guidelines and regulations.

Additional Responsibilities

• Occasionally assist study projects where additional oversight of more junior team members is needed, or there is a need for more resources.

• Responsibilities may differ slightly from the above based on specific needs of the business.

• Clear and sustained demonstration of the Ora Clinical’s Values of prioritizing kindness, operational excellence, cultivating joy and scientific rigor.

What We Look For:

• Experience needed for the Role: Bachelor’s degree with 5 years’ experience as a clinical research experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Years of experience may be considered in lieu of education Minimum of 1 year of management or leadership experience, preferably in a CRO setting

• Additional Skills & Attributes: Extensive clinical operations experience in clinical trials specifically following Ora processes, and utilizing Ora standard tools such as Veeva Vault document management system (eTMF and CTMS), ICH GCP, DIA TMF Reference Model and regulatory guidelines/directives is strongly preferred Proven ability to lead multifunctional teams and manage and mentor junior clinical operations staff. Prior CRO experience is strongly preferred Ability to motivate and lead / mentor a team and identify and execution coaching opportunities Understanding of comprehensive regulatory requirements and implications for clinical operations. Experience managing external partnerships and relations (e.g., sites, vendors, sponsors). Detailed knowledge of regulatory requirements and ICH/GCP guidelines to support clinical trial documentation needs and records management. Extensive clinical operations experience in ophthalmology clinical trials. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, complete tasks to deadlines. Ability to communicate effectively with internal team and, when necessary, sponsors and external vendors, including issue escalation, training and responding to inquiries and concerns.

• Competencies and Personal Traits:

• What We Do: Execution Excellence: Ability to set goals, create structure and maintain a focused and collaborative approach to the delivery of timely and high-quality work. How We Do It: IQ, EQ and SQ: Agile and positive thinker, communicator and collaborator who uses a growth mindset to work and lead with authenticity, transparency, resilience, and empathy. Scientific, intellectual, and emotional/social curiosity creates the willingness and ability to innovate, make mistakes, learn and try again. Clear and Direct Communication, Feedback and Conflict Resolution: Practice radical candor in your communication and participate in active Giving and receiving feedback frequently, with an open heart and mind creates psychological safety and promotes faster, individual, team and company growth. Why We Do It: Seek Meaning and Purpose and a Desire to be Part of Something Bigger than Yourself: Crave being part of a team that works together under shared values to achieve significant positive impact in the wider world. At Ora, we are creating vision beyond what we see.

What We Offer:

• Well Being: Offering comprehensive healthcare options in Medical, Dental and Vision beginning day 1.

• Flexible PTO & Unlimited Sick Time: Providing you the freedom to unwind and recharge when you need to in addition to 14 company paid holidays.

• Financial: Competitive salaries along with a 401K plan through Fidelity with company match.

• Family Support Care: Adoption and fertility assistance provided along with offering 16 weeks paid Parental Leave.

• Company Paid Life & Disability Insurance: Offering peace of mind to help you and your family feel secure.

• Remote & Wellness Reimbursement: We'll reimburse you to support your remote workspace and wellness purchases.

• Employee Assistance Program: No matter what issues you're facing, New Directions is here to help you and your family.

• Career Development Opportunities: Continued opportunities to grow and develop your career journey.

• Global Team: Opportunities to work with colleagues across the globe.

• Impact: A chance to research new ophthalmic therapies that will impact patients across the globe.

Benefit Eligibility: Full-time employees of Ora working a minimum of 30 hours per week. Our per diem workforce is eligible for Medical and Dental coverage once they have hit 6 months of service and work an average of 30 hours per week.

Our mission is to weave together people, processes, and technology to support innovation in ophthalmology around the world. We believe our business should be a force for good — to improve, heal, and change how we see. As a global company, our vibrant community and culture are nurtured by our core values: Prioritizing kindness, cultivating joy, operational excellence, and scientific rigor. Through our commitment to these values, we have built an inclusive and supportive work environment that fosters respect, accountability, and a fulfilling work-life balance for every team member.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. People of color, the LGBTQIA+ community, disabled candidates and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Ora is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and fair, equitable compensation regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

We are looking for a Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver to join our Rexel USA team in Midland, TX!

Summary:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities. The Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment
• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims
• Prepare branch orders from the warehouse and ensure that the correct number and type of product is being shipped
• Process paperwork regarding shipments including but not limited to verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct postage tape and label, following customer shipping instructions, and insuring the shipment when necessary
• Operate machinery including forklift, reach truck, and wire cutting machine when required
• Load common carrier and company vehicles
• Inspect and perform minor maintenance on equipment
• Perform inventory counts and reconcile any discrepancies
• Operate delivery vehicles to make deliveries to and from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers
• Inspect company vehicle for visual and operating defects; responsible for completing a daily inspection report
• Keep company vehicle clean, serviced, and maintained; alert supervisor of repair and/or service needed
• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations
• Load or unload vehicle and ensure all material for each order is correct (quantity and type of material) and that material is free of damage before departure
• May assist in preparing orders for delivery

• Pick up material returns from customers; responsible for inspecting the condition of the material and verify quantities and catalog numbers
• Pick up material from company suppliers

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization.  We ensure that our distribution centers and warehouse facilities function at maximum efficiency.   Safety is a core value in our distribution environment.  We emphasize this through training, education and accident prevention programs.  Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways.  If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

What You Need:

• Ability to grip/grasp continuously during the assigned shift.
• Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently during the assigned shift.
• Ability to work designated shift including overtime as required, which could include time before or after the designated shift and/or weekends.
• Exposure to wide range of temperatures
• Ability to successfully complete forklift certification process
• Reading comprehension skills up to high school level
• Writing skills up to high school level
• Math skills – basic arithmetic, addition, subtraction
• Attention to detail.
• Ability to work safely and adhere to safety guidelines in a warehouse environment.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Want to help everyday Americans invest and build wealth? Financial inequality is increasing, and too many people are getting left behind. At Stash, we're passionate about democratizing wealth creation through education, advice, and products that help customers achieve greater financial freedom. We also believe in working smarter—leveraging AI and emerging technologies to move faster, operate more efficiently, and focus our time on solving meaningful problems for our customers.

The Lifecycle team is responsible for helping customers take the right next step—from sign-up to becoming active, long-term investors. As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you'll own retention, churn prevention, and winback—the programs that keep customers subscribed, funded, and invested over time, and bring them back when they lapse.

You'll partner closely with Data Science and Product to identify churn signals, design targeted interventions, and measure what actually moves retention. While our Engagement manager focuses on driving ongoing product usage and habit formation, you'll focus on the other side of the coin: keeping customers from leaving, catching them before they churn, and winning them back when they do. This is a strategic, analytical role for someone who thinks in cohorts and leakage points—not just campaigns.

This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on-site in our New York office at least three days per week to work with stakeholders and foster team collaboration.

What you'll do:

• Own lifecycle strategy for retention, churn prevention, and winback—from identifying at-risk customers to designing rescue flows and reactivation programs

• Partner with Data Science to define churn signals, build predictive and behavioral segments, and prioritize interventions based on impact and reach

• Partner with Product to align lifecycle messaging with product changes, subscription flows, pricing transitions, and friction points that drive churn

• Design and optimize churn prevention programs—early warning journeys, save flows, and proactive outreach for users showing disengagement or cancellation intent

• Build and iterate winback and rescue strategies for lapsed subscribers, unfunded accounts, and dormant investors—testing offers, messaging, and channel mix

• Assist in developing a retention measurement framework: define core metrics (churn rate, save rate, winback conversion, LTV impact), attribution windows, and reporting cadences

• Analyze cohort behavior and lifecycle leakage to identify where customers drop off—and design targeted programs to address root causes

• Assess the existing retention and winback portfolio: identify what's working, what's redundant, and what should be built, optimized, or sunset

• Run rigorous A/B tests and experiments; translate results into clear strategic recommendations, not just incremental tweaks

• Support major business moments (pricing changes, product repositioning, subscription model shifts) with retention-focused lifecycle comms for existing customers

• Mentor lifecycle marketers and associates; contribute to hiring and team development

What we're looking for:

• 7–10+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or growth marketing—with deep expertise in retention, churn prevention, or winback

• Analytical and strategic mindset—you think in cohorts, funnels, and leakage points; you use data to define problems before designing solutions

• Proven track record of improving retention and reactivation metrics (e.g., churn rate, save rate, winback conversion, subscription retention, LTV)

• Experience partnering with Data Science or analytics teams to build churn models, behavioral segments, or predictive targeting—not just pulling reports

• Experience partnering with Product to address retention through both messaging and product/UX improvements

• Strong understanding of subscription and fintech retention dynamics—cancellation flows, payment failures, passive churn, pricing sensitivity

• Ability to audit a complex program portfolio and make strategic calls on what to prioritize, optimize, or kill

• Strong communication skills—you write clearly for internal partners (strategy docs, data-backed recommendations, briefs) and external audiences (customer-facing retention and winback copy)

• Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces; you create structure and momentum without waiting for a playbook

• Bias for action balanced with rigor—you move fast, but you validate with data

Gold Stars

• Experience in fintech, investing, or subscription-based products

• Hands-on Braze expertise

• Familiarity with Mixpanel, Looker, Redshift, or warehouse-based analytics for cohort and churn analysis

• Experience with promotions platforms, dynamic offers, or personalized winback incentives

We proudly celebrate the unique qualities that make you you, 365 days a year, and not just because it’s the right thing to do or good for business. Our vision is to bring hope, happiness, and healing to the world through cannabis, and we’re doing it one state, one store, and one customer at a time.

Leadership defines how we show up. Data drives how we grow. Gratitude keeps us grounded. Unity fuels our momentum. And growth, in every sense, inspires everything we do.

If you’re ready to challenge what’s expected and shape the future of cannabis, your next chapter starts with Story.

Overview:

We’re looking for a dependable and detail-oriented Janitor to maintain a clean, safe, and compliant environment in our cannabis manufacturing facility. This role is essential to ensuring that production areas meet strict cleanliness and safety standards required by state and federal regulations.

Responsibilities:

• Clean and sanitize all facility areas including production rooms, offices, restrooms, break areas, and storage spaces.

• Perform routine cleaning of floors, walls, equipment exteriors, and surfaces.

• Collect and dispose of waste, recyclables, and compostable materials according to facility protocols.

• Support deep-cleaning and sanitation schedules for processing and packaging areas.

• Basic understanding of cleaning chemicals and handling procedures.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/top-100-next-unicorns-the-uk-france-and-germany-lead-with-the-most-promising-technology-companies-in-europe/ 2025 Great Place to Work certified. About the Role:

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth.

As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.



What You Will Do:

 - Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises.

 - Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog.

 - Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate.

 - Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model.

 - Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way.



What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

 - Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity.

 - Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.

 - Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

 - Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance.

 - Ability and/or willingness to use our product https://accounts.cloud.camunda.io/signup?_ga=2.47330343.127558761.1654184528-504024057.1654184528.

Nice to Haves:

 - Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.

 - Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.

 - Experience implementing IAM federation.

 - Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

 - Experience with L3 support/incident management.

 - Experience working in a fully remote organization.

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for   key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.

• Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.

• Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.

• Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.

• Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.

• Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.

• Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.

Professional Experience and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.

• 2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.

• Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.

• Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.

• Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.

• Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.

• Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.

• Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.

• Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.

• Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.

• Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Sound like you? Apply now!

jobs.title: Full Time Floor Leader - South Hills Village
jobs.description:
Position: Full Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 30-39 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

South Hills Pay

$16.50—$16.50 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

YouTube
LinkedIn

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — Forge & Build is Hiring a Sales Associate

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

Forge & Build is hiring a Sales Associate at our facility in Elwood, KS, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Sales Associate is a critical, front-line, customer-facing role responsible for delivering exceptional in-store customer service. Key responsibilities include managing customer walk-ins, handling incoming calls, processing orders, and supporting outside sales representatives. This position is pivotal in assisting and resolving customer issues to ensure a consistently positive experience, and it serves as an excellent opportunity for learning and career growth within the Forge & Build business.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (Includes working weekends)

Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as the first point of contact, providing outstanding customer service, exceeding customer expectations, and maintaining a friendly, professional attitude for walk-ins and incoming calls.

• Process sales orders, quotes, pricing requests, and apply payments on customer accounts.

• Responsible for stocking, cleaning, merchandising, and maintaining overall store cleanliness and a safe shopping environment.

• Assists in unloading merchandise that is received in the store.

• Maintain strong knowledge of all product lines available at the store and the ability to provide product information.

• Helps identify new business opportunities by referring potential leads (contractors, builders, developers, homeowners, etc.) to outside sales representatives.

• Responsible for learning and understanding the BisTrack system, including identifying inventory discrepancies, receiving, and POS tasks.

• Ensure effective and timely communication to the store and internal clients, developing and providing action items to improve issues with a sense of urgency.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

About Forge & Build

Forge & Build is a place contractors and customers can access all the materials and hardware they need to get the job done, as well as tech-powered equipment rentals.

At its foundation, Forge & Build was started by contractors for contractors. Its leadership team is different from our competitors because they know what it feels like to be a builder. They remember walking into a hardware store hoping to find everything in one place, but many times having to head to another store.

As a partner of EquipmentShare, Forge & Build is backed by one of the largest construction equipment buyers in the country, a nationwide support team and T3 technology that helps builders of America increase overall productivity, efficiency, and visibility. EquipmentShare is building connectivity for all verticals in construction including materials – which means having accurate and up-to-date information around inventory and location of materials to ensure our customers always have what they need.

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Possess a strong customer service skill set, consistently providing excellent experience to current and potential customers.

• Effective communication (clear, accurate, and timely to all internal and external customers) and problem-solving ability.

• Fosters a strong collaboration and partnership with all internal team members.

• Ability to provide general product knowledge and understanding of upselling to customers.

• Maintains a professional appearance and positive attitude at all times.

• Able to thrive in both collaborative and autonomous environments.

• Self-driven with an entrepreneurial mindset, adaptable and agile to quickly learn new and changing technologies and processes.

• Embodies Equipmentshare mission and culture, with adherence to all company employee policies and regular, reliable attendance.

• Other duties as assigned by management.

Education and Experience:

• Preferred experience with providing a great customer experience.

• General knowledge of the construction industry is a plus.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, effective and consistent with internal and external customers.

• Understanding basic math for calculating quantities and processing sales.

• Effective organizational, time management, detail orientation, and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to adapt quickly, thrive, and succeed in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be able to drive and maintain a valid driver’s license.

• Inherent desire to learn, develop on an individual basis, and strive for continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to stand and walk for prolonged periods of time.

• Ability to move products and assist with layout changes (must be able to lift up to 50 lbs at a time).

• Move self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including tight and confined spaces, which will require bending and stooping.

• May be required to work in extreme outside temperatures while assisting customers.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

jobs.title: Region Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Region Pricing Analyst to join our Rexel USA team in Houston, Dallas or Austin Location!

Summary:

The Region Pricing Analyst is responsible for reviewing transactional sales data and determining opportunities for margin improvement for assigned region. Uses various reports and tools to make recommendations to the pricing manager or director regarding pricing actions to be taken to improve sales productivity and accuracy of customer pricing. Works directly with the fields sales organization to secure copies of SPA contracts and prepares them for load into the ERP system. Maintains resale pricing as needed for customer specific requests.

What You'll Do:

• Analyze pricing and margin data and recommend pricing updates to meet margin improvement goals and strategies outlined by the company for assigned region
• Work Special Pricing Agreement (SPA) expiration report with field sales and management to ensure renewals of cost and sell are completed in time to avoid lapses in customer service and profit leaks
• Monitor vendor price increases and adjust resale pricing to maximize profitability
• Identify system resale pricing errors and provide solutions to maintenance group
• Create and analyze reports to measure key pricing metrics such as percent overrides
• Become an expert on all pricing software systems utilized in the assigned branches
• Formats and prepares pricing documents and spreadsheets for loading into the ERP system
• Conduct branch pricing reviews / branch audits, specifically looking at customer segmentation, price matrices, SPA utilization and renewal process, and override rates. Identify potential changes, get acceptance from sales team, implement changes and measure results
• Other duties as assigned

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. • Demonstrated orientation to challenge the status quo and initiate change
• Strong project management and presentation skills

jobs.description:
At Hawthorne Residential Partners, we’re looking for dependable, motivated, and hands on maintenance professionals who take pride in creating clean, well-maintained, and welcoming communities.

We offer more than just a job, we offer a path to grow your skills, learn new trades, and build a career. You’ll work alongside a team who will support you, challenge you, and cheer you on every step of the way.

Join a company where your work matters and your future is full of opportunity!

As Maintenance Technician II, you will handle work orders independently, assist with preventative maintenance, and support day-to-day upkeep across the community. This role requires HVAC certification and a working knowledge of routine repairs.

Experience:

Licenses & Certifications:

• EPA/ HVAC Certification

• CPO Certification is a plus

Maintenance Technician II | Job Functions

• Assure all service requests are completed by Hawthorne standards.

• Repair and restore vacant apartments to make ready status in preparation for the next move-in as per company standard.

• Assist with pool maintenance and cleaning.

• Completion of preventative maintenance according to the guidelines outlined in company policy.

Maintaining Building & Grounds

• Perform building and common area upkeep daily. Assist in keeping ground neat and free of litter, debris, and pet waste.

• Maintain shop appearance to facilitate quick assessment of supply inventory.

Additional Responsibilities

• Promote good professional relations with residents, co-workers, and company staff. Through the LIVE IT culture, always display a friendly and courteous attitude towards prospects, residents, vendors, and other employees. Always maintain professionalism.

• Conduct on-call emergency service rotation as scheduled

jobs.title: Lead VFX Artist
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

What it means on a daily basis

• VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
• Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
• Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
• VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
• Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
• Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

What success will look like

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

jobs.title: Lead Animator

Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a Lead Animator to lead the animation team working on a new action-based, multi-platform IP featuring world-famous characters from a major licensor.

Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. jobs.title: Game Cinematic Artist Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

As a Game Cinematic Artist Intern, you will join our team in Barcelona and learn how cinematic sequences are created and implemented directly inside a real-time game engine.

Working alongside our artists and game team, you will help create compelling camera shots and sequences for our games, from race introductions and menu sequences to in-game cinematics. You will develop your eye for framing, composition and visual storytelling while gaining hands-on experience with our cinematic tools and pipelines.

What it means on a daily basis

• Create and adapt 3D camera shots and cinematic sequences inside our real-time game engine, including race intros, menu sequences and in-game cinematics.
• Work with 3D characters, vehicles and other game assets, positioning them within scenes and finding the best framing and composition.
• Learn and work with our existing real-time cinematic tools and pipelines, maintaining and updating sequences as the game evolves.
• Review and test your work directly in-game, identifying visual or technical issues and making the necessary adjustments.
• Collaborate with the game and art teams, responding to feedback and supporting new cinematic needs throughout production.

WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In your first 3 months, you will become familiar with our game engine, cinematic pipeline and existing camera sequences, progressively contributing your own shots with guidance from the team.

By 6 months, you will be comfortable creating and adapting camera sequences for different areas of the game, testing your work and incorporating feedback with increasing autonomy.

As you progress, you will develop a stronger understanding of real-time cinematics and visual storytelling while contributing polished camera work that enhances the presentation of our games.

WHO YOU WOULD BE WORKING WITH

You will work closely with our Art and Game teams in Barcelona, collaborating with the people responsible for the characters, environments and game content featured in your cinematic sequences.

You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking more ownership of your work as you become familiar with our tools and pipelines.

YOUR RECRUITMENT JOURNEY

• Recruiter interview
• Hiring team interview
• Portfolio/showreel review
• Test

WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU

This internship will give you practical experience in real-time cinematics within a professional game development environment, developing transferable skills in camera work, composition, 3D workflows and visual storytelling.

You will also gain exposure to how Art and Game teams collaborate to take cinematic content from an initial idea to its final implementation in-game.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Basic understanding of 3D environments and workflows, including navigating scenes and manipulating 3D objects.
• Understanding of camera composition, framing and visual storytelling in a 3D environment.
• Familiarity with at least one real-time game engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
• Ability to understand how positioning, framing and camera movement can help present 3D characters, vehicles and environments effectively.
• Good attention to both visual and technical details.
• Good level of English.
• Ability to sign an internship agreement with a school or university.

WHO YOU ARE

• Curious about video games, film and visual storytelling.
• Eager to learn new tools, workflows and technical pipelines.
• Creative, with a good eye for composition and presentation.
• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on your work.
• Organized and able to work towards deadlines.
• Proactive while knowing when to ask the team for guidance.
• Detail-oriented and willing to test and review your own work.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Benefits

• Internship agreement for 6 months
• Flexible schedule adapted to your student needs
• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• An exceptional, dynamic, demanding and motivating working environment within a fast-growing company
• Free coffee in the office

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

jobs.title: AI Sales Solutions Engineer (Presales with AI focus)
jobs.description:
Champion AI is the strategic future of QAD | Redzone, and we are building a dedicated AI division to own it — this is where the company’s attention, investment, and ambition are concentrated. The strategy and the technical foundation are built; we need solution designers who can execute it and scale it across customers.

There has never been a better moment to sit at the frontier of agentic AI for manufacturing. We are assembling a small team of operators to capture it, and this role helps define what “great” looks like.

The Role

The AI Sales Solutions Engineer is a solution designer. You walk into a customer conversation, understand their end-to-end process, and assemble an agentic solution to fix it — without engineering involvement.

You sit on top of a pre-built foundation — data, semantics, an agent platform, and a library of persona agents. You configure within it; you don’t build it. The platform exposes configuration through natural language and drag-and-drop, so your edge is domain fluency and solution-design instinct, not code.

What You’ll Do

Working hand-in-hand with other Account Executives, you take a qualified opportunity and turn it into a working agentic solution:

• Run process discovery workshops: sit with champion users to map any of the standard enterprise processes (P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R) — current state, KPIs, manual effort, bottlenecks, and target state.
• Design the agentic solution: decide which agents, working together, fix the customer’s process — and recognize whether it’s a greenfield build or a brownfield plug-in to an existing system (SAP, Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer).
• Map KPIs to the platform: confirm the system has the data and the business context to measure what the customer actually cares about.
• Configure each agent: set triggers, decision logic, exceptions, KPIs, data sources, communications, company-specific rules, and hand-offs — all in natural language and drag-and-drop, no code.
• Present the solution: pitch anchored in business outcomes — OTIF, working capital, cycle time, cost reduction — worked backwards to the agents that achieve them.

• You are a quota carrier with 3 or more years of experience selling Tech/AI/SaaS solutions.
• Enterprise domain fluency: operational, end-to-end working knowledge of at least two of P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R — not just a consulting view. The deepest value sits in plan-to-make and procure-to-pay.
• Solution-design thinking: ability to decompose a vague business outcome into agents and data flows, and to know when one agent suffices and when several are needed.
• Low-code / natural-language comfort: hands-on with tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make. The agent platform will feel familiar.
• Customer-facing credibility: workshop facilitation and executive-level presentation.

Nice-to-Have

• Background at a major ERP vendor or process consultancy (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba, or a Big Four firm).
• Hands-on experience with AI tooling.
• Industry depth in manufacturing, particularly tier-one suppliers.

Not Required

Model-building, software-engineering depth, or an ML / data-science background. Engineering owns the platform; you own the solution.

Who Thrives Here

• You are joining a small, entrepreneurial team — not a delivery machine with a ticket queue. We want self-starters who see the opportunity in agentic AI and move without waiting for instructions.
• Self-starter: if a solution pattern or workshop framework doesn’t exist yet, you create it. If a document is missing, you write it.
• Resourceful: you pull in the right people — your AE, Product, and Customer Success — to move a deal forward and get the customer to value.
• Builder’s mindset: you take a strong foundation and a playbook and extend them as the platform matures, rather than waiting for every process to be defined for you.
• If you need rigid structure and a clearly defined process for every situation, this is not the right place. If you want to shape how this role and this division are built, it is.

• Compensation. $100,000— 140,000 USD (Open)
• Plus a strong benefits package inclusive of PTO, 401K matching, and Healthcare/Medical Insurance plans.
• Virtual-First Culture: work remotely, with the flexibility to lead in-person customer workshops in your market.
• Atmosphere of Growth: join a team where idea-sharing is prioritized over hierarchy, at the leading edge of agentic AI for manufacturing.
• Comprehensive Benefits: health, dental, vision, PTO, 401K matching, and a collaborative culture of smart, hard-working people.

About QAD:

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Protein Production
jobs.description:
What if… you could pioneer a new approach to designing life’s most essential molecules?

FL116, backed by Flagship Pioneering, is an early-stage biotechnology company transforming the way biomolecules are synthesized. Our innovative platform has the potential to redefine how critical research, diagnostic, and therapeutic molecules are designed and built. We are seeking passionate problem solvers ready to make a profound impact on biotechnology and therapeutic innovation.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and exceptionally organized Research Associate II to expand our protein production capabilities across two complementary scales: bulk expression and purification of individual high-priority targets, and high-throughput parallel production of large variant panels. This hands-on, laboratory-facing role will execute and advance scalable protein expression, purification, normalization, and characterization workflows that feed the design–build–test cycles at the core of our platform.

The successful candidate will bring direct, practical experience in recombinant protein production and chromatographic purification at both preparative and high-throughput scale — together with the ability to execute experiments, run high-throughput analytics, troubleshoot workflows, and deliver well-characterized protein reagents on rapid timelines. This individual will work closely with Protein Engineering, Chemistry, and Assay Development team to align production activities with program priorities and experimental timelines. Meticulous record-keeping and sample traceability are essential to this role. Experience with liquid handlers, magnetic-bead purification platforms such as the KingFisher, cell-free expression, or workflow scripting is preferred.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is motivated to apply automation and emerging technologies to developing a synthetic biology platform.

Key Responsibilities

Bulk Expression & Purification

• Execute multi-liter recombinant expression campaigns in bacteria from construct transformation and culture growth through induction, harvest, and lysis.

• Design, build, and run preparative purification methods on ÄKTA FPLC systems using UNICORN, including affinity, ion exchange, size exclusion, and mixed-mode chromatography.

• Deliver milligram-to-gram quantities of highly pure, well-characterized protein.

• Troubleshoot expression and purification challenges such as low yield, insolubility, aggregation, and proteolysis, and drive protocol improvements that increase yield and purity.

High-Throughput Production & Analytics

• Bacterial library transformation, colony picking and sequencing

• Execute miniaturized, parallel protein expression and purification in plate-based formats

• Perform automated purification, sample normalization, and quality assessment to deliver fit-for-purpose protein reagents at scale.

• Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and continuously improve liquid handlers, magnetic-bead purification platforms (e.g., KingFisher), automated purification systems, and associated analytical instrumentation.

• Run high-throughput protein analytics across many samples in parallel, including plate-based quantitation, capillary electrophoresis, analytical SEC/SEC-HPLC, and thermal stability or aggregation screening.

• Translate methods between scales — adapting preparative purifications into miniaturized high-throughput formats, and scaling promising hits back up for in-depth characterization.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, biotechnology, bioengineering, synthetic biology or a related scientific discipline with 1-4 years s of relevant academic and/or industry experience; or a master’s degree with 0-2 years of commercial experience.

• Hands-on experience with recombinant protein expression and production workflows in E. coli, including multi-liter culture growth and harvest.

• Direct, hands-on experience operating ÄKTA FPLC systems, including independently designing, executing, and troubleshooting purification methods in UNICORN — not solely running pre-established protocols.

• Demonstrated proficiency across multiple column purification modalities.

• Demonstrated experience working at both scales: preparative purification of individual targets to milligram-or-greater quantities, and parallel, plate-based production and analytics across large sample sets.

• Exceptional organization and record-keeping, with a proven ability to track samples, buffers, and method runs in parallel without loss of traceability.

• Core molecular biology skills, including plasmid preparation, cloning, and transformation.

• Ability to independently execute experiments, analyze data, troubleshoot technical problems, maintain accurate documentation, and advance assigned work.

• Ability to maintain flexibility in the face of evolving priorities and short timelines in a collaborative, matrixed research environment.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a clear commitment to laboratory safety and data integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with magnetic-bead–based purification platforms such as the Thermo KingFisher.

• Familiarity with cell-free or yeast expression systems.

• Hands-on experience programming and operating liquid handlers and robotic workstations (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, Bravo).

• Comfort organizing and analyzing experimental data in Excel, Python, or similar tools, and maintaining structured records in an ELN or LIMS.

Who You Are

Innovative Pioneer: You are excited to help build new production capabilities and continually look for better ways to make and characterize protein.

Collaborative Contributor: You work effectively across disciplines, partnering closely with scientists in protein engineering, assay development, automation, machine learning, and beyond.

Inventive Problem Solver: You proactively identify challenges and rapidly develop creative, practical solutions.

Comfortable at Any Scale: You move easily between a careful multi-step purification of a single important target and a plate of ninety-six variants, and you bring the same rigor to both.

Rigorously Organized: You keep meticulous records, design your workflows so results are reproducible months later, and are trusted by colleagues to know exactly where every sample stands.

Mission-Driven Individual: You are motivated by the opportunity to fundamentally transform how biomolecules are designed and synthesized, with meaningful impact on human health and biotechnology.

More About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Pioneering conceives, creates, resources, and develops first-in-category life sciences companies to transform human health and sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, generating billions in value. Flagship companies are known for addressing humanity’s most pressing challenges and advancing innovative solutions with global impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams. If you have some of the qualifications listed above but not all, we still encourage you to apply. We value passion, experience in many forms, and unique backgrounds.

Come pioneer the future with us.

Position Summary:

The Veterinary Assistant provides essential support to the veterinarian during outpatient exams and throughout the diagnosis and treatment of patients. They care for all patients, assist with medical procedures, and help ensure each patient receives high-quality, compassionate care. In this role, the Veterinary Assistant also serves as a key connection between the veterinarian and clients. Through exceptional service and communication, the Veterinary Assistant helps build trust and foster lasting relationships with clients and their pets.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provides compassionate, professional care to patients and clients at all times.

• Communicates clearly and respectfully with clients, doctors, and team members, including answering phones and routing inquiries as needed.

• Handles sensitive client situations with empathy and discretion, escalating medical questions appropriately.

• Assists the veterinarian during exams, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures.

• Safely restrains animals of varying sizes and temperaments using low-stress handling techniques.

• Administers medications, draws up vaccines, collects lab samples, and performs basic lab tests as directed.

• Creates, reviews, and enters treatment plans accurately in the medical record system.

• Educates clients on common vaccinations, medications, and treatment protocols to ensure understanding of care plans and follow-up recommendations.

• Accurately records patient information and maintains organized, up-to-date medical records.

• Enters charges accurately and assists with the client check-out process, including processing payments when needed.

• Ensures exam rooms, treatment areas, and hospital spaces are clean, stocked, and well maintained.

• Demonstrates consistent reliability, punctuality, and commitment to supporting patients, clients, and hospital operations.

• Performs all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Basic computer proficiency, including the ability to use practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.

• Previous experience working with animals preferred; veterinary or animal care background strongly valued.

• Able to work safely around cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Maintains composure and professionalism in emotionally challenging or high-stress situations.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 130 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations.

Compensation and Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays and access to employee assistance program.

At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview of Opportunity

We are seeking a Release Train Engineer to serve in a dual capacity: supporting core feature development (~60%) while acting as the primary Release Engineer / Pipeline Guardian (~40%).

In this role, you will write clean, production-ready code while maintaining ownership of our software delivery pipeline. You will orchestrate release flows across DEV, TEST, and PROD environments, establish pipeline execution standards, enforce dependency management, and ensure frontend/backend compatibility during deployments.

This position is ideal for an engineer looking to grow into release architecture, DevOps coordination, and software delivery management.

What you will do:

• Full Stack Software Engineering (~60%) Design, implement, and maintain scalable feature code across the full technology stack. Develop, test, and deploy new code and efficient software solutions Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality and reusable code. Troubleshoot and debug issues in the application, including performance optimization and error handling Provide continuous maintenance, support, and enhancements in existing systems and platforms. Strong proficiency with Go programming language and best practices (or other modern programming languages) Collaborate with engineering team members to ensure code quality and system performance.

• Release Engineering & Pipeline Governance (~40%) Review and sequence incoming MRs to minimize deployment risks, verify BE/FE compatibility, and streamline delivery schedules. Coordinate and execute deployment cycles across DEV, TEST, and PROD environments, targeting a 1–2 day stabilization window between stages. Validate post-deployment installation integrity, resolve database/index mapping issues, and perform smoke tests on core functionality. Inspect exception dashboards post-release to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve deployment-related issues alongside development teams. Communicate post-deployment procedures (e.g., manual scripts, data re-processing) and maintain release documentation.

What you will need:

• 3+ years of professional software development experience across frontend and backend technologies.

• Mastery of Git workflows, complex merge strategies, conflict resolution, and release branching strategies.

• Active Top Secret (TS) clearance with willingness to undergo a Counterintelligence (CI) Polygraph.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools, build automation, and code-review workflows.

• Strong interpersonal and organizational skills to coordinate releases under pressure and resolve engineering bottlenecks diplomatically.

Nice to haves:

• Background supporting operational software systems, intelligence analysis tools, or government mission software.

• Hands-on experience with database index configurations, automated test suites (e.g., Cypress), and application monitoring dashboards.

• Basic understanding of infrastructure-as-code, deployment scripting, or containerized environments.

• SAFe RTE, AWS Certified Developer, or related Agile/DevOps certifications.
