jobs.title: Client Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Aescape is a New York-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes-driven practice.

Powered by real-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. 

Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. 

Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.



Aescape is looking for a Client Success Specialist who can build strong, trust-based relationships with the teams running our hospitality and wellness partner locations and help drive consistent utilization of Aescape’s technology on the ground. You’ll be the day-to-day partner contact behind healthy, growing accounts — keeping locations enabled, active, and supported as we scale our presence across the world’s leading recovery environments.

You’ll report to our Head of Client Strategy and Success, work alongside our Client Success Managers on their largest accounts, and collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Product, and Marketing as we redefine recovery as a measurable, outcomes-driven practice that millions of people rely on every day. This is an amazing opportunity to learn strategic account management from the inside, own real partner relationships early, and grow your client success career at a category-defining company. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

This role is based in Miami, FL. Travel to partner sites is expected.




WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 - Serve as the day-to-day contact for a set of hospitality and wellness locations (hotels, spas, wellness studios), supporting them from go-live through renewal

 - Drive session volume and utilization at partner locations through staff enablement, programming support, and ongoing coaching of on-property teams

 - Track partner health signals — CSAT, utilization trends, downtime — and flag emerging risk early so it can be addressed

 - Coordinate with Operations and Field teams on hardware uptime and issue resolution, keeping partners informed on status through to close-out

 - Capture and summarize structured partner feedback for Product and Marketing

 - Build trusted working relationships with the on-property contacts who drive daily adoption — general managers, spa and studio directors, front-desk and fitness staff

 - Proactively drive local demand for assigned locations: call and follow up with first-time guests and leads to book return sessions and convert them into members

 - Spend time on-site at partner locations after go-live to train front-desk and floor staff, run live demos, and build the daily habits that lift adoption

 - Plan and staff on-site activation events at partner locations, and represent the brand at local events, run clubs, and community fitness or wellness gatherings that drive foot traffic

 - Build referral relationships with nearby ancillary businesses (gyms, run clubs, studios, med-spas, hotels) to generate a steady flow of new guests to each location

 - Own local reputation: request and respond to reviews on Google, Yelp, BBB, and similar sites, and keep each location's listings accurate and active

 - Hit clear per-location targets for session volume, membership conversions, and new-guest acquisition, and report progress against them




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 2–3 years of client success, account coordination, account management, or hospitality/wellness operations experience — B2B, hardware, SaaS, or hospitality tech exposure a strong plus

 - Experience supporting a book of accounts or a portfolio of locations against retention, utilization, or growth goals

 - Experience in or around hospitality or wellness brands is highly valued

 - Strong communicator who builds trust quickly with day-to-day operational contacts and on-property teams

 - Highly organized, able to juggle multiple accounts and competing priorities without dropping the ball

 - Collaborative by nature — effective at working across Sales, Ops, Product, and Marketing

 - Genuine interest in health, wellness, recovery, and the future of physical AI

 - Ability to travel to partner sites locally 3-5x a week, and other sites domestically 1-2x a quarter

 - Comfort with outbound, sales-oriented work: calling leads and guests, following up, and closing memberships without hand-holding

 - A local network or the hustle to build one fast, and willingness to be on-site and in the community several days a week




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

 - Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery

 - The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living

 - Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun!

 - 100% employer-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents

 - Flexible time off

 - Quarterly Wellness Days - everyone fully unplugs

 - Generous parental leave

 - Complimentary OneMedical membership

 - 401(k) with employer matching

 - Home office budget

 - Annual stipend for professional development

 - Working late? Dinner is on us

 - Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends & family

Compensation: Base salary range of $65,000 - $80,000 annually, plus discretionary 10% annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave.

 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law.



BEGIN YOUR AESCAPE CAREER JOURNEY

At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team.

YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (TAM)- US
jobs.description:
About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Technical Account Management team is the technical backbone behind every SaaS (Feeds/Shopify) customer relationship. Led by our Lead Technical Account Manager, the team sits between customers' technical teams, Nivoda's product/engineering org, and regional Account Managers — making sure every feed integration works, keeps working, and keeps growing.

About the Role 🤔

You're the technical owner for a territory's worth of SaaS customers. A feed that's healthy and well-integrated compounds into a customer who trusts the platform and expands their catalogue; a feed left to rot quietly becomes a churn risk nobody saw coming. Your job is to make sure it's the former, everywhere in your territory — from first integration through years of live trading.

What will you be doing? 😎

Lead technical onboarding and feed integration setup for new SaaS (Feeds/Shopify) customers in your territory.

Monitor feed health and integration performance, and troubleshoot issues before they affect customer trading.

Partner with Product Marketing and sales to identify and unlock feed/SaaS expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

Be the technical escalation point between the customer, Nivoda's product/engineering teams, and Account Management.

Document integration patterns and feed configuration options; feed structured product feedback upstream.

Track integration health and adoption metrics across your book of SaaS accounts.

What do we need from you? 💪

Experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, or account management— ideally in e-commerce or SaaS.

Comfortable reading feed specs, debugging integration issues, and working directly with customer technical teams.

A clear communicator who can translate technical detail for both engineering and commercial audiences.

Organised across a multi-account territory with varying integration complexity.

Native or professional proficiency in English.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Client Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Senior Manager, Client Portfolio Management is responsible for leading the Client Portfolio Management (CPM), Project Services Coordinator (PSC), and Sample Management teams across Eurofins Medical Device Services (MDS).

This role serves as a critical bridge between Business Development, Client Portfolio Management, and Laboratory Operations, ensuring seamless execution of client programs from opportunity conversion through project delivery. The Senior Manager provides leadership and governance across the client delivery ecosystem, driving operational excellence, client satisfaction, revenue growth, and scalability across multiple laboratory sites in the United States.

The Senior Manager serves as the operational leader connecting the commercial organization and laboratory network, ensuring opportunities transition efficiently into successful delivery while maintaining a consistent and high-quality client experience across Medical Device Services.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and operational leader who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and can effectively align commercial teams, technical operations, and client-facing teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

Location: Lancaster, Pennsylvania (On-Site)

Travel: Approximately 20% domestic travel to Eurofins laboratory sites and client locations

Key Objectives

• Maximize revenue growth by leveraging Eurofins' combined testing and consulting capabilities across Medical Device Services.
• Position Eurofins as the partner of choice by supporting clients throughout the medical device product lifecycle, from concept and development through commercialization and post-market activities.
• Strengthen leadership relationships through a coordinated, cross-SBU approach that aligns commercial and operational priorities.
• Act as the primary operational interface between Business Development and delivery organizations, ensuring client objectives are effectively translated into successful execution.
• Enable scalability through standardized processes, operational oversight, and performance management across multiple sites.
• Drive continuous improvement in utilization, customer satisfaction, project execution, forecasting accuracy, and operational performance.
• Create a consistent client experience across the MDS network.
• Provide leadership across client portfolio management, project coordination, and sample management functions to ensure alignment between commercial commitments and laboratory execution.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and develop the Client Portfolio Management (CPM), Project Services Coordinator (PSC), and Sample Management teams across Medical Device Services.
• Establish organizational goals, KPIs, and performance expectations across all functions.
• Coach, mentor, and develop future leaders within the organization.
• Drive accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
• Support workforce planning, hiring, training, and succession planning.
• Promote a culture of client focus, operational excellence, collaboration, and ownership.
• Lead teams across multiple laboratory sites while ensuring consistency in processes, performance, and client experience.

Commercial & Client Delivery Alignment

• Partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Client Portfolio Managers to ensure smooth transition from opportunity development to execution.
• Support opportunity planning and account strategy discussions for key client programs.
• Ensure successful onboarding and execution of newly awarded business.
• Facilitate communication between client-facing teams and laboratory operations.
• Remove barriers that impact project execution, customer satisfaction, or revenue realization.
• Provide leadership oversight for strategic and high-value client portfolios.
• Align commercial commitments with laboratory capabilities, capacity, and delivery expectations.
• Support the development of integrated testing and consulting solutions that maximize value for clients and Eurofins.

Direct Client Portfolio Responsibility

In addition to leading the CPM, PSC, and Sample Management organizations, the Senior Manager will directly manage a limited portfolio of strategic client accounts as the assigned Client Portfolio Manager.

This responsibility ensures the Senior Manager maintains first-hand knowledge of client needs, commercial interactions, project execution processes, laboratory coordination requirements, and evolving operational challenges.

Key responsibilities include:

• Serve as the primary CPM for 1-2 strategic client portfolios.
• Maintain direct engagement with clients through routine communications, program reviews, and issue resolution.
• Coordinate delivery activities across commercial, consulting, laboratory, and operational teams.
• Identify opportunities for account expansion and cross-functional solutions.
• Apply insights gained from active client management to improve organizational processes, tools, training, and performance.
• Model the behaviors, client engagement practices, and operational discipline expected across the CPM organization.

Client Portfolio Management Leadership

• Establish governance and standards for portfolio management activities across MDS.
• Drive consistency in client communication, project tracking, risk management, and account planning.
• Monitor portfolio performance, forecasting accuracy, project execution, and customer satisfaction.
• Support CPMs in identifying account expansion opportunities and cross-functional solutions.
• Ensure alignment of portfolio activities with commercial growth objectives.
• Develop reporting and operational review mechanisms that support visibility, accountability, and decision-making.

Project Services & Program Execution

• Oversee project setup, intake, documentation, and execution readiness processes.
• Ensure effective coordination between CPMs, PSCs, Sample Management, and laboratory teams.
• Improve project initiation efficiency and reduce administrative bottlenecks.
• Drive standardization of project management tools, workflows, and reporting across MDS.
• Monitor key project delivery metrics and ensure timely escalation of risks.
• Ensure project support processes effectively enable laboratory operations and client delivery teams.

Sample Management Leadership

• Provide leadership oversight for sample receipt, registration, chain-of-custody, storage, inventory management, shipping, and disposal processes.
• Ensure compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and operational requirements.
• Drive efficiency, accuracy, and accountability throughout the sample lifecycle.
• Establish performance metrics related to turnaround time, quality, inventory accuracy, and productivity.
• Partner with laboratory leadership to ensure consistent sample management practices across sites.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on traceability, throughput, and operational excellence.

Laboratory Operations Partnership

• Collaborate with laboratory leadership to align capacity, resources, and project priorities.
• Support effective workload balancing across the laboratory network.
• Ensure client expectations are aligned with operational capabilities and timelines.
• Facilitate cross-site coordination for multi-laboratory projects and programs.
• Drive escalation and resolution of operational issues impacting client delivery.
• Foster strong relationships with laboratory leaders to improve communication, planning, and execution across the MDS network.

Financial & Business Performance

• Monitor revenue realization, forecasting accuracy, backlog health, utilization, project performance, and operational efficiency.
• Support forecasting and capacity planning activities.
• Drive initiatives that improve operational efficiency, resource utilization, and delivery performance.
• Support scalable growth through capacity planning, process optimization, and effective resource allocation.
• Ensure effective management of project financials, invoicing readiness, and revenue recognition support activities.
• Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and process improvements across the organization.

Process Excellence & Scalability

• Establish standardized operating procedures and best practices across the organization.
• Drive adoption and effective utilization of CRM, LIMS, PSA, and reporting tools.
• Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure organizational performance.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, efficiency, scalability, and customer experience.
• Foster a culture that embraces data-driven decision making.
• Ensure operational processes can scale to support business growth across multiple laboratory sites and service lines.

Success Metrics

• Revenue growth within existing portfolios
• Portfolio expansion and cross-sell success
• Client retention and satisfaction
• Forecast accuracy and backlog health
• Project onboarding and delivery performance
• Sample management quality, accuracy, and turnaround metrics
• Reduction in delivery issues and client escalations
• Employee engagement, development, and retention
• Process standardization and operational efficiency improvements
• Effective collaboration between commercial teams and laboratory operations

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, Operations Management, or related discipline.
• 8-12+ years of experience in laboratory services, medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated industries.
• 10+ years of direct leadership experience managing client-facing and/or operational teams.
• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional organizations in a multi-site environment.
• Experience supporting commercial organizations and complex client programs.
• Proven ability to align sales, client management, and operational delivery functions.
• Strong operational, financial, and process improvement capabilities.
• Ability to travel approximately 20%.
• Ability to work on-site in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

Preferred

• Experience within medical device testing, consulting, CRO, or laboratory services industries.
• Experience with CRM, LIMS, ERP, PSA, and business intelligence platforms.
• Experience leading project management, client services, sample management, or laboratory operations organizations.
• Experience managing strategic client accounts and leading enterprise-level client relationships.

Key Competencies

• Strategic Leadership
• Commercial Acumen
• Operational Excellence
• Client Relationship Management
• Program & Portfolio Management
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Change Leadership
• Process Improvement
• Team Development
• Data-Driven Decision Making
• Executive Communication
• Customer-Centric Mindset
• Organizational Scalability & Continuous Improvement

What we offer:

• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

gFiber is seeking a seasoned, strategic, growth-minded and pragmatic leader to join the Customer Engagement leadership team as the Director of Brand & Marketing Strategy. This role operates at the nexus of brand, product, growth marketing, and corporate communications, and is accountable for driving accelerated customer and market growth through excellence in brand strategy,  go to market planning and execution, and communications. While leading the Brand organization, the successful candidate will go well beyond the creative elements of our brand and must be digitally-astute, acquisition-focused, entrepreneurial and operationally minded. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, this position is highly visible and requires frequent, direct engagement with the Chief Executive Officer as well as the Chief Operating and Chief Product and Technology Officers on the company’s most critical strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate is results-oriented with an entrepreneurial ownership mindset, collaborative, analytical and creative. This executive will architect brand, growth and communications strategies and lead a multi-disciplinary team to operationalize brand initiatives across the entire organization.

In this role, you’ll:

Strategic Branding & Marketing Communications

Operational Excellence & Team Management

At a minimum, we would like you to have:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of progressive leadership experience in brand strategy, product marketing, growth marketing, communications or a related field for a consumer product, B2C technology or B2C telecommunications company.

• Demonstrated ability to drive consensus and execute complex programs in a highly ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

• Demonstrated experience operating at an executive level, with a track record of driving strategic outcomes through direct engagement with C-suite leadership.

It’s preferred that you have:

• MBA or a Master’s degree in a related field (e.g., Marketing, Strategy, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, General Management, Communications, Psychology, Analytics)

• Business line leader with proven track record of customer growth or P&L responsibility

• Demonstrated fluency in digital marketing

• Experience in both B2C and B2B environments

• Prefer candidate who lives in one of gFiber serviceable metro areas

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Asphalt Legends
jobs.description:
Job description

As Senior Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.
• Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.
• Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.
• Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.
• Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.

• Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).
• Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.
• Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.
• Excellent presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.
• Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

BONUS POINTS

• Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.
• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
• Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
• Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
• Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year
• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• Free language courses
• Birthday day off!
• 1 month of remote work
• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career-development opportunities.
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
The AI Engineering group within Intuitive Surgical has an immediate opening in Sunnyvale, CA for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with focus on Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Generative AI and Robotics, contributing to new technology development for next-generation robot-assisted surgery platforms. This role is an exciting opportunity to join a newly formed team and contribute to its growth and it will give you an opportunity to test your knowledge in a challenging problem-solving environment.

The successful candidate must excel in a high-energy, focused, small-team environment, be able to initiate and drive new research directions, and have a commitment to high research quality. A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required.

Primary Function of Position

• Lead the research, design, and implementation of AI algorithms for computer vision (image and video analysis), multimodal data, and action models
• Contribute to surgical AI and robotics pipelines; integrate, test, and evaluate accuracy bottlenecks of vision action (VA), and vision language action (VLA) models
• Lead development of effective techniques and infrastructure, from the initial idea to the running prototype and product.
• Contribute to research projects that develop a variety of algorithms and systems in computer vision, robotics, and multi-modal data fusion.
• Advance the state-of-the-art in the field, including generating patents and publications.
• Develop validation methods, datasets, pipelines, and evaluation metrics to show scalability to large clinical datasets.
• Participate in integration of new ML/CV algorithms into existing and future robotic platforms.
• Collaborate with users and clinical advisors to iterate prototype designs based on feedback and performance.
• Develop new technologies and digital products to improve surgeon and team performance on robotic surgery platforms.
• Support academic collaborations in related fields.

Required Education, Skills & Experience

• Master's degree with minimum of 6 years industry experience developing computer vision and machine learning applications; or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field and minimum of 3 years of experience
• Strong understanding and experience in building effective learning systems (data collection, training, evaluation, and making iterative improvements).
• Strong publication track record in conferences like CVPR, ICCV, MICCAI, etc.
• Strong hands-on experience with at least one of the mainstream deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
• Strong hands-on experience with Python (proficiency), C/C++ (proficiency), shell scripting
• Familiarity with control systems, robotics, kinematics, and dynamics.
• Strong engineering practices, debugging/profiling skills, familiarity with multi-threaded programming.
• Strong hands-on experience with GPU accelerated algorithms and implementations.
• Strong hands-on experience with state-of-the-art AI models, VFMs, or vision action models.
• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
• Interested in early phases of product exploration and iteration based on incomplete requirements.
• Solid understanding of computer vision, machine learning, generative models, and deep learning.
• Experience with visualization tools is a plus.
• Self-starter and able to work in a collaborative and results-oriented environment.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally (5-15%)
• Able to view live and recorded surgical procedures.

• Managed PTO for salaried/exempt employees (personal time off without accruals or caps); 22 PTO days starting out for hourly/non-exempt employees; 12 company-observed paid holidays; 4 early-close days

jobs.title: DevOps
jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

DevOps Engineers enable our engineering teams by delivering standardized CI/CD pipelines, secure coding frameworks and reference architectures that accelerate development while maintaining high reliability standards. The product is the paved road: the fastest way to ship should also be the safe way, and the development teams who use it are the customers.

The CI/CD platform is production. DevOps Engineers are on call for it, because a broken pipeline is an incident for every team behind it, and the paved road is judged by adoption and developer satisfaction as well as by DORA numbers.

You will own features end to end: the specification, the code, the tests and how it behaves in production. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you are the engineer who answers for whether what you shipped actually works.

The pull request is the visible part. The job is the machine behind it: turning a loosely worded need into something precise enough to build against, naming what can break before it does, proving the change is correct rather than asserting it, and staying with it once it is live.

How we work

• Business alignment and focus come first. Engineering here exists to move the business, not to be busy. You will know which few things matter most this month and why, say so when the work in front of you is not one of them, and land what you committed to on dates the business can plan around, at a quality that does not come back as an incident or a customer escalation.
• Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software is the output of this job, and everything below is in service of it.
• This job gets more hands-on every quarter, not less. The volume of code goes up while the time you spend typing it goes down, so the value moves to the two ends of it: what you specify, and what you verify. You will stay close to production, run the AI harness daily, read code you did not write, and keep your technical judgment current rather than remembered.
• Whoever ships it owns it, regardless of what wrote it. Most code is AI-generated now, so the judgment moved to either side of it: specifying exactly what to build, and verifying that what came back is correct, secure and operable. An agent wrote it is not a defense. Your name is on the merge.
• You do not need to own the roadmap to know why the work matters. You will not be the Product counterpart at this level and you are not expected to be. You are expected to understand what the customer gets and what the business gains from the thing you are building, and to ask before you build the wrong thing correctly. The engineers who move fastest here are the ones who ask that question early rather than at the review.
• You go on call for what you build, and you take your turn on the rotation. Engineering declares risk and timelines in writing for the business to accept, and that includes yours: when a date is at risk you say so early, with evidence, rather than quietly.

Responsibilities

• Own an enablement domain others come to for answers — the CI/CD platform, secure coding and supply-chain controls, or reference architectures and service templates. This is the rung where you specialize: the domain is yours, and development teams escalate to you inside it.
• Build the AI verification layer for your domain. Review agents in the pull-request path, AI-assisted test generation, gates tuned for AI-generated code, and provenance that records what an agent wrote. Show measurable gains in lead time, change failure rate or escaped defects — not adoption alone.
• Make the paved road agent-ready. Golden-path templates and repos that ship with the context files, skills and MCP connections agents need, and CI that runs agents safely: scoped credentials, sandboxing, defenses against prompt injection.
• Enforce quality on everything you own, including what AI wrote. Pipelines are versioned, tested and observable, and your gates fail the build rather than warn.
• Remove recurring toil for development teams, with the AI contribution measured rather than assumed.
• Be the escalation point for your domain. Mentor engineers on and off your team, run enablement sessions that teach development teams to work specification-first with agents, and hold Tech Lead for an enablement initiative when one needs it.
• Go on call for the CI/CD platform. A broken pipeline is an incident for every team behind it; incidents written up with actions closed on dates, toil removed rather than absorbed.
• Write the specification before the code, and verify with evidence on the pull request — the failure cases exercised, not only the happy path.
• Clear what you need from another team yourself. Find the dependency early, agree it directly with the engineer who owns it, and land it ahead of your work rather than escalating once it is late.

Requirements

• 5+ years in software engineering, with real ownership of developer-facing tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or platform/enablement work after it shipped.
• Hands-on technical fluency in: containerization, deploy automation, PHP, Perl, and GitHub Automation.
• Depth in at least one enablement domain — the CI/CD platform, secure coding and supply-chain controls, or reference architectures and service templates — and the ability to read your way into a part of the pipeline you have never touched. You can read a diff in a language you do not use daily and say what is wrong with it.
• Hands-on AI-assisted engineering, in your daily work rather than a trial. You can specify precisely, review generated pipeline and IaC code critically, and tell us where it fails and what you always check before it merges.
• Tests and evidence as a habit rather than a mandate. You write them as you go, you gate on changed code, and you have caught your own mistakes with them.
• You have operated what you built. A production on-call rotation for a platform or pipeline, an incident you owned, and a write-up that changed something afterwards.
• Clear written communication in a remote, distributed team. Decisions and trade-offs recorded in writing, with colleagues across several time zones.
• Managed hosting, cloud or another high-availability service business is a bonus.

We offer

• Visa support and relocation assistance.
• Daily lunches in the office.
• Work in a team of professionals at an international level.
• Comfortable working conditions.
• Opportunity to practice and improve your English.
• Competitive salary and all necessary equipment.
• Medical insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Grafana Ops - IRM | US - EST | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full time remote role for candidates in the US (EST), UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The Opportunity:

The Grafana IRM squad operates a business critical set of services that help Grafana and multiple organizations across the globe respond to incidents. Our mission is “We make it easy to detect, respond, and learn from incidents with minimal toil”. We have three functional squads within our team, frontend, backend and mobile, but our work is usually spread across the three functions.

Our domain is quite large and it is constantly evolving. Our key values are unified experience, automation and integration and Observability Native. We are customer focused and aim to provide an excellent customer experience for efficient usage with a high degree of automation and integration to multiple 3rd party systems that our users can leverage. When we say Observability Native is in our core, we really mean it, we want to highlight the integration of IRM with observability, which enables teams to gain actionable insights and resolve incidents more efficiently. The value is faster and more informed decision making.

Grafana IRM is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

What you’ll be doing:

• Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives.

• Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.

• Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers.

• Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope.

• Design, build, operate, and maintain Grafana’s mobile Application, owning the reliability, performance, and availability.

• Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the application you’re running.

• Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team.

• Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What are we looking for in you?

• You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action.

• You are customer focused.

• We build everything with our users in mind.

• You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.

• Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively.

• Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must.

What makes you a great fit:

• Experience with at least one native mobile platform (Android or iOS).

• Strong experience building production Flutter apps, including state management, navigation, asynchronous programming, and architecting maintainable codebases.

• Experience taking mobile features from idea to release in a self-driven way, from clarifying requirements and exploring solutions to building, testing, CI/CD workflows, and shipping updates to the App Store and Google Play

• Comfort integrating mobile apps with backend APIs and cloud services

• Write clean, maintainable, and performant code that is easy for other engineers to understand and extend.

Bonus points for:

• Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects).

• Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn.

• Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code.

• Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source projects

Compensation & rewards:
In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $174,986 - $209,983 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

• You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced settings, embracing change and ambiguity with ease.

How you will create impact (key responsibilities):

Ensure project owners have clarity on responsibilities and deadlines and proactively surface risks or blockers that could impact execution.

The Scalable ML team builds the data generation, orchestration, and distributed training infrastructure that lets our ML developers work efficiently with large volumes of data, and it sits at the intersection of several infrastructure teams: ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and High Performance Computing.

In this role, you will manage the Scalable ML team while also setting the technical strategy for how our data and training infrastructure interoperates with those adjacent platform teams. This is a job for someone who can both run a high-performing engineering team and act as the technical bridge across organizations that do not report to them.

• Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, driving high technical standards and continuous skill development for scalable machine learning infrastructure.

• Define and own the multi-quarter technical strategy for data generation, orchestration, and distributed training, including where that strategy depends on or shapes the roadmaps of other teams.

• Represent Scalable ML team in org-level planning and architecture decisions, resolving cross-team tradeoffs on shared infrastructure such as GPU scheduling and quota, job orchestration, storage, and compute cost.

• Drive the implementation of advanced MLOps practices, including model artifact management, experiment tracking, and automated model deployment and testing strategies, at a standard that other teams adopt.

• Build and maintain durable technical partnerships with peer managers and architects on ML Platform, Jobs Platform, Cloud Platform, and HPC teams to design and review shared-infrastructure changes jointly.

• Hold the team and its systems to a high reliability bar, including how incidents that cross team boundaries get root-caused, fixed, and prevented.

What you'll need to succeed:

• A Bachelor's and 10 years experience or Master's Degree and 8 years experience in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years in a Staff/Principal engineering or senior technical leadership role.

• A track record of setting technical strategy and direction across multiple teams or organizations, not just within a single team.

• Extensive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure for machine learning, including direct experience with the kind of cross-team dependencies that come from shared compute (GPU scheduling/quota, job orchestration, multi-tenant clusters).

• Proven expertise in developing and optimizing machine learning data pipelines, including data generation, management, and distributed training.

• Strong proficiency in Python for developing high-performance, production-quality software.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and align peer teams and leaders without direct authority over them.

• Track record of successfully delivering complex, multi-org software initiatives from conception to production, emphasizing scalability, reliability, and organizational alignment.

Nice to have (optional):

• Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field.

• Hands-on experience with distributed machine learning frameworks and tools such as Ray, PyTorch, Dagster, LakeFS, or PyArrow.

• Experience with multi-sensor data fusion and processing techniques relevant to autonomous driving applications.

• Familiarity with safety-critical software development principles in automotive or robotics domains.

• Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, computer vision use cases, and the challenges of L2/L3 autonomy.

jobs.title: Head of US Government Affairs
jobs.description:
Head of US Government Affairs



Chainalysis is seeking an exceptional government affairs expert to define and activate our North America public policy strategy. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you will drive Chainalysis’ strategy across Congress, the Executive Branch, U.S. regulators, and key policy stakeholders while helping shape the future of digital finance. A successful candidate will be able to leverage substantive policy expertise to influence policy outcomes, advise senior executives, and serve as a trusted external voice for the company. You will be a senior member of a team that operates at a global scale, and Chainalysis’ leader driving how we can help US government agencies advance their missions. 



In this role, you'll:

Own North America Policy Execution & Advocacy Strategy

 - Lead the company’s engagement with Congress, the Executive Branch, U.S. regulators, and other influential policy stakeholders

 - Build trusted relationships with policymakers and key staff while advancing thoughtful, business-oriented policy solutions

 - Develop company positions on legislative, regulatory, appropriations, and public policy issues at the intersection of financial services, emerging technologies, and national security

 - Anticipate policy developments and translate complex legislative and regulatory activity into actionable business strategy and executive recommendations

 - Represent Chainalysis in meetings with policymakers and key staff, industry coalitions, regulatory consultations, conferences, and public speaking engagements

 - Prepare executive leadership for meetings with senior government officials through strategic briefing materials and policy recommendations

Serve as a Critical Partner to the Business

 - Partner closely with Product, Legal, Communications, Go to Market, and regional policy colleagues worldwide to ensure North America policy strategy is integrated within the business

 - Contribute to the development of the company’s broader global public policy strategy by bringing critical North American insights into international policy discussions

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on U.S. political, legislative, and regulatory developments

 - Work in concert with Chainalysis and Chainalysis Government Solutions (CGS) leadership and account teams to identify engagement opportunities and facilitate strategic policy efforts

 - Work with Communications to develop and publish thought leadership content, blogs, or op-eds to enhance Chainalysis's visibility in policy debates

 - Proactively strategize and identify opportunities for Chainalysis executives to engage with the North American policy and stakeholder environment

Manage External Partnerships & Coalitions

 - Manage U.S. lobbyists, trade associations, and third-party coalitions, guiding messaging and strategy at the working level

 - Attend industry events and represent the company in policy discussions, ensuring a proactive and consistent presence within the industry and with regulators

 - Build and maintain a robust network of policy stakeholders that amplifies Chainalysis's voice in key debates

 - Participate in meetings with customers to provide policy insights and serve as a thought leader in conversations

 - Prepare internal and external enablement materials and communications



We're looking for candidates who have:

 - 10+ years of experience in U.S. government policy programs in fast-paced environments, with demonstrated success winning on legislative and regulatory outcomes

 - Substantive experience in emerging technology, financial services, or national security policy; while prior experience in digital assets is helpful, we place higher value on leaders with intellectual curiosity and substantive ability who can quickly develop expertise in new technologies

 - A command of how Congress and the Executive Branch work, and how to strategically engage with them to advance Chainalysis business priorities

 - A track record of driving successful policy initiatives to achieve enterprise-wide results; as opposed to solely monitoring, this person will have actively shaped relevant policy

 - Demonstrated experience working with collaboratively with multiple types of cross functional teams throughout an organization to drive a goal forward

 - Experience creating executable plans with measurable outcomes from broad strategic objectives

 - A strategic thinking orientation with sound political instincts, not solely a subject matter expert

 - Experience managing and working with lobbyists, trade associations, and coalition strategies

 - An understanding of and interest in digital assets

 - Excellent judgment and the ability to balance operating autonomously with leadership guidance inside of a fast-moving, high-stakes environment

 - Exceptional communication, writing, and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory and business concepts to a range of audiences

Technologies we use:

 - Google Workspace

 - Chainalysis data and tools

This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Storage) - remote in the US
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Design and build the software that provisions, integrates, and operates high-performance storage for GPU-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will develop the control-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale-out storage systems to Kubernetes-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

About the Role

We are looking for a software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. The right candidate has built production software against real storage systems (whether enterprise NAS, scale-out, or object), understands what makes storage fast and reliable at scale, and prefers declarative automation over manual operations. You should be self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, and effective communicating technical decisions across teams.

Responsibilities

1. Storage Software & Integration

• Design and build control-plane services, drivers (e.g., CSI), and tooling that provision, configure, and operate storage for Kubernetes-based AI/compute workloads.
• Integrate high-performance storage platforms — Dell PowerScale, VAST, and comparable systems — into automated, declarative provisioning workflows.
• Build data-path, telemetry, and observability tooling to diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues.

2. Software & Automation

• Write production-quality software — primarily in Go — with strong testing, code review, and operational rigor.
• Deliver infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps-driven pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux) for storage configuration and lifecycle.
• Support bare-metal and hybrid provisioning where storage intersects host and cluster bring-up.

3. Platform & Hybrid Delivery

• Deliver storage integration for k0s-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies.
• Architect storage software for fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of software development, including production systems, with Go as a primary language.
• 5+ years building or integrating storage systems (distributed, scale-out, NAS, or object) at scale.
• Hands-on experience with high-performance storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale, VAST, or comparable technologies.
• Solid understanding of storage fundamentals: file/block/object models, throughput and latency behavior, caching, consistency, and failure modes.
• Experience with Kubernetes storage (CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes) and infrastructure-as-code.
• Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

• Proficiency in Python and/or Rust in addition to Go.
• Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, k0s, MKE) and Cluster API.
• Experience developing storage for GPU/AI workloads (high-throughput data pipelines, GPUDirect Storage).
• Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
• Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
• Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with the Kroger Family of Companies (i.e. H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status)

The Salesforce Reporting & Analytics Specialist is a member of Sales Operations responsible for developing, maintaining, and governing Salesforce reports, dashboards, and commercial analytics solutions. This role helps leaders and business teams turn Salesforce data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights that support pipeline management, forecasting, revenue visibility, opportunity tracking, quote performance, and executive decision-making.

The specialist will partner across Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, and other commercial teams to understand reporting needs, translate business questions into scalable analytics solutions, and ensure that Salesforce reporting reflects established business processes and definitions. The role will also strengthen reporting governance, reduce manual data requests, promote self-service analytics, and establish the data foundation needed for future automation, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Reporting and Dashboard Development

• Design, build, validate, and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards that support commercial, operational, forecasting, and executive reporting needs.

• Develop reporting solutions that provide visibility into pipeline, revenue, opportunity progression, quote performance, forecast performance, and other business-critical metrics.

• Establish scalable reporting structures that meet both immediate business requirements and longer-term analytical needs.

• Optimize dashboards and reporting processes to improve usability, performance, consistency, and stakeholder adoption.

• Build solutions that reduce manual reporting activity and expand access to self-service insights.

Forecasting and Pipeline Analytics

• Develop and maintain reporting that supports Salesforce-native forecasting processes, categories, methodologies, and review cadences.

• Provide clear visibility into pipeline health, opportunity progression, forecast changes, and performance trends.

• Support forecast accuracy by identifying reporting gaps, investigating variances, and validating the underlying Salesforce data.

• Partner with Sales Operations and business leaders to improve forecast transparency, accountability, and confidence.

• Support reporting structures used by sellers, commercial leaders, Finance, and executive stakeholders.

Data Quality, Reconciliation, and Reporting Integrity

• Monitor Salesforce reporting data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.

• Perform field-level, record-level, financial, and reporting reconciliation when discrepancies are identified.

• Investigate reporting defects, dashboard inconsistencies, duplicate data, integration-related issues, and forecast gaps.

• Partner with business and technical teams to identify root causes and coordinate remediation.

• Help ensure consistent definitions and calculations across Salesforce reports, dashboards, Finance reporting, and executive metrics.

• Establish controls and monitoring practices that increase stakeholder trust in Salesforce as the system of record.

Reporting Governance and Intake Management

• Establish and maintain reporting standards, definitions, documentation, and best practices.

• Manage or support a structured intake process for new reports, dashboards, analytics enhancements, and data-related requests.

• Evaluate requests based on business impact, urgency, scalability, and alignment with Salesforce reporting strategy.

• Reduce redundant reports and encourage the use of standardized, governed analytics assets.

• Maintain an operational backlog of reporting gaps, data-quality issues, forecasting improvements, and workflow simplification opportunities.

• Provide data-informed recommendations to Salesforce governance and prioritization discussions.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

• Consult with Sales Leadership, Account Teams, Finance, Sales Operations, Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to understand reporting and analytics requirements.

• Translate business questions and operational needs into clear reporting requirements and scalable Salesforce solutions.

• Serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that reporting accurately reflects commercial processes.

• Communicate findings, reporting risks, data limitations, and recommended actions in clear business language.

• Support cross-functional validation and prioritization of reporting enhancements and platform improvements.

Salesforce Adoption and Enablement

• Develop reports and dashboards that help users understand, monitor, and manage their business within Salesforce.

• Support user adoption by making information accessible, understandable, and actionable.

• Create documentation, reporting guidance, FAQs, and self-service resources.

• Contribute to Salesforce Office Hours, training sessions, knowledge resources, and other enablement activities as needed.

• Identify recurring user questions, reporting pain points, and adoption blockers, then recommend improvements.

• Promote consistent reporting and data-management practices across commercial teams.

Automation, Advanced Analytics, and AI Readiness

• Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, dashboard processes, reconciliations, and manual data requests.

• Support the development of scalable reporting architecture for advanced analytics and emerging AI use cases.

• Improve the structure, consistency, and governance of Salesforce data used by analytical and automated solutions.

• Partner with technical teams to assess the reporting and data implications of platform changes, integrations, and new capabilities.

• Help position Sales Operations for continued growth in self-service analytics, automation, and data-informed decision-making.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

The following qualifications are recommended based on the stated responsibilities of the role:

• Five+ years’ experience developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, or analytical solutions in Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into reporting requirements and actionable insights.

• Five+ years’ experience working with pipeline, forecasting, revenue, opportunity, quote, or commercial-performance data.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies and validate data.

• Understanding of data-quality, reporting-governance, and metric-definition practices.

• Ability to communicate technical or analytical findings to nontechnical business stakeholders.

• Five+ years’ experience partnering across business and technical teams.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple reporting requests and priorities.

• Commitment to accurate, consistent, and well-documented analytical work.

Preferred Qualifications

These are recommended qualifications that support the future-state scope described in the attachment:

• Five+ years’ experience with Salesforce report and dashboard architecture.

• Five+ years’ experience with CRM analytics, business intelligence, data visualization, or commercial analytics.

• Three+ years’ experience with PowerBI architecture

• Understanding of sales forecasting, pipeline management, revenue reporting, or sales operations.

• Five+ years’ experience automating reports, dashboards, reconciliations, or recurring analytical processes.

• Familiarity with data flows between Salesforce and downstream reporting platforms.

• Experience supporting user acceptance testing, reporting validation, system implementation, or platform stabilization.

• Familiarity with advanced analytics, AI readiness, or governed data foundations.

• Five+ years’ experience creating reporting documentation, standards, or self-service training materials.

Core Competencies

• Analytical problem-solving: Investigates complex reporting and data issues and converts findings into practical solutions.

• Business acumen: Understands how Salesforce data supports pipeline, forecasting, revenue, quoting, and commercial decisions.
