jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY AND PROJECT

Marfields Group is developing St. Regis Residences Limassol, a luxury branded development in Cyprus valued at around €400 million. The project covers two buildings with approximately 250 residences and premium offices, and is at its earliest stage, before excavation.

Design was previously outsourced to consultancies. Because St. Regis buyers require extensive customisation of their apartments (finishes, FF&E, layouts), Marfields Group is now building an in-house design team to manage these changes from the ground up.


THE ROLE

The Head of Design builds and leads the in-house design team and owns the design of St. Regis Residences Limassol, including buyer customisations.

 - Reports to: Dario Berego, Chief Design Officer (CDO)

 - Leads: a team of around 5, including the Architect and Interior Designer

 - Location: on-site in Limassol, Cyprus


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Set up and lead the in-house design team: structure, workflows, standards and tools.

 - Lead architectural and interior design for the project, in line with St. Regis brand standards.

 - Manage the buyer customisation process (finishes, FF&E, layout changes) from request to handover.

 - Coordinate external consultants, engineers and suppliers.

 - Work closely with the construction team to ensure design is buildable, on time and on budget.

 - Present design concepts and options to senior management and, where needed, to buyers.


REQUIREMENTS

Essential

 - 10+ years in architecture or interior design, including at least 3 years leading a design team.

 - Experience on luxury residential or branded residences projects.

 - Developer-side (client-side) experience managing design from concept through construction.

 - Strong technical delivery: coordination of drawings, specifications and consultants.

 - Fluent English.

Desirable

 - Russian language (many buyers are Russian-speaking).

 - Experience with hospitality-branded developments (St. Regis, Mandarin Oriental, Four Seasons or similar).

 - Experience managing buyer customisations or FF&E packages.

 - Degree in architecture or interior design.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Contract: permanent Cyprus employment contract with social insurance and access to the National Health System (GeSY).
   Tax: eligible employees on salaries above €55,000 may benefit from Cyprus's 50% income tax exemption.

 - Relocation: flight tickets, help finding accommodation plus the first month's accommodation, and work visa sponsorship for non-EU citizens.

 - Company car with fuel.

 - Working hours: flexible start between 8 and 9 AM, finish between 5 and 6 PM, one-hour break.


HIRING PROCESS

 1. Pre-screening interview with the recruitment partner.

 2. First interview with Demetra Loizidou and the CDO.

 3. Final interview with the Managing Director (Owner).

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Compute Solutions)
jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Compute Solutions builds and operates the VPS, Cloud Dedicated, storage, and bare metal products our customers run their cloud infrastructure on.

You will own infrastructure changes end to end: the specification, the automation and configuration, the validation, and how they behave in production.

The pull request is the visible part. The job is the machine behind it: turning a loosely worded need into something precise enough to build against, naming what can break before it does, proving the change is correct rather than asserting it, and staying with it once it is live.

How we work

• Business alignment and focus come first. Engineering here exists to move the business, not to be busy. You will know which few things matter most this month and why, say so when the work in front of you is not one of them, and land what you committed to on dates the business can plan around, at a quality that does not come back as an incident or a customer escalation. Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software is the output of this job, and everything below is in service of it.
• This job gets more hands-on every quarter, not less. The volume of code goes up while the time you spend typing it goes down, so the value moves to the two ends of it: what you specify, and what you verify. You will stay close to production, run the AI harness daily, read code you did not write, and keep your technical judgment current rather than remembered.
• Whoever ships it owns it, regardless of what wrote it. Most code is AI-generated now, so the judgment moved to either side of it: specifying exactly what to build, and verifying that what came back is correct, secure and operable. An agent wrote it is not a defense. Your name is on the merge.
• You do not need to own the roadmap to know why the work matters. You will not be the Product counterpart at this level and you are not expected to be. You are expected to understand what the customer gets and what the business gains from the thing you are building, and to ask before you build the wrong thing correctly. The engineers who move fastest here are the ones who ask that question early rather than at the review.
• You go on call for what you build, and you take your turn on the rotation. Engineering declares risk and timelines in writing for the business to accept, and that includes yours: when a date is at risk you say so early, with evidence, rather than quietly.

Responsibilities

• Own infrastructure features end to end within the Compute Solutions domain. Take work from specification through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support across VPS, Cloud Dedicated, storage, and bare metal services.
• Build and maintain cloud compute infrastructure. Work with Linux-based systems, virtualization platforms, configuration management, and supporting infrastructure to deliver reliable and scalable compute services.
• Manage and improve KVM-based virtualization environments. Support the configuration, performance, reliability, and lifecycle of virtualized compute infrastructure.
• Automate infrastructure configuration and operations. Use tools such as Ansible or Puppet to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and make infrastructure changes repeatable and auditable.
• Translate requirements into clear technical specifications. Identify dependencies, operational risks, and unknowns early, and resolve ambiguity before implementation begins.
• Verify changes before they reach production. Test infrastructure and software changes, exercise failure scenarios, and provide clear evidence that changes are safe and production-ready.
• Use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of your daily workflow. Apply agentic tooling to implementation, automation, and review while remaining accountable for the quality and operability of the final result.
• Review infrastructure and code changes from other engineers. Identify design, reliability, scalability, and operational risks early and provide clear, actionable feedback.
• Own the systems you run. Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, document root causes and follow-up actions, and continuously reduce operational toil.
• Work safely in existing and unfamiliar systems. Understand complex or legacy infrastructure, make incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites, and leave systems better documented and instrumented than you found them.
• Mentor other engineers. Share technical knowledge, explain design and operational decisions, and support less experienced engineers through implementation and review.
• Coordinate dependencies across teams. Identify cross-team requirements early and work directly with the relevant engineers to avoid delivery blockers.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience working with cloud computing infrastructure and production environments.
• 5+ years of experience with Linux server administration.
• 5+ years of experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
• 5+ years of experience with KVM administration and virtualization environments.
• Strong understanding of compute infrastructure, virtualization, networking, storage, and production operations.
• Experience building, operating, and supporting highly available production infrastructure.
• Experience automating infrastructure configuration and operational processes.
• Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
• Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multiple infrastructure layers.
• Ability to work effectively in unfamiliar or legacy environments and make safe, incremental improvements.
• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools as part of day-to-day technical work.
• Clear written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed team across multiple time zones.

Preferred

• Experience with VPS, dedicated cloud, bare metal, or hosting infrastructure.
• Experience with storage systems used in virtualized or cloud environments.
• Experience in managed hosting, cloud platforms, or another high-availability service environment.
• Experience with infrastructure automation at scale.
• Experience reviewing infrastructure changes and mentoring other engineers.

We offer

• Visa support and relocation assistance.
• Daily lunches in the office.
• Work in a team of professionals at an international level.
• Comfortable working conditions.
• Opportunity to practice and improve your English.
• Competitive salary and all necessary equipment.
• Medical insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Account Executive, MENA
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location

• Dubai, UAE

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Sr. Commercial Account Executive to join our team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).
As a Senior Commercial Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.
Regional Focus: Kuwait, Bahrain, Levant and Iraq

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level and minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Language Skills: Fluency in Arabic and English. French is a plus.

• 10+ years of advanced experience selling complex related technology solutions to the biggest enterprise companies across Emerging Markets (such as Upper Gulf, Levant, Iraq, North Africa), with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customers within the Commercial sectors.

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Senior Motion Graphics Designer
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

To capture the hearts and minds of millions of players across the world by creating unforgettable games powered by the best technology.

About Us:

PlayQ is a rapidly growing entertainment and technology company that recognizes quality is king as we deliver unforgettable mobile game experiences to a global audience. Our games engage millions of users daily, surprising them with creativity, beauty and fun!

Our portfolio includes hit titles like Treasure Party, which combines match-3 puzzle gameplay with a board game adventure for a vibrant treasure-hunting experience, and Sort Wizard, a fresh take on sorting puzzle mechanics that challenges and delights players. Both games are quickly building strong followings in their genres, offering fun, rewarding journeys for puzzle lovers and adventurers alike.

Our team is driven, playful and deeply committed to excellence and innovation. We work together to craft clever, visually stunning, and memorable experiences. PlayQ's environment values initiative, collaboration, and individual leadership to ensure that our mission is fulfilled.

Who You Are:

• Proactive Achiever You consistently take the initiative to drive business results, supported by sound reasoning and detailed execution plans.

• Growth Driver You champion company-wide success by relentlessly focusing on achieving results, understanding how your work impacts the entire organization, and pushing to make it 10% better every time. You continuously level yourself up and drive the business forward.

• Solution Seeker Fueled by curiosity, you explore various ways to solve a problem. Every hard problem is an opportunity in disguise.

• Team Builder You actively foster strong dynamics within and between teams, contributing to our collective success.

• Resilient Leader You consistently approach your work with resilience and a steadfast passion for achievement of our goals despite challenges or setbacks.

• Data-Driven Creator You leverage data to back intuition. Empirical creativity is your go-to. Imagination led, data validated.

Why you'll want to come to work:

Our Senior Motion Graphics Designer role offers the opportunity to directly shape PlayQ’s growth through high-quality, performance driven user acquisition creative.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on creating motion graphics, editorial content, gameplay driven ads, and high volume creative iterations for paid media campaigns. You will work closely with Marketing Art and User Acquisition to turn creative direction and performance learnings into engaging short form ads.

Your work will contribute directly to PlayQ’s growth by creating strong hooks, clear gameplay stories, and modular creative assets that can be tested, optimized, resized, and scaled efficiently across advertising platforms.

Your Responsibilities:

• Motion Design: Design and animate high-quality motion graphics for user acquisition, social, and digital marketing campaigns using typography, transitions, visual effects, gameplay assets, UI, and graphic design to create visually compelling advertising creatives.

• Video Production: Edit gameplay capture, promotional footage, AI-generated content, voiceover, music, and sound effects into engaging short-form video ads that effectively communicate gameplay, features, rewards, and player motivations.

• Creative Storytelling: Apply strong editorial principles including pacing, timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling to create compelling narratives, impactful opening hooks, and high-performing marketing creatives.

• Creative Development: Produce both net-new creative concepts and high-volume iterations of existing ads, developing structured variations that test hooks, messaging, gameplay moments, pacing, visual treatments, ensuring that all creative decisions improve campaign performance

• Performance Marketing: Create performance-driven video ads for major paid media platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, Moloco, and other digital advertising channels, leveraging user acquisition best practices and platform-specific requirements.

• Production Efficiency: Build organized, modular After Effects projects and reusable creative templates that enable rapid iteration, efficient production workflows, and consistent creative quality across campaigns.

• Creative Optimization: Adapt marketing assets into polished deliverables across multiple aspect ratios, formats, and advertising placements while maintaining visual consistency and production excellence.

• Project Organization: Maintain well-structured project files, naming conventions, source assets, and deliverables to support scalable creative production and effective cross-functional collaboration.

• AI-Enhanced Production: Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate ideation, content generation, editing, iteration, and creative adaptation while applying strong creative judgment to ensure quality, consistency, and brand alignment.

• Industry Research: Stay current on mobile advertising trends, emerging creative technologies, social media formats, competitor creatives, and evolving user acquisition best practices to continuously improve creative effectiveness.

• Collaboration: Partner closely with Creative Director, User Acquisition, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to align on campaign objectives, share creative insights, and deliver high-performing marketing assets.

What you’ll bring to the team:

• Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in motion graphics, video editing, digital advertising, or performance marketing creative, with experience producing user acquisition creatives for mobile games.

• Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in motion design, editorial storytelling, gameplay advertising, and short-form video production that showcases measurable creative quality and performance.

• Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects, strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, with the ability to execute polished motion graphics and video editing workflows.

• Creative Skills: Deep understanding of animation principles, typography, composition, visual hierarchy, compositing, pacing, rhythm, storytelling, music editing, sound design, and audio synchronization as applied to performance marketing.

• Production Ability: Proven ability to combine gameplay footage, UI elements, typography, visual effects, sound, and graphic design into engaging, performance-focused short-form advertising creatives.

• Optimization Mindset: Experience creating both original concepts and high-volume creative iterations, with a strong understanding of user acquisition testing methodologies, hook strategies, performance marketing workflows, and creative optimization.

• Technical Organization: Experience building organized, modular project files and reusable templates that support efficient production, rapid creative iteration, and scalable content development.

• Platform Knowledge: Familiarity with paid media platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, Moloco, and other digital advertising ecosystems, along with an understanding of performance metrics such as CTR, CPI, ROAS, conversion, retention, and hook performance.

• AI Proficiency: Experience integrating AI tools into modern creative production workflows, including platforms such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop AI, ChatGPT, Claude, and other emerging AI technologies to enhance ideation, editing, production, and creative adaptation while maintaining high creative standards.

• Collaboration: Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to independently own creative projects from concept through final delivery.

Bonus Points:

• Industry Experience: Experience creating user acquisition creative for match-3, puzzle, casual, or hybrid casual mobile games, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming audiences and advertising strategies.

• Additional Creative Expertise: Experience producing App Store screenshots, promotional graphics, App Store Optimization (ASO) assets, or other marketing collateral supporting mobile game launches and growth.

• Technical Skills: Familiarity with Unity or other gameplay capture tools, Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D software for asset preparation and compositing support, as well as motion graphics plugins such as Trapcode, Saber, Element 3D, or similar technologies.

• AI & Emerging Technology: Experience using generative AI platforms such as Runway, Midjourney, and other advanced creative tools to support content production and innovation.

• Performance Collaboration: Experience working directly with User Acquisition teams and applying campaign performance insights, creative testing results, and user behavior data to continuously improve future creative development.

Working at PlayQ:

• Remote Work Environment. Work remotely from anywhere in Latin America, with the flexibility to structure your day around your location while collaborating closely with our HQ and global teams.

• Meaningful ownership & impact. Take ownership of growth initiatives and directly influence the strategy, performance, and success of our games.

• AI-powered tools. Access to company-provided AI tools and paid subscriptions to support creative work, experimentation, and productivity.

• Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy balance while delivering against your goals.

• Career growth & visibility. Work closely with senior leadership and have the opportunity to grow your scope and influence as the business and products scale.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real.

What you will do

• Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
• Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
• Manage and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure governance, including security baselines, cost management, and compliance controls.
• Build demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry to support business development and potential client work.
• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
• Advise clients on cloud migration strategy, landing zone design, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
• Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.
• Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
• Depending on seniority, mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal capability building within the Azure and AI practice.

What you bring

• Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language.
• Willing and able to travel for client work (mostly within the Benelux).
• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a production environment.
• Strong knowledge of Azure core services: compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID/Azure AD.
• Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or similar.
• Interest in or experience with Azure AI Foundry or building AI demos/proofs of concept is a strong plus.

• Competitive salary package, including annual salary increase, bonuses, and NS Business Card.

• Flexible working arrangements (office, home, client sites) and international project exposure.
• Collaborative global environment fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - Delta One
jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Senior Quantitative Researcher – Delta One

DRW is seeking a Senior Quantitative Researcher (Delta One) to join the FICC options trading business. This individual will serve as an embedded quantitative research lead within an established discretionary and systematic options platform, with a mandate to research, develop, and validate futures-driven systematic strategies that complement and enhance the broader FICC options franchise.

This role focuses on delta-one strategy research, quantitative signal generation, systematic futures execution research, and portfolio hedging across global futures markets. The individual will partner closely with options traders and developers to translate research into production strategies and integrate futures-based signals, directional overlays, and risk-efficient hedging frameworks into the broader derivatives platform.

This position is suited for someone with deep quantitative expertise, a demonstrated record of research contributing to trading performance, and experience developing scalable systematic models within derivatives markets.

Key Responsibilities

• Research, develop, and validate systematic delta-one futures strategies across global markets, including rates, FX, commodities, and equities.

• Build and refine quantitative signal generation frameworks to support both standalone futures strategies and options portfolios.

• Develop and evaluate futures-based hedging methodologies to improve portfolio risk management across the FICC options business.

• Research directional options overlays grounded in quantitative futures signals, partnering with traders on implementation and evaluation.

• Model and analyze strategy and portfolio risks, including exposure, volatility, liquidity, and cross-asset correlations.

• Partner closely with traders, developers, and trading infrastructure teams to productionize research, establish model monitoring, and improve execution.

• Conduct rigorous research, backtesting, out-of-sample validation, and performance attribution, incorporating realistic transaction costs and execution constraints.

• Analyze live strategy performance to identify model weaknesses, changing market conditions, and opportunities for improvement.

• Continuously refine models to improve signal quality, robustness, scalability, and capital efficiency.

• Develop quantitative frameworks to inform portfolio construction, capital allocation, and risk budgeting within the FICC platform.

Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in quantitative research supporting systematic trading, preferably in futures and listed derivatives.

• Proven track record of developing quantitative signals or models that have been deployed in production and contributed to trading performance.

• Strong understanding of derivatives pricing, volatility dynamics, and risk modeling.

• Deep experience in signal research, statistical modeling, and alpha generation.

• Expertise in research design, backtesting, and model validation, including addressing overfitting, data leakage, and implementation costs.

• Fluency in Python and experience working with large-scale financial datasets.

• Strong knowledge of market microstructure and execution modeling.

• Ability to independently lead research projects while collaborating effectively with traders and developers.

Preferred Background

• Experience researching strategies across global futures markets, including equities, rates, commodities, and FX.

• Experience integrating options strategies within systematic futures frameworks.

• Familiarity with portfolio construction, capital allocation, and risk budgeting models.

• Experience working within or alongside an options trading desk.

• Experience supporting the full research lifecycle, from hypothesis development and empirical testing through production implementation and ongoing evaluation.

• Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.title: Sales Development Manager
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2.5 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to run the team that calls provider offices on behalf of the pharmacies we work with.

When a pharmacy sends us a prescription that needs a prior authorization, we usually need something from the prescriber's office first, most often the clinical notes. Many of those offices have never heard of us. Our calling team reaches them by phone, gets the request to the person who handles prior authorizations, and returns their callbacks. Whether that call happens quickly and gets a response often decides whether a patient starts their medication this week or next.

You'll run that team, reporting to our Head of Provider Growth (to our CEO until that role is filled). It's small today, and it works in a calling tool our engineers built and keep improving. You'll own how much calling capacity we have, how fast calls and callbacks happen, and how many offices respond.

Three things define success in this role:

 1. You own speed and capacity. Calling tasks get worked while they still matter, and callbacks are returned the same day. You know how many calls the team can make, how many we need, and when to hire.

 2. You own the response rate on calls. You know how often we reach someone, how often they respond, and why calls fail (wrong number, voicemail, wrong desk). You change scripts, timing, and process to move those numbers.

 3. You make the tooling better. You work in the calling tool every day and turn what you see into specific, prioritized asks for our engineers.

You don't need a healthcare background, but you do need to pick up a complex domain quickly. Startup experience is a strong plus.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Run the team

 - Hire, train, coach, and schedule callers. Set the daily cadence, listen to calls, and give feedback.

 - Make calls yourself, especially early on.

 - Decide when to add headcount or bring in outside help, with the numbers to back it.

Run the numbers

 - Own the calling metrics: capacity against demand, time from task to first call, callback response time, reach rate, and response rate.

 - Report them weekly and explain what moved.

Improve how we call

 - Own call scripts and talking points for different kinds of offices, and test changes.

 - Work with our growth marketing lead, who owns fax, email, and messaging, so phone and digital touches work together on the same offices.

 - Work with engineering on the calling tool: what slows callers down, what data is missing, and what to fix first.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING ON DAY 1

 - You've managed an outbound calling team. SDR, inside sales, patient access, or similar, with phone as a main channel. You've hired and coached callers.

 - You run a team on numbers. Activity, speed to lead, connect rate, conversion. You can walk us through a metric you moved and how.

 - You're good on the phone. You can get past a front desk politely and get a busy office to act.

 - You build process. You've fixed a queue, written a playbook, or set up a workflow in a CRM or dialer, and given useful feedback to whoever built the tool.

 - Quantitative fluency. You can break a funnel into its steps and tell which one is broken.

 - Fast and self-directed. You take direction well, then run with it.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO LEARN QUICKLY

 - Our domain: prior authorization and medication access, and what a provider office needs from us to complete a request.

 - How a provider office works: who answers the phone, who handles prior authorizations, and who to ask for.

 - The rules: what HIPAA allows on a call, and with whom.




BONUS POINTS

 - Phone outreach in healthcare: specialty pharmacy, hub services, revenue cycle, or a medical office.

 - Early hire at a high-growth or early-stage startup.

 - Experience with AI voice agents or modern dialer tooling.




THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You want to manage managers or a large org right away. This is a small team you'll build.

 - You'd rather not make calls yourself. You will, especially early.

 - You need polished process and tools on day one. Building them is part of the job.

 - You want to own digital channels. Fax, email, and messaging belong to our growth marketing lead. You'll share the same funnel.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.

 - Modern calling and AI tooling, built in-house and improving every week.

 - Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients, with room to grow as the team scales.

jobs.title: Laborant Fysisch (dagdienst)
jobs.description:
Als Laborant Fysisch werk je binnen het Fysisch Laboratorium van Eurofins Analytico. Hier zorg jij ervoor dat milieumonsters op de juiste manier worden voorbereid voor verdere analyses. Je werkt met verschillende technieken en apparatuur en leert elke dag meer over laboratoriumwerk in de praktijk. Je komt terecht in een enthousiast team van collega's die je goed begeleiden en helpen om het vak te leren. Het werk is afwisselend en praktisch: je bent veel bezig met monsters, apparatuur en verschillende testmethodes. Nauwkeurig werken is hierbij belangrijk, want jouw werk vormt de basis voor betrouwbare analyseresultaten.

Wat ga je doen?

• Monsters voorbewerken door middel van ontsluiten, spoelen en zeven
• Uitvoeren van lutumbepalingen (klei- en deeltjesfracties)
• Uitvoeren van organische-stofbepalingen
• Bepalen van korrelgrootteverdelingen met behulp van zeef- of lasertechnieken
• Uitvoeren van verschillende fysische laboratoriumtesten
• Werken met moderne laboratoriumapparatuur en materialen
• Signaleren van bijzonderheden en afwijkingen tijdens je werkzaamheden
• Zorgdragen voor een veilige en nette werkomgeving
• Samenwerken met collega's om alle monsters op tijd te verwerken

• Je hebt een laboratoriumopleiding afgerond op MBO niveau 2, 3 of 4
• Je werkt graag nauwkeurig en vindt het leuk om praktisch bezig te zijn
• Je bent leergierig en staat open om nieuwe technieken te leren
• Je bent een aanpakker en vindt het niet erg om repeterende werkzaamheden uit te voeren
• Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken
• Je bent kwaliteitsbewust en verantwoordelijk
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal

Werken bij Eurofins Analytico betekent werken in een professioneel, dynamisch en snelgroeiend laboratorium met enthousiaste collega's. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en ervaring op te doen binnen een toonaangevende organisatie.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

• Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
• Een marktconform salaris;
• 8% vakantietoeslag;
• 25 vakantiedagen;
• Een kwartaalbonus bij het behalen van de bedrijfsdoelstellingen;
• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met een eigen bijdrage van slechts 3%;
• Een extra verlofdag op de dag na je verjaardag (uitslaapdag);
• Reiskostenvergoeding;
• Toegang tot meer dan 100 online trainingen via GoodHabitz;
• Een prettige en collegiale werksfeer.

Deze functie wordt uitgevoerd in dagdienst, waardoor je profiteert van vaste werktijden en een goede werk-privébalans.

Over Eurofins

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal life sciences bedrijf dat klanten ondersteunt met laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu voeren in Nederland een breed pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses uit.

Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder andere overheden, waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, milieuadviesbureaus en bedrijven. Binnen Eurofins Milieu werken circa 700 collega's aan het traject van monstername tot digitale rapportage van analyseresultaten. Een groot deel van de analyses wordt uitgevoerd in onze laboratoria in Amsterdam en Amersfoort

¿Te interesa?

Debido al alto volumen de solicitudes que recibimos para nuestras ofertas, lleva un tiempo poder revisarlas todas. Si no recibes noticias dentro de las dos-tres semanas posteriores a tu solicitud, por favor considera que en esta ocasión hemos decidido avanzar con otras candidaturas. Las personas que cumplan con los criterios serán contactadas por el equipo de Talent. ¡Gracias por tu interés y tiempo!

jobs.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
McAdams is a full-service land planning, landscape architecture, civil engineering, transportation, and geomatics firm located in North Carolina, South Carolina, Texas, and Florida. We seek to partner with our clients to create meaningful experiences through inspired design. Our employees are what make McAdams different. We bring experiences to the forefront of everything we do, and to do that takes special people.

Position Overview

The Director of Talent Acquisition is responsible for leading McAdams' talent acquisition strategy and recruitment function, ensuring the organization attracts, engages, and hires the talent needed to achieve its strategic growth objectives. This leadership role oversees the talent acquisition team and partners closely with business leaders, human resources, and corporate services teams to develop innovative and effective recruiting strategies.

The Director of Talent Acquisition serves as a trusted advisor to hiring leaders, providing guidance on talent market conditions, recruiting trends, and hiring best practices. This role is responsible for strengthening McAdams' brand, enhancing candidate experience, developing talent pipelines, and driving continuous improvement across all talent acquisition programs and processes.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Strategy

• Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies that support McAdams' business objectives and long-term growth plans.

• Partner with business leaders and human resources to anticipate hiring needs and align recruiting efforts with organizational priorities.

• Identify recruitment challenges and opportunities and implement innovative solutions to attract top talent.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to leaders on talent market trends, recruiting strategies, and competitive hiring practices.

• Develop proactive talent pipeline strategies for critical and hard-to-fill positions across the organization.

Talent Acquisition Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Talent Acquisition team committed to delivering exceptional recruiting outcomes.

• Establish team goals, performance expectations, and service standards that align with organizational objectives.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

• Provide guidance and professional development opportunities that strengthen recruiter capability and effectiveness.

• Evaluate team performance and implement strategies to improve productivity, quality, and consistency.

Partnerships + Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with business leaders, hiring managers, and Human Resources team members to understand talent needs and recruiting priorities.

• Consult with leaders on hiring strategies, interview processes, candidate evaluation, and talent acquisition best practices.

• Support annual staffing discussions by providing recruiting insights, labor market intelligence, and talent availability data.

• Influence hiring decisions through data-driven recommendations and market expertise.

Employer Brand + Talent Attraction

• Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen McAdams' employer brand and position the organization as an employer of choice.

• Develop and implement recruitment marketing strategies that increase awareness of career opportunities and company culture.

• Promote McAdams through professional associations, industry events, social media, and other talent attraction channels.

• Ensure the employee value proposition is effectively communicated throughout the candidate journey.

Strategic + Key Hire Recruiting

• Provide leadership and support for strategic, key hire initiatives.

• Develop recruitment approaches tailored to highly specialized, leadership, and difficult-to-fill positions.

• Build and maintain relationships with passive candidates and industry professionals to strengthen talent pipelines.

• Manage relationships with external search firms and recruiting partners as needed.

Operations + process Improvement

• Oversee talent acquisition processes, systems, and programs to ensure efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

• Establish and monitor key talent acquisition metrics, including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, candidate experience, and offer acceptance rates.

• Optimize applicant tracking system (ATS), reporting tools, and recruiting technologies to improve team effectiveness and candidate experience.

• Evaluate and implement process improvements that reduce hiring cycle times and improve recruiting outcomes.

• Ensure compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements and all applicable employment laws and regulations.

• Prepare and present talent acquisition performance updates, insights, and recommendations to organizational leadership.

• Leverage data to improve recruiting effectiveness and support business objectives.

• Develop and implement best practices that enhance the overall candidate experience.

Skills + Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or related field, or equivalent combination of education/training and experience

• 10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, including experience leading recruiting teams and talent acquisition programs

• Proven success in developing and executing recruitment strategies within a growing, multi-office organization

• Strong business partnership, consulting, and influencing skills

• Experience managing recruiting technology, applicant tracking systems, and talent acquisition analytics

• Demonstrated success building talent pipelines and recruiting for professional, technical, and leadership positions

• Strong knowledge of employment laws, EEO regulations, and recruitment compliance requirements

• Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship-building skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment

• Experience within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (A/E/C) industry or related professional services organizations, preferred

• Experience with Greenhouse ATS and ADP Workforce Now, preferred

Work Environment + Physical Demands

The characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. When properly requested and when feasible (without undue hardship to the company), reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

• Work will primarily be in an office setting with limited opportunities to be exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

• Work will be primarily working with fingers by picking, pinching, typing, and grasping often with repetitive motion.

• Must have visual acuity for viewing a computer screen, the ability to talk, hear and sit for extended periods of time.

• Must be able to carry, lift and push/pull up to 5 pounds frequently and up to 30 pounds occasionally.

• Travel will be required with this role.

• Additional physical duties may be required as necessary.

McAdams is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard for race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran's status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Backend Platform Team Leader
jobs.description:
Nanit is moving families beyond overwhelm by transforming how parents understand their baby's early years. We combine advanced AI, real-world data from billions of sleep hours, and clinical expertise to deliver the clarity and confidence every parent deserves. Trusted by over one million families and backed by $125M in funding, we're building an entirely new category: predictive parenting intelligence.

Here, your work directly impacts millions of families. Our team of scientists, engineers, and parents is small but mighty - we share a mission to make early childhood easier, healthier, and more connected. If you want to work on technology that genuinely matters, join us.

As Backend Platform Team Leader at Nanit, you'll lead the Platform pod. The pod owns our shared backend infrastructure (Kubernetes, Redpanda (Kafka), RabbitMQ, CI/CD, observability, and more), and it builds the tools, architecture and agentic workflows that let engineers in every other pod ship faster and more safely, at our growing scale

The role has two parts. As Pod Lead, you own the pod's direction, planning, delivery, and working process. As People Manager, you own the growth and performance of 3–4 direct reports, some of whom may work in other pods.

What you'll be doing -

• Infrastructure Ownership: Keep our shared infrastructure reliable, secure, and cost-efficient, and make every change to it safe and well planned.

• Architectural Evolution: Lead multi-quarter programs that reshape our backend, and migrate services onto them safely.

• Reliability: Make sure problems surface early, and drive incidents to their real root cause.

• Direction and Delivery: Maintain one clear, prioritized plan that you know in depth, and run a predictable team.

• Planning and Delivery: Own sprint and quarter planning. Maintain one clear, prioritized plan that you know in depth, and run a predictable team.

• Pod Process: Follow the PDLC, uphold the company's working processes and policies, and continuously shape and improve how the pod works.

• Technical Ownership: Know the pod's systems and how they fit together deeply enough to reason about them with confidence, guide design decisions, and challenge assumptions.

• People Leadership: Set clear goals and expectations, give honest feedback, invest in each report's growth, and stand behind your people. Where your reports work in other pods, stay aligned with those pod leads.

Who you are -

• Professional Experience: At least 6 years of backend development, with significant architecture or platform work, plus proven experience as a people manager, leading a team's execution and delivery.

• Technical Proficiency: Deep Kubernetes and AWS experience (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3), including cloud cost drivers. Hands-on experience with Redpanda (Kafka), RabbitMQ, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and Grafana/Prometheus.

• Problem Solving: You can reason through an unfamiliar problem out loud and outline sound solutions with their trade-offs.

• Who You Are:

• Agency: You don't wait to be told. You find what's broken or missing and move it forward.

• Passion for the Craft: You love backend engineering and care how things work under the hood.

• Purposeful Leadership: You know why you lead, and you see leadership as responsibility for other people's success.

• Depth and Clarity: You go deep into the details and explain things simply.

• Growth Mindset: You seek feedback and turn it into visible change.

What We Offer -

• Ownership of the foundation every Nanit backend team builds on.

• Impact on a platform that improves the lives of millions of parents around the world.

• Ownership of high-scale, modern systems that every Nanit backend team builds on, and the chance to shape their future.

• A leadership team that invests in developing its managers.

• A culture of continuous learning and balance.

• A clear growth path for strong leaders.

Join us as a Backend Platform Team Leader and help shape the foundation of Nanit's backend.

Why Nanit?

• Nanit products can actually change lives. We’re an integral part of the lives of new parents, making an exciting but stressful time a little more manageable.

• We are international and believe our diversity makes our culture, products, and brand even better.

• We invest in our people. We consider each employee a long-term investment and we see value in continuously helping them to advance in their lives and careers

• Nanit is a fun, collaborative group of hard workers! We believe in an appropriate work-life balance and offer a flexible, open environment.

• We are at the forefront of innovation, creating products and services that have never been seen before.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Manager, Visual Inspection Biologics - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
The Manager, Visual Inspection Biologics, is responsible for leading the coding, visual inspection and vacuum processes within the AbbVie Westport manufacturing facility. The Manager provides visible day-to-day leadership to the team on 1st Shift, builds capability and accountability, and ensures safe, compliant and efficient execution of the production schedule. The role works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain and other support functions through a structured daily and weekly meeting cadence to review priorities, confirm resource requirements, resolve issues and maintain product flow and timely delivery.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the visual inspection team and maintain full accountability for people, safety, quality, compliance, delivery, cost and operational performance.

• Provide visible, hands-on leadership across the area, setting clear expectations, promoting open communication and reinforcing a culture of accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.

• Lead daily and weekly operational meetings to review the production schedule, staffing, priorities, performance, quality events, constraints and required actions; ensure decisions and actions are communicated and followed through.

• Translate the agreed manufacturing schedule into clear shift and team priorities, coordinating resources and escalating risks early to support reliable schedule attainment and timely product delivery.

• Manage, coach and develop team members through regular one-to-one meetings, performance feedback, talent development, succession planning, training and recognition; support recruitment and effective onboarding as required.

• Establish and maintain an effective meeting cadence with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain and other support functions to align schedules, remove barriers, manage dependencies and close actions on time.

• Ensure coding, visual inspection and vacuum operations meet approved procedures, quality standards, GMP requirements and applicable regulatory expectations.

• Develop, maintain and periodically review visual inspection limits, procedures, training requirements and associated documentation.

• Monitor key performance indicators, address performance gaps and lead structured problem solving, continuous improvement and appropriate cost-saving initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations and policies, actively promoting safe behaviours and timely resolution of hazards and concerns.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in a GMP-regulated function, including demonstrated people-management or team-leadership experience; visual inspection experience is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of visual inspection materials and processes.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Strong leadership and management skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Knowledge of regulatory requirements for packaging.
